jobs.title: IT-Systemadministrator (w/m/d)
jobs.description:

in Hamburg-Harburg und in Vollzeit  genau richtig für Dich. Selbstständige, pragmatische und serviceorientierte Arbeitsweise mit klarer Priorisierung im TagesgeschäftSichere Deutschkenntnisse sowie überwiegende Präsenzbereitschaft

Umfassendes Onboarding:  Startklar ab Tag 1 – mit strukturierter Einarbeitung, enger Begleitung und ausreichend Zeit, um unsere Systeme, Abläufe und Ansprechpartner:innen bei HydroMapper sicher kennenzulernen.

jobs.description:

Unsere Scantechnologie liefert detailgenaue, georeferenzierte digitale Zwillinge und setzt neue Maßstäbe in Präzision und Kosteneffizienz. KI für Bilder und Punktwolken entwickeln:  Du entwickelst Anwendungen zur Auswertung von Bilddaten, Punktwolken und 3D-Daten, beispielsweise zur automatisierten Erkennung und Vermessung von Bauwerksschäden.

jobs.description:

The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.

We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.

The deadline for applying to this role is Sunday 15th November 2026, end of day, anywhere on Earth.

Security Engineering at the AI Security Institute (AISI) protects our people, partners, models, data and the research infrastructure that AISI's work depends on. We build secure-by-design platforms, automated governance and intelligence-led detection. We work closely with research units and technology teams so researchers can get on with their work.

We're now building an offensive security team and have three roles available.

We're looking for an experienced offensive security engineer who builds and breaks. You should be able to find and exploit vulnerabilities across cloud, infrastructure and application layers, and want to apply that work to containing and evaluating frontier AI models.

That includes the sandboxes, Inspect (our open-source evaluation framework), and the supporting cloud, identity and platform services. Alongside testing, you'll build and own agent-assisted red-teaming harnesses that test this infrastructure continuously.

You'll work directly with the engineers and with research teams on cyber ranges and evaluation tasks, and there's scope to publish and present your work externally.

jobs.description:
SingleStore is looking for an accomplished sales professional to join our Sales Team. AI is moving from experimentation into production, and this role is an opportunity to break into AI while doing meaningful enterprise selling.

As an Account Executive, AI Hunter, your job is simple: create new SingleStore customers. You will find companies building AI applications where data access, real-time context, memory, retrieval, or operational scale is becoming a constraint—and turn those challenges into new SingleStore customers. You will own a broad territory, build a majority self-sourced pipeline, create demand in an emerging category, and close greenfield enterprise opportunities.

This is a true hunting role. You will engage customers before they have a defined project, develop customer-specific points of view, create urgency around business and technical problems, work with technical experts to land first production workloads, and build a measurable new-logo business with broad ownership. The ideal candidate is a measurable enterprise hunter who is competitive, curious, technically credible, resilient, and able to sell business outcomes. Direct AI sales experience is valuable, but proven selling ability and technical curiosity matter more than a narrow “AI seller” title.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Software Engineer, GPU Compute
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Systems Engineer to join our team and play a key role in the development of our cutting-edge hyperscaler platform. The GPU & InfiniBand team is responsible for enhancing and optimizing the core components of our Cloud platform, with a specific focus on GPU computing, InfiniBand networks, and the KVM/QEMU stack. You’ll work closely with hardware virtualization and device emulation technologies, ensuring high performance and security in multi-GPU, HPC environments. The role involves analyzing, troubleshooting, and improving infrastructure to support new hardware, fine-tuning system performance, and automating fault detection and resolution in a complex system.

In this position, you will be responsible for:

  • Tuning the performance of GPU clusters and InfiniBand networks to ensure optimal operation in HPC and GPU-based environments. 
  • Analyzing and troubleshooting the root cause of issues related to GPUs and InfiniBand networks, and proposing corrective actions. 
  • Integrating new hardware into the existing infrastructure, including support for new GPU hardware through software stacks like Kubernetes, QEMU, and KVM. 
  • Enhancing automation systems for proactive monitoring, detecting, and resolving issues in GPU and InfiniBand environments. 
  • Configuring and managing GPU devices and InfiniBand fabrics, ensuring efficient and reliable operation.

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in system-level software development (focused on performance optimization, low-level programming). 
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Linux systems (administration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning). 
  • In-depth understanding of server architecture, including PCIe devices, NICs, Linux OS/Kernel, and high-performance computing (HPC) sy

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Vertical Search
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.

You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.

The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.

In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, research, data, and go-to-market.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own the vertical roadmap. You decide where we invest, what we ship for each, and when a vertical is not worth it.
  • Shape the product surface on top of the data, so a customer gets something built for their job.
  • Find and evaluate the data behind each vertical, across public sources and paid pro

About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine  cutting-edge biology  and  AI  to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our  AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.  Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to  bring more effective treatments to patients  who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a  fast-growing, mission-driven startup  at the intersection of science and technology.

The role

We are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team.  Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. Your mission will be to make omics data available to computational biologists and research engineers in a form they can build on. You will gather their needs and, in coordination with the Data & Infra team, design the data representations, storage layouts and access patterns that make model training and experimentation fast and reproducible. As our biobank expands, this will become a massive omics corpus that must efficiently serve client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D projects.  Starting from processed omics data, you will assess how it is stored and served today, propose solutions to scale it, and drive their implementation, so our scientists and models can rely on it. You will build this hand in hand with our data engineering team, keeping our omics infrastructure consistent with the rest of the company’s stack. You will report to the Head of Computational Biology.  Experience with omics data is a strong plus, not a prerequisite. If you come from the conventional tabular data world and want to master data that is massive, multi-layered and regularly reprocessed, this role is built for you.

What you will do

Design and build the omics data architecture.  Together with our data engineering team, define and evolve how omics data is stored as the corpus grows: what lives in a database, what stays in columnar files on S3, and how it all fits the company’s stack.

jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description:
About Kernel  Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at  Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion  already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised  $20M  from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing  12x YoY .

The Guardian team builds practical safety and oversight systems for increasingly capable AI agents. Our goal is to make it possible for agents to take on longer-running, higher-autonomy work while preserving meaningful safeguards, respecting user intent, and intervening when actions could cause serious or difficult-to-reverse harm. We're looking for a developer to grow Ember's network of charging hubs. You'll find the sites, take them through legals and planning, manage the build and energise them. How you work and think matters more to us than which industry you've worked in. You think clearly, can run several projects at once and are as at home on a site as behind a desk.

About Ember

We're building the future of public transport — convenient, affordable, connected and zero-emission. Our goal is to make it easier and more enjoyable to get from A to B with Ember than it is with your own car.  Ember is a tech company, not a traditional bus operator. We've built a platform that coordinates our entire operation — everything from monitoring vehicles and controlling chargers to selling tickets and calculating ETAs. This allows us to use electric buses more intensively than anyone else in the world, leading to a massive reduction in emissions. It also helps us provide a much better passenger experience, with innovative features like demand-responsive stops.  We’re still tiny, with a handful of routes and ~100 buses. The challenge is to scale this 50x whilst staying lean, increasing efficiency and delivering an even better product experience. We’ve recently raised a Series A from some of Europe’s leading climate VCs and are looking for mission-driven individuals who want to get on board and help take us to the next level.

The role

Charging hubs are Ember's key growth enabler. They give us the ultra-fast charge points we need to run our network, and they act as a base for our fleet — parking, washing, driver lounges and more. We have hubs across Scotland today, with additional sites across the UK under construction or in the pipeline.  You'll join a small team of four, taking end-to-end responsibility for your own sites and helping out on others. We're typically running a handful of projects at any one time.  Step one is finding a site. You’ll need to think about where we need charging capacity to support future routes, scout industrial estates and brownfield plots and reach out to commercial agents, local authorities and landlords. Some great sites are advertised but many are not, so landing one usually means being patient and creative.  Once you've got a site, we move on to lease negotiations, design, the planning application and the power connection. You'll work with network operators to land the grid connection, and with our suppliers to procure, install and commission the charging equipment. Solicitors, architects and engineers are there to help, but the project is yours to drive — you set the direction, you ask the difficult questions and you make the trade-offs.  It’s important to be hands-on. We don't go to tender and leave the rest to an outsourced project manager — we want you on site, asking why a kerb is in the wrong place. Every month, around 100 million people come to  Docplanner  to find a doctor, book a visit, stay in touch with their care and pay for it. Each of those steps is now being reinvented with AI.

At  OKX , we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles:  We Before Me ,  Do the Right Thing , and  Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

OKX is hiring a Head of Tax Information Reporting to build and run our global tax information reporting function. The function covers the OECD Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF), the EU's DAC8 directive, the amended Common Reporting Standard (CRS 2.0), FATCA, and US Form 1099-DA across multiple reporting entities and a large global user base, with annual reporting across the EU, Brazil, and other CARF jurisdictions.

Most of the work is data: getting the right user, transaction, and balance data out of our platform, reconciling it, and turning it into accurate filings. You will own the relationship with our reporting vendor, the data specification that feeds it, and the quality checks that decide whether a file goes out.

You will run a central function that owns policy, data, vendor, QA, and submission for every entity in scope. Each reporting entity names an accountable signatory. Local compliance and entity leads are consulted on local requirements and support registration where the law requires a local filer. You will work closely with Product, Data Engineering, Finance Operations, Group Tax, Legal, Data Privacy, and the local entity leads.

Location: remote available, with a strong preference for the US or EU. Some travel to OKX offices.

What You'll Be Doing

Own the end-to-end CARF, DAC8, CRS 2.0, FATCA, and 1099-DA reporting cycle for every OKX entity in scope: population definition, self-certification coverage, data extraction and reconciliation, file production, QA, filing, corrections, and tax authority queries.

Define and own the data specification that feeds the tax platform vendor: which users, which transactions, which balances, how they are aggregated by user and jurisdiction, and how they reconcile to the ledger. Work with Product and Data Engineering to build and test the pipeline.

Build and run the QA framework. Reconcile every file to source, validate it against the OECD XML schema and local variants, sample-test self-certification reasonableness checks, and run cross-entity consistency checks for users who hold accounts with more than one OKX entity. Nothing files without your release.

jobs.description:
About  Nebius :

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Infrastructure Acquisition Group

The Infrastructure Acquisition Group secures the land, power, and data center capacity that enables the Nebius AI Cloud. We identify where Nebius should grow next, structure the commercial agreements that make that growth possible, and partner across engineering, energy, finance, legal, and development to bring new AI infrastructure online.

We're a small, founding team building this function from the ground up across the Americas, leading the acquisition of colocation, build-to-suit, powered land, and other strategic infrastructure opportunities as one of the world's fastest-growing AI cloud platforms scales.

Examples of Problems We're Solving

Transform acquisitions into data center-ready projects.  A signed agreement is only the beginning. You'll lead development planning, utility coordination, permitting, consultant management, and infrastructure planning to prepare projects for successful delivery.

Keep development ahead of construction.  Coordinate engineering, utilities, municipalities, and development partners so projects remain ready for execution while commercial negotiations conclude and infrastructure requirements evolve.

Build a repeatable development program.  Help establish the standards, development governance, readiness gates, and project controls that will support AI infrastructure development across the Americas.

About the Role

As a Development Manager, you'll lead the development of AI infrastructure projects across the Americas from executed agreement through construction readiness. Working within the Infrastructure Acquisition Group, you'll partner with Site Selection, Technical Due Diligence, Engineering, Energy, Finance, Legal, and Delivery to transform acquisitions into fully defined, development-ready projects.

This is a build-phase role on a build-phase team. Many of the development standards, governance processes, readiness gates, and project controls you'll use are still being written—in some cases, you'll help write them. We're looking for someone who can independently lead complex infrastructure developments while helping build the systems that make every future project faster, more predictable, and more scalable.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
THE ROLE 📝

We’re looking for a Senior Digital Marketing Manager to lead Form3’s digital growth and demand generation strategy, helping drive pipeline growth and brand development across our priority markets. Reporting to the Marketing Director, you’ll combine strategic ownership with execution across integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, digital acquisition and performance measurement. You’ll also identify practical ways to use AI, automation and marketing technology to improve targeting, personalisation, efficiency and campaign results. You’ll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product and the wider Marketing team, aligning marketing activity with commercial priorities and identifying opportunities within strategic accounts.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and own Form3’s digital growth and demand generation strategy.
  • Create go-to-market plans for products, propositions, markets and strategic announcements.
  • Create integrated, multi-channel programmes that generate awareness, engagement, qualified leads and pipeline.
  • Build account-based marketing programmes for high-value prospects and strategic accounts.
  • Use AI, automation and marketing technology to improve targeting, personalisation, lead generation and campaign performance.
  • Monitor performance across the marketing funnel and make insight-led recommendations.
  • Improve website performance, conversion rates, user journeys and marketing-driven engagement.


WE’RE LOOKING FOR 🔍

Essential

  • 6+ years’ experience in B2B digital marketing, demand generation or campaign management.
  • Strong experience developing campaign strategies and delivering integrated marketing campaigns.
  • Proven ability to link marketing investment to revenue growth and return on investment.
  • Expertise in account-based marketing, audience segmentation, pipeline generation and campaign activation.
  • Practical experience using AI, automation and marketing technology to improve campaign performance.
  • Strong digital marketing capability across websites, landing pages, email, paid media, search and social, with the breadth and depth to lead an integrated digital strategy.
  • Strong analytical and performance-reporting skills, combined with a commercial and customer-focused approach.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions.

Desirable

  • Experience within technology, SaaS, Fintech or payments.
  • Experience working within a start-up/scale-up environment.
  • Working experience across multiple markets e.g. UK/Europe/NA
  • Familiarity with tooling such as Salesforce, Pardot, Salesloft, Cognism, ZoomInfo.

jobs.title: Director, Audience Development & Digital Marketing (Parental leave 12 Months FTC)
jobs.description:
The Orchard are looking for a highly motivated, forward thinking, Audience Development & Digital Marketing Director to join us on a 12 Month parental leave cover.

You will be responsible for finding unique ways to grow audience data and drive engagement by running effective CRM strategies and engaging fanbases to drive sales and revenue for new releases and catalogue titles across our client roster.

As this a senior role you will be expected to be a strategic thinker in the marketing space and help execute marketing campaigns at a high level across the team.

As a team we meet in the London office from Monday–Thursday. People may choose to work remotely on Fridays.

What you'll do:

  • Work closely with our Marketing Strategists to help lead the day-to-day development and execution of strategies that grow artists’ first-party fan audiences across email & SMS
  • Serve as the main point of contact for CRM and audience development in the UK office encouraging best practices with The Orchard’s internal and 3rd party tools
  • Develop scalable acquisition frameworks & benchmarks that can be adapted across artists, genres, & campaign types.
  • Define campaign KPIs and benchmarks across acquisition channels, markets, artists and campaign types.
  • Build case studies and best-practice guidance that can help scale successful acquisition strategies across the organization.
  • Be on hand to help the Marketing Strategists with executing creative and innovative marketing campaigns. You will also be working closely with the Paid Media team to deploy digital advertising campaigns across the main platforms Meta, TikTok, Google, Snapchat and Spotify and more
  • Seek out opportunities for artist and label development through internal resources and external tools or services that could enhance campaign efforts. Work with multiple departments and team members to bring innovative marketing activations to life in the digital and real world. Foster fan community relationships to amplify campaign reach and effectiveness
  • Be proactive in identifying challenges and providing solutions to keep release campaigns on track. Demonstrate flexibility and a balance of supporting label needs. Be nimble as priorities arise outside of process, be able to move with importance as well as vision

Who you are:

  • Minimum of 5 years of audience development, digital marketing, fan acquisition, growth marketing or related experience in the music industry or a similar field.
  • Proven track record of successful campaign development, audience growth and execution.
  • Passionate about the music business

We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in its diverse and inclusive work culture centered around great people practices, learning opportunities, and having fun! Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.

For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.

As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

Given our continued growth, we always have room for more intellect, energy, and enthusiasm - join our global team and see why it's so special to be a part of Mitratech!

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer specialising in Generative AI and Large Language Models, with a strong focus on agentic systems, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and AI evaluations, to join our dynamic team.   • Define and own evaluation frameworks for generative outputs, including automated metrics, LLM-as-judge approaches, human evaluation protocols, hallucination detection, and drift monitoring.
  • Apply classical NLP techniques where appropriate and maintain awareness of data distribution shif

About The Opportunity

We are building a rigorous, verifiable evaluation suite of Terminal-Bench tasks designed to test the limits of large language models on multilingual software challenges. Our goal is to measure multilingual robustness across prompt language effects, non-English data processing, and complex locale/encoding edge cases in terminal workflows.  We are seeking experienced native-speaking software engineers to design, build, and validate these benchmarks. You will create high-signal, high-quality tasks that genuinely test a model's ability to handle multilingual environments without relying on English translation crutches.

Note this is a remote, freelance opportunity

What You’ll Deliver

Task Engineering: Evaluating Coding Agents.

Asset Creation: Build realistic task environments using datasets and files in your native language.  Crucially, these assets must remain in the target language to genuinely measure multilingual handling.

Prompting & Translation: finding failure points where AI does not work, in your native language

Implementation & Verification: Support the development of robust solutions (reference implementations) and write highly reliable, deterministic verifier scripts (using rubric-based judging only when strictly necessary).

Calibration & Execution: Analyze execution logs and calibrate task difficulty (Easy to Very Hard) using standard Terminal-Bench run configurations against various model tiers (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus).

Quality Assurance: Participate in a rigorous, 4-layer human quality control process (creation, human review, calibration review, and audit) alongside automated LLM-based checks to ensure fairness, grammatical accuracy, and benchmark integrity.

Experience:  1+ years of industry experience in software engineering.

Background:  Proven track record at leading technology companies and/or graduation from top-tier engineering universities.

Language:  Native or near-native fluency, with a deep understanding of its grammar, register, and phrasing rules. High English proficiency.

Workflow:  Extensive experience with Terminal/CLI-based development workflows and a working familiarity with coding agents.

Domain Expertise:  Deep technical understanding of multilingual text processing pitfalls, including:

Encoding/decoding robustness and Unicode normalization.

Locale-dependent conventions (collation, casing, non-Gregorian dates).

Text I/O, toolchain interoperability, and safe string operations.

(For specific languages)  Bidirectional/RTL handling, font fallbacks, and rendering/typography in UI or artifacts.

jobs.title: Robotics Data Engineer, Human Motion Data (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About EASE  EASE builds active, AI-powered exoskeletons for logistics and manufacturing. As a TUM spin-off, we have just started series production, and paid pilots with well-known logistics companies have led to first purchase orders. Our goal: move every parcel better, manually with an exoskeleton or autonomously with a robot.  The role  Our exoskeletons are deployed in real warehouses and production plants and capture what video-only datasets miss: body pose, joint kinematics, interaction torques, vision, and hand forces from real human work. Your job is to build pipelines that turn raw exoskeleton recordings into clean, robot-ready training data, including retargeting human motion to the humanoid’s body. So in the future human workers and robots can work side by side on the same tasks.  What you'll do

Define signals, formats and metadata for our next exoskeleton generation

Build pipelines from devices in the field to storage, incl. sync, calibration and versioning

Build tooling for quality checks, segmentation, annotation and dataset export

Implement anonymization, consent handling and GDPR-compliant data flows

Set up storage and compute together with our robot learning team

What you bring

Degree in CS, data engineering, robotics or similar, with hands-on pipeline experience

Strong Python and SQL; pipeline tools (e.g. Airflow, Ray or Spark)

Time-series or multimodal sensor data, incl. synchronization and calibration

Cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure), Docker and Linux

Solid understanding of GDPR and personal data

Nice to have

ROS 2, MCAP or LeRobot; annotation or dataset management tools

Kubernetes or SLURM; basic ML training workflows in PyTorch

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. What you have built matters more than a perfect match.  What we offer

Data almost nobody else has, from a product in series deployment

The chance to build our data platform from the ground up

Competitive salary plus virtual stock options (VSOP)

Flexible hours, hybrid in Munich, mobility benefit

Budget for conferences and further training

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

We're looking for a Principal, Product Analytics who loves getting to the bottom of things. You'll do the deep investigative and technical work that explains why users and customers behave the way they do, and turn it into decisions that change the product and the business.

We're building a more proactive data function, and this role is its deep-investigation engine. You'll take ambiguous, high-stakes questions about user behaviour and customer experience and follow them wherever the data leads, across acquisition, activation, usage and the wider customer journey.

You'll work hands-on and independently, partnering with Product Managers, engineering managers and commercial teams, and working alongside a VP of Growth who will set the function's direction and build the team. Your findings will inform experiments, the roadmap and company strategy.

What you'll do

Go looking for what nobody asked about.  This is the heart of the role. You'll notice when something looks off in a funnel, a cohort or a metric, disappear into it, and come back with a product issue, a cost leak or an opportunity nobody was looking for. You set much of your own agenda, and you don't wait for a request to start digging.

Lead deep investigations  into user behaviour and customer experience across product and non-product touchpoints, including support, customer success and sales.

Find where activation breaks.  Identify failure points in the user journey, including those that could become productised capabilities.

Understand acquisition and intent.  Dig into acquisition channels, user use cases and what people are actually trying to achieve.

Do rigorous causal and statistical work.  Go beyond correlation with regression, causal analysis and well-designed experiments, and be clear about what the evidence does and doesn't support.

Build models that drive action.  Apply data science to real business problems, such as churn modelling that can trigger real-time product action, and explain clearly how models are applied and what impact they have.

Analyse unstructured and AI-specific data.  Work with agent-user conversations, context layers and evaluation systems alongside structured product data.

jobs.title: Technical Architect
jobs.description:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.

THE ROLE: Technical Architect

We’re deploying large-scale NVIDIA GPU clusters, including GB200 and GB300 rack-scale systems, into live data centres on tight customer commit dates. On those schedules, a design error found on site costs weeks and real money. We need one architect per deployment who takes the high-level design and turns it into something that can actually be built, then stays with it until the customer signs off.

This is a role for someone who would rather find the problem on paper than on the data hall floor. It suits someone who will push back on an inherited design or a customer requirement that won’t perform, and who carries authority through owning the design rather than managing people.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:

  • Take each cluster from CTO handover to customer acceptance as its single design authority, so nothing is ordered or installed against a design you haven’t validated
  • Turn high-level designs and initial BOMs into build-ready low-level designs, hall layouts, rack elevations, P2P maps and cable schedules that site teams can build from without having to call you
  • Design the InfiniBand and Ethernet fabric, power, direct liquid cooling and containment to fit the real constraints of each data centre
  • Validate every BOM before it goes to procurement, and make part substitution calls knowing exactly what breaks when a line changes
  • Hold OEMs and integrators (NVIDIA, Dell, Lenovo, Supermicro and others) to their technical commitments, from FAT witness through to on-site issue resolution
  • Build the reference designs and building blocks that mean each new deployment starts from a known-good baseline rather than a blank page

ABOUT YOU

We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You’ll likely bring a combination of the following:

Essential:

  • You’ve designed and delivered large-scale GPU or HPC clusters into live data centres, and you were on site for the build
  • Deep, practical knowledge of NVIDIA platforms (GB200/GB300 rack-scale and HGX H200/B200) and what each one demands of a facility

jobs.description:
Hi  I’m

Abhik  ,  Ashby 's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. We’re looking for an ambitious full-stack engineer who is laser-focused on solving customer problems and making the right long-term investments to solve them not only today but in our future features and products.  What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you write product specs, make product and design decisions, and build in an almost-no-meeting culture. While also the product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: tens of thousands of daily users who depend on your software and eagerly await your next feature.  We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet.  You’ve probably seen this role posted before, and it’s because we’re always expanding the team (we’re on track to double this year). We’re bubbling with ideas on how to support Talent Acquisition through software, and we’ve started the journey of building products beyond Talent Acquisition. We read every application and aim to respond to yours within 3-4 days (often sooner).  About the Role and How We Work  Our engineering culture strives to recreate the environments where we did our best work as ICs – where we had the ownership and agency to impact our users with creative and innovative software.  I started my career building software for artists in the Visual Effects industry. It was a formative experience for me as a software engineer because success relied on my ability to be a product manager and designer. I talked to artists to understand their needs. I came up with ideas. I did industry research, designed interfaces, and prototyped ideas. I watched artists use what I built and decided what to tackle in the next iteration. No daily stand-ups, no t-shirt sizing, no planning meetings.  I studied computer science to solve problems, not tickets, and this felt exactly like that. I not only felt creative and fulfilled but the agency and ownership we were given as engineers powered an incredible amount of innovation.  Innovation came differently (or not at all) at technology startups beyond the seed stage, often through an engineer’s force of will and ability to push back against culture (rather than any encouragement from it). Engineering was narrowed to implementation and delivery, partly due to the influence of other departments and partly due to the influx of "Agile" processes like sprint planning. In those companies, I felt like a JIRA jockey.

jobs.title: Staff Design Engineer - UK
jobs.description:
Hi  I’m

Abhik  ,  Ashby 's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year.

This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that.

You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have:

Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI.

Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily.

Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

The Design Engineer role is more common today than five years ago, but I believe Ashby offers a unique opportunity that few can match:

You work on a product at scale, not at an early-stage startup struggling to find users and get feedback on what you’ve designed and built. At Ashby, your work will touch over 100,000 weekly active users, millions of candidates per week, and notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. You’ll get to test out ideas with our own recruiting team and hiring managers who use Ashby every day (like me), and often hear customer feedback as early as the day you release.

This role has always had the commitment of both Benji (CEO & Co-Founder) and me: I’ve held the role, steadfastly championed it since we started hiring in 2020, and haven’t diluted its responsibilities as we’ve grown (in fact, we’ve doubled down).

You get to shape the UI and UX of a powerful and complex product. Our users need software that helps them move quickly while adapting to their unique workflows and preferences. As a r

CNTD Dept는 크래프톤의 AI 경쟁력을 강화하고 새 성장 기회를 확보하기 위해 AI 사업과 기술 투자 기회를 발굴하는 조직입니다.
단순 재무 투자에 그치지 않고 크래프톤의 중장기 전략 방향을 바탕으로 유망 기술과 사업 기회를 앞서 탐색합니다. 투자 이후에는 사업 접점과 협업 여지도 함께 봅니다. 이를 위해 AI 기술, 제품, 산업 구조를 조사하고 잠재 투자 대상을 발굴/분석하며, 필요 시 투자 실행과 후속 연계 방안까지 검토합니다.

  • 글로벌 AI 시장, 기술, 산업 구조 리서치 및 인사이트 도출

jobs.description:

Join some of the best Graphics Engineers in the world supporting the largest immersive 3D streaming environment deployed across console, desktop, mobile, and VR.

  • Scalability: Roblox provides a platform that guarantees to the creators that their games will always and automatically run on different devices, with cross-platform play and minimal load times.
  • Compatibility: Roblox games and assets made in the past, are still working today. Rendering has to have an eye to the past, and an eye to the future…
  • Community: Roblox games are made by creators of all experience levels, from professionals who earn their living on the platform to kids who are learning to program using Roblox!

As a Rendering Engineer, you will solve difficult challenges, while continuing to build a high-speed, completely dynamic environments connected on all devices.

Many established rendering techniques do not trivially apply to our platform - novel solutions are needed as we push Roblox towards higher targets of visual fidelity. Even the simpler visuals we support on low-power devices are enabled by some creative rendering ideas, often centered around caching, incremental computation and graceful degradation.

All of this is based on an in-house rendering engine built from the ground up, supporting DirectX 9/11, OpenGL, GNM, Metal, and Vulkan GAPI's. We have a powerful need for top-notch, low-level and high-level graphics work.

You Will:

  • Help investigate and implement rendering techniques to make ROBLOX graphics more immersive and expressive
  • Learn about our community and work with technical artists to understand the present and future needs of our creators
  • Help improve the performance and stability of our game engine
  • Work with other engineering and art teams
  • Take ownership of a project throughout its full lifecycle

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Job Description

The Geometry Scalability team builds the systems that power both Avatars and Environments across Roblox. Our mission is to enable millions of developers to build large, high-fidelity worlds and multiplayer experiences that still run smoothly on phones and low-end devices.

We’re the team that lets Roblox experiences evolve from simple platformers into massively multiplayer, open-world, AAA-quality games. This is a CEO-level priority: how Roblox “ages up” from kids’ games to experiences everyone wants to play, by making higher-fidelity avatars and environments performant at platform scale.

You Will:

  • Design and ship 3D engine systems for avatar and environment geometry, including mesh processing, level of detail, transcoding, streaming, runtime loading, and related performance systems.
  • Partner closely with other teams (Rendering, Avatar, Studio) and external developers so that the features you build are directly usable to create amazing experiences.
  • Profile and improve the performance of our game engine across a wide range of devices, with particular attention to mobile.
  • Lead by example: drive projects end-to-end, mentor other engineers, and help set a high bar for technical quality and code health on the team.

You Have:

  • Proven Expertise: 8+ years of professional experience building and shipping high-performance systems in domains such as game engines, real-time simulation, robotics, AR/VR, or similar.
  • Strong C++ Experience: Deep proficiency in C++, with a focus on writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code in large codebases.
  • Applied 3D Systems Experience: Demonstrated hands-on experience building at least one production system involving real-time 3D rendering, mesh or geometry processing, LOD, animation/skinning, spatial data, 3D

We’re looking for an outstanding Software Engineer to join our Game Engine Data Model team. As a member of this team, you will innovate on the core data structures that form the backbone of Roblox’s platform. In this role you will have first hand opportunity to design and build one of the core technologies that makes the Roblox game engine special.

The Data Model is the object hierarchy that is analogous to a scene graph or entity system, powering all our experiences by exposing an interface between core engine capabilities and our creators. It also acts as a fabric to core technologies, such as networking, scripting, Studio, rendering and physics which are essential to the high performance of the Roblox game engine.

jobs.description:

As a Software Engineer on the Engine Systems team, you will help build the core diagnostic instrumentation for Roblox’s engine. In this role, support and build the systems that allow us to monitor and analyze Roblox from the hardware level all the way up to end user experience to improve Roblox for our millions of concurrent users.

You will contribute to platform-level systems that help Roblox understand hangs, crashes, performance regressions, and session health across our supported clients. This work requires navigating hardware and vendor-specific limitations across devices, while building reliable systems that help engineering teams safely ship weekly binary updates to Roblox at global scale.

You Will

  • Build and maintain components of the (predominantly C++) systems that report stability, reliability, and performance signals across Roblox clients, working from defined designs and contributing to technical decisions within your area.
  • Write well-instrumented, production-quality code across supported platforms, including mobile, desktop, and major consoles, with guidance on complex systems-level work.
  • Deliver the tools and signals engineers use to detect, understand, and resolve disruptions to the user experience, and help improve them based on feedback from those teams.

You Have

  • 1+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong ownership of complex technical systems.
  • Knowledge: You are comfortable working with systems level programming languages (C++, C#, Objective C, Rust, or similar programming language).
  • Curiosity: You are eager to work across a wide range of systems and understand the engine end to end
  • Long-term Mindset: You are considerate of how your work impacts the team/users over time, not just getting the green checkmark on a deliverable

The Infrastructure Compute Site Reliability Engineering mission is to own and manage the successful operation of our underlying cell infrastructure system, along with elements of service discovery, secrets management and related software layers. We’re looking for a skilled Senior Site Reliability Engineer with strong programming skills to help us build Roblox's private cloud, productionize our growing Kubernetes-based infrastructure, and institute reliability best practices across the Roblox Compute team.

You will:

  • Design and Develop systems & libraries that promote fault-tolerance and resilience, automate much of the management and lifecycle of our clusters, and ensure systems are observable.
  • Promote and Institute reliability best practices across the Infra Compute group, drive common reliability initiatives. Provides collaborative technical reviews and operational guidance to strengthen system reliability.
  • Build, Automate and Standardize process automation to create a "golden path" of tooling and platform support that powers the fundamental Roblox ecosystem.
  • Create Tooling that provides production guardrails, by evaluating release candidate capacity with load testing tooling before deploying to production.
  • Create Performance Monitoring Services and observability towards understanding capacity issues and platform degradations, monitoring production services and their changes, like generalized canarying services with alerting.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer- User Behavior
jobs.description:

Why User Behavior?

You will build the backend systems that fundamentally shift how Roblox responds to unsafe behavior - from reactive, stateless punishment to a personalized, adaptive system that reflects who a user actually is.

You will own core backend infrastructure for a new capability at Roblox: a low-latency behavioral data layer, a centralized rules-and-inference engine, and a unified intervention-delivery framework that together let us treat users based on their real risk profile instead of a single point total. This is a rare opportunity to build foundational, high-scale systems that directly shape how Roblox understands and responds to risk across hundreds of millions of users.

You will feel a deep sense of responsibility building systems that directly affect millions of users, especially minors, on one of the world's largest platforms. Your work will reduce harm, improve fairness, and help ensure Roblox remains a place where creativity and community can thrive safely.

You will:

  • Build the User Behavior Foundation: Design and operate the low-latency, per-user behavioral data layer that powers real-time safety decisions - aggregating signals like violation history, in-game reports, and behavioral patterns into a single queryable source of truth.

We build the isolation layers that contain untrusted and semi-trusted code. You will design, build, and harden process sandboxes across one or more of Linux, macOS, and Windows, the last line of defense when something inside goes wrong. This is a deep systems role for someone who thinks in terms of attack surface, threat models, and the exact boundary between trusted and untrusted.

  • Make deliberate engineering tradeoffs between isolation strength, performance, compatibility, and maintainability, and document the reasoning.
  • Write threat models, review designs, and respond to sandbox escapes and hardening findings.

  • Fluency in the boundary between sandbox and host (brokers, IPC, syscall filtering, privilege separation) and how to design a minimal, well-audited interface.

The Game Engine team at Roblox works on the systems that power the experiences at the heart of the metaverse. Our code is the technical foundation in our client, editor, and our simulation servers.

The Game Engine team is broadly split into departments — Audio-Video-Communication, Avatar, Core AI, Digital Matter, Productivity, and Systems. This position is for the Systems Runtime pod.

The Runtime pod builds and maintains the foundational C++ components that power the entire Roblox engine and Studio stack. We own the runtime layer — the performance, efficiency, and usability of the core primitives that every other engineering team relies on. Think of Runtime as the “standard library” and execution engine for Roblox's C++ world. Our ownership centers on three pillars:

  • Concurrency System — our task scheduler and fiber runtime power how work is parallelized across CPU cores, letting teams scale features across platforms while keeping code understandable and debuggable.
  • Memory System — we own the engine's memory allocator stack, tracking pipelines, and observability tooling to make memory behavior predictable and prevent leaks and fragmentation.
  • Profiling and Observability — we build and evolve the MicroProfiler and telemetry pipelines to help engineers diagnose real-world regressions and keep the client fast at global scale.

This role centers on our Concurrency system. You will own the scheduler and fiber runtime that the rest of the engine is built on, research and implement the performance work needed for 3K-player servers and genre expansion initiatives, and act as the point of contact other engine teams come to with concurrency asks. You will debug real production failures across PC, Mac, mobile, and console, and build deep intuition for how compilers, CPU architectures, and operating systems interact. jobs.title: API Engineer (H/F)
jobs.description:
Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé.  Nous avons l’obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd’hui utilisés par des millions d’utilisateurs.  Nous créons des objets connectés et des applications pour aider chacun à prendre soin de sa santé au quotidien. Au cœur de cet écosystème, l' équipe API  est le pont qui connecte nos produits, nos services et nos partenaires.

Vos Missions 
Rattaché(e) directement au Lead Developer API, vous êtes le garant technique de nos API. Vous êtes un(e)  développeur(se) Backend ou Fullstack  (avec au moins une expérience significative en développement API) souhaitant concilier la pratique du code avec un rôle central dans l'évaluation fonctionnelle, la conception d'architecture et la rédaction de spécifications techniques.

1. Conception d'architecture et spécifications techniques (40%)

Analyser et challenger les spécifications fonctionnelles des PMs.  Modéliser les bases de données, définir les endpoints et concevoir les contrats d'API.  Rédiger les spécifications techniques.

2. Développement & debugging (40%)

Développer de nouveaux endpoints et maintenir les services existants (framework PHP interne performant, front React).  Résoudre les problèmes techniques, déboguer et optimiser les requêtes SQL.  Accompagner les équipes internes lors de la livraison et participer aux revues de code.

3. Productivité, LLM & Suivi technique (20%)

Intégrer les LLM au quotidien pour automatiser ou améliorer la documentation, les tests, la revue de code et l'outillage interne.  Participer aux réflexions techniques avec les développeurs.  Surveiller et améliorer le suivi des erreurs et des performances des APIs.

Requirements

Formation  : Vous êtes issu d'une formation Bac+5 en informatique

Expérience :  Vous justifiez d'une première expérience significative en tant que développeur Backend ou Fullstack. Vous avez déjà été confronté aux réalités de la production, à la conception d'APIs et aux cycles de livraison logicielle.

Techniques :  Vous maîtrisez au moins un langage Backend et êtes prêt(e) à vous approprier un framework PHP interne robuste.Vous avez des connaissances sur React pour la partie web.

Esprit d'analyse :  Face à un document de spécifications, vous aimez creuser et chercher la petite bête pour éviter les pièges techniques avant le premier commit.

Sens du collectif  : Vous aimez échanger avec des profils variés (PM, Devs, Ops). Vous savez écouter, questionner et vulgariser.

Sensibilité LLM / IA :  Vous utilisez déjà des outils comme Copilot, ChatGPT ou Claude au quotidien et vous êtes prêt(e) à trouver des solutions pour intégrer l'utilisation des IA génératives dans nos processus existants.

Précision :  Ce rôle n'est ni un poste de Product Owner ni de gestion de projet

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

They may also work across the full stack, creating intuitive user experiences that turn data from millions of devices into actionable insights, while partnering closely with product and design to rapidly iterate on features that deliver real customer value.

On the mobile side, a New Grad could help strengthen the infrastructure behind our React Native app, enabling feature teams to move quickly and build performant, maintainable products. About the role:

  • Lead and develop a leadership team of Senior Managers and Managers, who in turn run Ocean Operations teams across EMEA. You are accountable for organisation design, hiring plans and succession planning at every level beneath you.   • Define and deliver the multi-year EMEA ocean strategy and the planning cycles that support it (biannual planning and quarterly check-ins). You separate what the core operation needs to keep running well from what is expansion, and you turn that into clear choices on investment, team size and priorities, aligned with EMEA operations goals.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role Summary

As an Account Executive, you will own the full sales cycle for UK and EU SMB customers—from prospecting and pipeline generation through closing and activation. This is a hunter role focused on building pipeline, driving revenue, and consistently achieving quota.

What You’ll Do

• Prospect and identify new SMB opportunities across assigned territories
• Build and manage a healthy pipeline through self-generated and SDR-qualified opportunities
• Conduct discovery, sales conversations, negotiations, and close deals end-to-end

• Drive early customer activation and time-to-value post-close

Who You Are

• 4–5 years of experience in B2B Sales, Business Development, or Account Executive roles

• Strong discovery, negotiation, and consultative selling skills
• Comfortable owning a territory and independently building pipeline
• Data-driven, CRM proficient, and comfortable using AI tools for prospecting and productivity

Nice to Have

• Experience in fintech, payments, or B2B SaaS
• Knowledge of payments, FX, cash management, or financial operations
• Experience with multi-product selling and upsell/cross-sell

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Run & Grow
jobs.description:
About the Run & Grow:

Run & Grow is where SumUp builds the platforms and capabilities that help merchants discover, join, use, and continue growing with our products. The tribe brings together engineering, product, design, and revenue operations teams around two connected goals: helping SumUp serve and retain merchants, and accelerating acquisition, activation, and engagement.

Our work sits at the heart of SumUp's growth engine. We turn complex challenges across merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, commercial systems, operations, risk, and compliance into reliable products and services that other teams can build on. The systems we create help SumUp move faster, make better decisions, and deliver a simpler experience to millions of small businesses.

Joining Run & Grow means working on high-impact engineering problems with a broad view of the business. You'll collaborate across disciplines and teams, shape the foundations behind important merchant journeys, and help create a more connected, scalable way for SumUp to run and grow.

What you'll do:

Design, build, and operate production-grade backend services, APIs, and integrations, primarily using Go.

Build event-driven workflows and distributed systems using technologies such as Kafka and asynchronous processing.

Define clear service boundaries, data models, schemas, and API contracts that other teams can use confidently.

Build capabilities supporting merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, operations, risk, and compliance.

Own technical work end to end, from discovery and system design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production follow-up.

Modernise existing services and improve reliability through observability, security, failure handling, and incident response.

Collaborate with Product, Data, Operations, Compliance, Risk, Sales, Marketing, and other engineering teams to turn complex requirements into practical solutions.

Review code and designs, make pragmatic technical trade-offs, share knowledge, and mentor engineers around you

You'll be great for this role if you:

Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly

Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns

Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case

Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns

Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable fintech, payments, or similar domains

Have experience with testing, observability, and incident response practices and treat them as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts

Take ownership of ambiguous problems and turn them into clear, scalable, and maintainable solutions.

Communicate clearly, collaborate effectively, and explain technical conce

This is a rare chance to own that foundation at a pivotal moment, with a blank canvas to build on and a company-wide priority behind you. jobs.title: Senior IT Engineer
jobs.description:
About Morpho  Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

Why Morpho Exists  Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article  here .  About the role

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

Build the machine that builds the machine . Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology . Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook,  every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

Do work that matters, and see it grow . The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

Make an impact you can point to . In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

Create and maintain detailed, day-to-day production schedules that translate the production plan into executable work on the manufacturing floor.  Monitor progress, resolve scheduling conflicts, and adapt plans in real time as priorities and conditions change.  Enable predictable delivery of critical fusion hardware while improving efficiency, coordination, and transparency across manufacturing operations.

Sequence and re-sequence work orders day-to-day to reflect real-time engineering priorities, material availability and manufacturing constraints. Find out more about the team and life at Omnea  here .

The Role

As Omnea's Strategic Account Manager, you won't own a fixed book of accounts. Instead, you'll work across a large, shared pool of customers, 50+ at a time, and your job is to make every single one of them successful.

Unlike a traditional account role built around a handful of strategic relationships, you'll operate at scale: building Omnea's presence and community across your customer base through events, webinars, roundtables, and digital engagement, turning individual customers into a connected, invested group of Omnea advocates.

You'll still carry a commercial edge, owning retention and a smaller share of expansion across your pool, but the bulk of the role is about driving real value realisation and adoption at volume rather than running a small number of deep, high-touch relationships.

You're someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, is energised by variety, and knows how to prioritise ruthlessly. You're as comfortable hosting a roundtable for 30 procurement leaders as you are running a tight renewal call with a CFO.

What You'll Do

Own a large, shared pool of accounts:  Manage 50+ accounts at a time across SMB and mid-market, not a fixed book, building relationships from end users (Procurement, Finance, Ops) through to senior stakeholders (CFOs, COOs), and stepping in early wherever you spot a health risk.

Drive value realisation, with a lighter expansion motion:  Own Net Revenue Retention across your pool. Lead renewal conversations, secure multi-year extensions, and pass qualified upsell signal to Sales rather than running full commercial cycles yourself.

Build community and drive engagement at scale

jobs.title: Interim Chief Privacy Officer | RVO
jobs.description:
Omschrijving

Wij zijn voor de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) op zoek naar een ervaren  Interim Chief Privacy Officer (CPO) . Binnen de afdeling CIP speel je een sleutelrol in het verder ontwikkelen en professionaliseren van de privacyfunctie binnen een grote en complexe overheidsorganisatie.  Vanwege het vertrek van de huidige plaatsvervangend CPO is tijdelijke versterking nodig om de continuïteit van de privacyorganisatie te waarborgen. Op termijn wordt de functie structureel ingevuld. In deze opdracht ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verder inrichten en uitbouwen van de CPO-functie, het versterken van de privacy governance en het adviseren van management bij complexe privacyvraagstukken.  Je begeleidt en stuurt privacyfunctionarissen functioneel aan, verbindt verschillende stakeholders binnen de organisatie en draagt actief bij aan de verdere professionalisering van privacy, compliance en gegevensbescherming.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Verder ontwikkelen, inrichten en positioneren van de Chief Privacy Officer-functie.

Functioneel aansturen van privacyfunctionarissen en privacyaanspreekpunten binnen de organisatie.

Adviseren van hoger management over complexe privacyvraagstukken.

Opstellen, uitvoeren en bewaken van het privacyplan.

Doorontwikkelen van privacy governance, privacybeleid en bijbehorende processen.

Uitvoeren, begeleiden en beoordelen van Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA's).

Deelnemen aan strategische en tactische overleggen op het gebied van privacy en gegevensbescherming.

Begeleiden van privacy-audits, onderzoeken en opvolging van verbetermaatregelen.

Wat vragen wij?

Eisen

Afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding op het gebied van gegevensbescherming, privacy of een vergelijkbare richting.

Minimaal 2,5 jaar aantoonbare ervaring als Chief Privacy Officer (CPO) of plaatsvervangend CPO binnen de Rijksoverheid.

Aantoonbare ervaring met de toepassing van privacywetgeving, waaronder de AVG, binnen grote organisaties met meer dan 1.000 medewerkers.

Aantoonbare ervaring met functionele aansturing van privacyfunctionarissen of privacyadviseurs.

Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen of doorontwikkelen van privacy governance en privacybeleid.

Aantoonbare ervaring met het adviseren van hoger management over privacyvraagstukken.

Pré

Relevante privacycertificering, zoals CIPP/E of CIPM.

Ervaring met het uitvoeren of beoordelen van DPIA's.

Ervaring met het opzetten, vastleggen, inrichten en vervullen van een CPO-functie.

Ervaring met privacygerelateerde audits en onderzoeken.

Ervaring met Privacy by Design binnen organisatieprocessen of digitale producten.

Kennis van en/of ervaring met de EU AI Act en de relatie tussen AI-governance en privacy.

Competenties

Overtuigend en verbindend.

Bestuurlijk en organisatiesensitief.

Analytisch en doortastend.

Integer en onafhankelijk in de oordeelsvorming.

Informatie

Opdrachtduur:  7 maanden met optie verlengen

Locatie:  Den Haag, met werkzaamheden in Utrech

jobs.title: Senior AWS Consultant

Je ontwikkelt cloudstrategieën en vertaalt businessdoelen naar concrete AWS-oplossingen, op basis van een grondige analyse van de bestaande IT-omgeving en het AWS Well-Architected Framework.

Je zorgt dat oplossingen schaalbaar, veilig en toekomstbestendig zijn en blijft na oplevering betrokken bij optimalisatie en doorontwikkeling.

Signaleer je kansen om de samenwerking verder uit te bouwen.

Je analyseert IT-omgevingen, voert Well-Architected Reviews uit en vertaalt businessdoelen naar concrete AWS-strategieën, migratieplannen, roadmaps en toekomstbestendige oplossingen.
