On gère de gros budgets d’investissement publicitaire, et l’entreprise est portée par des équipes talentueuses.  Sur les Social Ads, la créa fait énormément. On cherche la personne qui va alimenter notre pipeline de concepts et qui ne sera jamais à court d’idées.  Ton rôle  Tu es la machine à idées de l’équipe. Tu trouves les concepts et les angles qui font scaler les comptes, tu les fais produire, puis tu analyses ce que ça donne.  Ce poste est  stratégique, pas opérationnel  : tu imagines et tu pilotes, le studio exécute.  Ce que tu fais au quotidien

Tu épluches les ads des concurrents et des top spenders pour dénicher les concepts forts : ce qui tourne, depuis combien de temps, pourquoi ça marche

Tu suis les tendances organiques (TikTok, Reels, formats, codes, sons) et tu les transformes en pubs qui convertissent

Tu es force de proposition en continu : chaque semaine, de nouveaux concepts et de nouveaux angles à tester

Tu alimentes le pipeline pour que les comptes ne tombent jamais en fatigue créative

Tu analyses les résultats des créas que tu as fait pousser : ce qui marche, ce qui flop, et pourquoi

Tu réinjectes ces learnings dans la prochaine vague de concepts

Avec qui tu bosses

Les Performance Managers  : ils pilotent les comptes, te donnent les chiffres et les contraintes, tu leur apportes les idées. Vous construisez ensemble la roadmap de tests et vous vous challengez.

Le studio créa  (designers, monteurs, motion designers) : tu les briefes et tu les supervises pour que ce que tu as dans la tête sorte exactement comme tu l’avais imaginé. Tu valides avant lancement et tu leur fais un retour sur la performance.

Ton profil

Tu es hyper curieux : tu regardes de la pub par réflexe, tu scrolles avec un œil de stratège

Tu as 1000 idées à la minute et tu sais les transformer en brief clair

Tu as de l’expérience sur les créas Social Ads (Meta en priorité, TikTok et Snap en plus)

Tu lis les chiffres (CPL, CPA, ROAS, hook rate, hold rate, CTR) et tu en tires des idées

Tu as le sens du copywriting et de la réponse directe

Tu sais briefer, challenger et donner du feedback

Tu as des exemples concrets de créas que tu as conçues et de leurs résultats

Ce poste n’est pas pour toi si

Tu veux faire du design ou du montage toi-même

Tu attends qu’on te dise quoi chercher

Tu n’as aucune réalisation concrète à montrer

Ce qu’on te propose

100 % télétravail : tu bosses d’où ça te chante

Un vrai impact : tes concepts font scaler des comptes avec de gros budgets

Du terrain de jeu : plusieurs verticales, beaucoup de choses à tester

Une équipe derrière toi : performance managers, studio, automatisation

De l’autonomie pour proposer, tester et structurer le pôle créatif

Une évolution liée à tes résultats

jobs.title: Senior Field Engineer, Data Center Design and Engineering
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's compute runs on a growing global portfolio of data centers built with development partners. As a Senior Field Engineer on the Data Center Design and Engineering team, you will work side by side with developers, general contractors and engineers of record to resolve technical issues on site and speed up construction. You will spend most of your time on active sites, acting as our team's eyes, voice and technical judgment in the field. You will spot problems first, get the right people moving, and stay with each issue until it is closed.

You don't need a data center background. We care more about whether you have delivered complex industrial projects from the field and can get contractors and partners to act when you have no formal authority over them.

What you'll do

Be our engineering presence on site. You will walk installed work against the approved design and build working relationships with developers, general contractors, engineers of record, vendors and commissioning teams. You will hold design acceptance on our team's behalf, deciding whether installed work meets the design. When field conditions and drawings disagree, you will be the first call. You will settle what you can on the spot and bring in the right discipline engineer for the rest. More than 50% of your working time will be at project sites, often with overnight travel across multiple sites. The rest will be remote from your home base.

Get issues closed. You will keep one prioritized list of open engineering issues for your sites, each with an owner and a date. You will follow up in person, challenge dates that don't hold up, and escalate early with a clear recommendation when something is stuck.

Find out why things fail. When equipment, an installation or a test fails, you will gather the evidence, test the first explanation, and trace the failure to its underlying cause. You will confirm that the fix works and check whether other sites carry the same risk.

Clear the path to commissioning and handover. You will check the interfaces between power, cooling, controls and structure before they surface as test failures. You will drive RFIs, deviations and field changes to decisions, so that open engineering questions don't hold up the crews.

Bring the field back into the design. You will turn recurring site problems into changes to our design

jobs.title: Technical Marketing Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Role

Most of what makes Together AI so valuable for customers is invisible from the outside. Optimizing kernels, scheduling, quantization, speculative decoding, and more create an industry-leading platform for inference and post-training at scale. As a technical marketing engineer, you are the conduit between the engineering and research work and the developers who should know about it. You go deep with product, engineering, research, and CX to learn the platform at the level of nuanced technical detail, then decide which details matter to an AI builder and build content that makes them care.

This is a creator role. You are a technical storyteller. You'll produce social-native posts, technical blogs, performance benchmarks, demo and explainer videos, and thought leadership, all aimed at one outcome: building Together’s credibility with developers. You'll also own our technical communities on X, YouTube, Discord, Linkedin and the engagement metrics for developer content company-wide, including amplifying the work of engineers and researchers who publish under their own names.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with product, engineering, DevRel, research, and CX to learn new capabilities in technical depth, then extract the most meaningful aspects for a developer audience.
  • Create the content strategy based on deep understanding of our company’s differentiation and marries that with an understanding of the content that would resonate.
  • Build technical content across formats: blogs, videos, benchmark reports, podcasts, and short-form posts that drive engagement with developers and preference for Together.
  • Monitor real-time news and announcements related to AI infrastructure and lead timely responses working with product and engineering
  • Own Together's presence in technical communities, primarily X, Discord and Youtube. Track engagement metrics, what lands, what doesn't, and adjust.
  • Drive amplification of engineering and research work across social channels.
  • Be the heartbeat of the Together AI technical community - understanding the developers and researchers who follow us and enabling them to be successful
  • Experiment and test new ideas to see what resonates with the community
  • While the role involved mainly online engagement (80%), there is an aspect of translating their deep understanding to deliver highly engaging in-person meet ups and events (20%) in collaboration with Events/ DevRel teams

Requirements

  • 3+ years of product, technical or developer marketing
  • Either hands-on GPU/AI infrastructure experience or a portfolio of in-depth technical content for engineers (links required).
  • Experience creating content for infrastructure or technical systems, not user-facing SaaS applications. You've explained how something works under the hood.

jobs.title: Contracts Manager
jobs.description:
Scale is at the forefront of powering artificial intelligence. We believe that to build exceptional artificial intelligence, you need exceptional human intelligence. Scale operates the largest global platform of knowledge workers that help deliver the human intelligence needed to build artificial intelligence.

Scale is seeking a Contract Manager to support our commercial and public sector teams. In this role, you will help scale (pun intended!) the legal department by working closely with business and legal teams to review, draft, and negotiate agreements. As an essential member of the legal team, you will also help refine workflows, manage processes, and be a critical cross functional partner. We are looking for someone who is excited about developing processes, getting into the weeds in our contract data, and improving efficiency across the legal team.

You will:

  • Develop, maintain, and administer government contracts lifecycle management processes and systems.
  • Negotiate and administer agreements between Scale and our customers, subcontractors, and vendors ensuring adherence to company policies and government regulations.
  • Respond to inquiries from our customers, subcontractors, and vendors.
  • Maintain Scale registration, reporting, and disclosures in government systems such as SAM.gov, PIEE, CPARS, etc.
  • Work closely with public sector legal teams to manage and improve our contracting processes, including contract management systems and contracts signature systems
  • Guide stakeholders in self-serve contracting processes as well as directly negotiate NDAs, task orders, modifications, prime contracts, vendor agreements, and other agreements
  • Partner with cross functional partners to track ongoing obligations post-signature
  • Document fulfillment of contract milestones/deliverables, invoices and cash collection.
  • Support the business and legal team members on legal review for customer questionnaires, security questionnaires, and a variety of other customer-driven requests.
  • Help build and maintain internal processes, resources, and tools to help scale the legal function.

You have:

  • Active Security Clearance or ability/willingness to apply.
  • Experience with a wide array of legal documents and contractual agreements, including NDAs, task orders, modifications, prime contracts, vendor agreements, and other commercial contracts
  • Experience working with contract lifecycle management tools such as Ironclad.
  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • 5+ years of experience as a contracts manager, paralegal, or similar experience
  • Knowledge of the Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR), Defense Federal Acquisition Regulations Supplement (DFARS), and other agency supplements.
  • Knowledge of government contract and subcontract processes including flow downs,

jobs.title: Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Sie haben schon einmal aus SAP-Auszügen und verstreuten Excel-Listen ein Datenmodell gebaut, mit dem ein Fachbereich wirklich arbeitet? Und Sie möchten Business Intelligence jetzt in einem Unternehmen von Anfang an aufbauen und Ihre Handschrift darin hinterlassen?  Über unseren Mandanten  Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis und macht BI und Analytics jetzt zu einem eigenen Thema.  Warum diese Rolle  Sie sind die erste Person, die BI und Analytics im Unternehmen verantwortet. Die Plattform ist gesetzt: Microsoft Fabric und Power BI, mit SAP als wichtigster Datenquelle. Die Datenbasis ist noch lückenhaft, und das Wissen über BI wächst in der Organisation gerade erst. Beides bauen Sie mit auf.

Weil Sie die BI-Landschaft von Anfang an prägen und Ihre Entscheidungen darin Bestand haben.

Weil Sie direkt an die IT-Leitung angebunden sind und Ihre Ergebnisse im ganzen Unternehmen sichtbar werden.

Weil in einer Aufbauphase Ausprobieren dazugehört und eine erfahrene IT-Leitung Ihnen dabei Rückhalt gibt.

Das sind Ihre Aufgaben

Sie bauen die BI-Landschaft auf Microsoft Fabric auf: Datenanbindung, vor allem aus SAP, Lakehouse oder Warehouse sowie Pipelines und Dataflows.

Sie entwickeln zentrale, wiederverwendbare Datenmodelle in Power BI, auf denen weitere Berichte aufsetzen.

Sie erstellen die ersten Basisberichte für die Fachbereiche.

Sie etablieren Report-Governance: Workspaces, zertifizierte Datenmodelle, Namenskonventionen, Berechtigungen und Deployment.

Sie machen Lücken in der Datenqualität sichtbar und bereinigen sie gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen.

Sie nehmen Anforderungen auf, holen die Beteiligten an einen Tisch und setzen Prioritäten.

Sie befähigen die Fachbereiche zu Self-Service mit klaren Leitplanken und zeigen den Kolleginnen und Kollegen, wie man einen Bereich und eine Analyse strukturiert.

Zur Einordnung: Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt auf Analytics und Engineering, also auf Datenanbindung, Datenmodellen, Berichten und Governance. Sie setzen selbst um und klären die Anforderungen direkt mit den Fachbereichen. Data Science und Machine Learning spielen in dieser Aufbauphase eine Nebenrolle.  Das bringen Sie mit

Ein Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung

Fundierte Praxis mit Power BI aus zwei bis drei Jahren oder mehr: Power Query, DAX und Datenmodellierung

Erste Erfahrung mit Microsoft Fabric, etwa mit Lakehouse, Data Factory oder Dataflows Gen2, sowie sicherer Umgang mit SQL

Erfahrung im Auf- oder Ausbau von BI-Lösungen im eigenen Unternehmen, gern auch als einzige Person für das Thema in einem kleineren Haus

Freude daran, mit Fachbereichen Anforderungen zu klären und Wissen weiterzugeben

Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit den internationale

Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

Quantum sensors that see  inside  the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

Act as the technical escalation point for regional service teams and distribution partners, resolving issues that require deeper system expertise.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (AI/Data)
jobs.description:
About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.  Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.

The Role

We're building the Advisory Intelligence Platform: Codat's client intelligence delivered inside the assistant a banker already uses (Microsoft Copilot first). Ask it anything about a client and it answers from the client's real books. Don't ask, and it still tells you what's changed, why it matters and what to do about it. Under it we're building the semantic layer, so every answer uses the same definitions, the signal layer that spots what's changed for a client, and the reasoning layer, a Codat-side LLM that turns those signals into advice. The first bank goes live this year. You'll be building the data and reasoning behind all of it.  This is a hands-on job for software engineers who want to build the systems a model reasons over, not configure a warehouse. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS. The product lives inside the AI assistant our clients already use, and we build it the same way: agents do the repetitive work, engineers do the hard parts. You'll build it and you'll run it. Nobody hands it over the wall once it's live. You'll also get a real say in where it goes next. That means making your case to engineers, product and the commercial team, and bringing them along with you.

What You'll Work On

The semantic layer. Measures, dimensions and definitions the model is allowed to use, so every answer it gives is the same answer. Yours to grow, persona by persona.

The signal layer. Detecting what's changed for a client and surfacing it before the banker asks. You'll be designing and building this.

The reasoning layer. A Codat-side LLM that turns signals into advice. Our calculations are the ground truth it reasons over. You own the calculations the model relies on, and the names, definitions and structure that let it pick the right one.

The agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers behind the assistant. What tools it has, how they're built, how they fail, and the evals that prove they work.

Everything from raw source data to the number the assistant quotes: the pipelines, services and data models, with the testing and observability to prove the number is right and the evals that catch the model quoting the wrong one.

You'll Probably Have

Built production systems from scratch, writing the code yourself rather than configuring managed services. You think about interfaces, failure modes and how the next person will change

jobs.description:
Draag bij aan onze missie  Creating A Climate For Growth  en word de nieuwe Stagiair(e) HR bij Priva! Ben jij enthousiast, leergierig en zelfstandig en op dit moment bezig met een opleiding in de richting van Human Resource Management? Dan zijn wij een match!

Wat ga je doen?

Als HR stagiair(e) bij Priva kom je terecht in een enthousiast HR team, bestaande uit HR Business Partners, Recruiters, HR Officers en een HR Assistant. We zijn een ambitieus team waarin we houden van hard werken, maar waar ook ruimte is voor een geintje of een goed gesprek. Tijdens jouw stage draai je volledig mee in het voorbijkomend HR werk en helpen wij je graag in het ontwikkelen van je competenties en de mogelijke schoolopdrachten. Je kunt hierbij denken aan:

Assisteren bij gegevensinvoer en HR assistenten taken in AFAS

Organiseren en bijhouden van personeelsdossier

Vragen van collega’s verwerken

Ondersteunen bij het organiseren van de onboardingdag

Meelopen met HR-professionals

Ondersteunen bij diverse HR projecten

Wie zijn wij?

Wij zijn Priva! Priva is een familiebedrijf, gevestigd in het Westland. Het is de missie van Priva om een ​​optimale omgeving te creëren waarin zowel planten als mensen kunnen werken, groeien en zich ontwikkelen. Wij bieden wereldwijde oplossingen voor de tuinbouw, gebouwautomatisering en alles daartussenin. Wij zijn toonaangevend in de ontwikkeling en productie van technologie voor het optimaliseren van omgevingsomstandigheden en processen.

Onze ambitie is om bekend te staan ​​als de toonaangevende technologie- en dienstverlener voor duurzame stedelijke delta's. We zijn er trots op dat onze oplossingen resulteren in een lager verbruik van natuurlijke hulpbronnen, zoals energie en water. Om onze missie en ambitie waar te maken, zijn we op zoek naar toegewijde collega's. We zijn er trots op dat we met ruim 500 collega's, in 16 internationale vestigingen verdeeld over 12 landen samen met meer dan 400 internationale installatiepartners werken aan het leveren van onze duurzame oplossingen en diensten in meer dan 100 landen.

Wie ben jij?

Wij zijn opzoek naar een enthousiaste derde- of vierdejaars stagiair die graag ervaring op wilt doen in HR. Bij voorkeur volg je de HBO-opleiding Human Resource Management, maar ook studenten van andere opleidingen waarbij HR een onderdeel is zijn welkom. Je bent proactief, nauwkeurig, communicatief vaardig en betrokken bij het team en je collega’s binnen Priva. Ook vind je het geen probleem om met internationale collega’s in het Engels te communiceren zowel schriftelijk als mondeling. Voor deze stage verwachten we dat je 24 tot 40 uur per week beschikbaar bent.

Wat je krijgt

Een uitdagende stage waarin je jezelf kunt ontwikkelen en waardevolle praktijkervaring opdoet.

Een passende stagevergoeding!

Bedrijfsrestaurant tegen betaalbare prijzen, gratis fruit en lekkere koffie in The Hub.

Een actieve personeelsvereniging & vitaliteitsteam met PrivaFit! workshops waaraan je deel kan nemen.

Als stagiair Marketing & Communicatie met een focus op copywriting schrijf je voor verschillende kanalen, doelgroepen en onderwerpen. Je vertaalt inhoudelijke en technische informatie naar content die helder, relevant en aantrekkelijk is voor de lezer.

Your Future Ecosystem

Located between Rotterdam and The Hague, in the heart of the world’s leading greenhouse region, lies Westland, home to Priva’s modern campus in De Lier. This innovative region has been the foundation of our family-owned company since the 1950s.

jobs.description:
Title: Interaction Designer (Contract)

Bungie is seeking an Interaction Designer to delight millions by designing amazing player interactions within Marathon. You’ll be responsible for producing UX design work on a cross functional team, evolving problems that are complex and ambiguous into clear actionable design solutions. You'll work from concept to completion by collaborating closely with other designers to achieve your goals.

Responsibilities

  • Convert goals and requirements into viable solutions that follow and complement our UX strategy and design principles.
  • Utilize appropriate UX design methodologies to communicate and validate the player experience: player interviews, flow diagrams, playtesting, high-fidelity mockups, and prototypes.
  • Establish and document strategies, guidelines, and patterns.

Required Skills

  • Effective collaborator: You know how to move a design forward with your team and in discussions with stakeholders using proven collaboration methods.
  • User-centered designer: You are a committed believer in putting player needs at the center of the development process. You know how to incorporate both qualitative and quantitative insights into your design process.
  • Visual communicator: You have comprehensive knowledge of graphic design fundamentals like layout, color theory and typography.
  • Process and team driven: You can break experiences down with a team to ship value to our players. You embrace that an effective user experience needs feedback and iteration to achieve.
  • Systematic thinker: Your design process considers moderate-to-large scale solutions that are sustainable over time.
  • Experience working on a cross-functional product team.
  • A portfolio with UX projects.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Degree in Human-Computer Interaction, User Experience, Cognitive Science or equivalent.
  • Experience in games across multiple platforms.
  • Ability to use design software (Figma, Adobe Suite, etc.) to convey designs.
  • Experience with player onboarding systems.

Brixio est partenaire Cloudflare certifié ASDP et fait partie depuis juillet 2026 du groupe Equans (groupe Bouygues), 18,7 Md€ de chiffre d'affaires et environ 85 000 personnes.  L'équipe compte une trentaine d'ingénieurs répartis entre Paris, Dubaï et un centre de production à Casablanca. Les clients sont des grands comptes et des ETI en France, en Europe et au Moyen-Orient, ainsi que les entités du groupe Equans. Il devient la référence opérationnelle Zero Trust de l'équipe France et prend en charge les projets SASE dès son arrivée, notamment le déploiement interne de Cloudflare One chez Brixio et l'accès distant sécurisé aux sites industriels du groupe Equans.  Il travaille avec le Delivery Manager France, qui pilote le planning, le budget et la relation projet, et avec l'architecte principal, référent technique de l'équipe.  Responsabilités

jobs.title: Consultant senior / Manager - Conseil en transformation, organisation et gestion de projet
jobs.description:
Pourquoi ce poste existe maintenant  Ad Valoris change de modèle. Depuis vingt ans, nous aidons des directions générales de Suisse romande, publiques et privées, à voir clair, à décider et à embarquer leurs équipes. Depuis 2025, nous pratiquons le conseil augmenté : l'IA nous sert à comprendre mieux, à aller plus loin, pas seulement à produire plus vite.  Le cabinet est en pleine croissance : de nouvelles directions nous confient leurs enjeux et un deuxième bureau ouvre à Lausanne. Nous cherchons deux personnalités prêtes à rejoindre cette aventure humaine : une équipe dynamique et engagée, au sein de laquelle vous pourrez contribuer au développement du cabinet et tracer votre propre parcours.  Ce que vous ferez  Vous rejoignez le cabinet comme consultant-e senior ou manager, selon votre expérience. Sur un mandat, vous pouvez assumer plusieurs responsabilités ; en particulier, vous concevez la démarche de chaque mandat, vous vous assurez qu'elle répond au vrai problème du client et vous gérez la relation avec lui tout au long de la mission.

Comprendre avant de proposer. Lire la situation du client, ses acteurs et ses non-dits, avant d'arriver en séance.

Résoudre le bon problème. Remettre en cause la commande quand elle ne vise pas le vrai sujet, et défendre une recommandation engagée.

Co-construire et faire avancer. Apporter tôt une première version, la faire travailler par le client jusqu'à ce qu'il en soit co-auteur, et animer seul-e des séances, y compris sur des sujets complexes, dans des environnements exigeants et avec des parties prenantes aux sensibilités diverses.

Créer de la valeur pour le client. Mieux comprendre, aller plus loin dans l'analyse et concrétiser : ce qui compte, ce sont les progrès durables que le client constate dans son organisation.

Faire grandir le cabinet. Transmettre, challenger et accepter de l'être.

Deux points d'entrée, selon votre expérience :

Manager (dès 10 ans d'expérience). Architecte de mission dès votre arrivée : vous cadrez et pilotez des mandats de bout en bout, et vous encadrez un ou deux consultants en continuant à produire. Vous prenez part à la conduite du cabinet : méthodes, recrutement, capitalisation. Trajectoire explicite vers un rôle où vous portez le résultat et la croissance de plusieurs comptes.

Consultant-e senior (dès 5 ans d'expérience). Autonome sur un périmètre cadré, vous menez vos entretiens et ateliers seul-e ou en équipe, et vous êtes une référence en conseil augmenté. Trajectoire explicite vers le rôle d'architecte de mission.

Le conseil augmenté, tel que nous le pratiquons  Le conseil augmenté, ce n'est pas utiliser l'IA pour produire plus vite. C'est l'utiliser pour comprendre mieux, sans jamais laisser la production avancer plus vite que la compréhension. Le test est simple : qu'avez-vous fait du temps que l'IA a libéré ? Plus de livrables, c'est de la sous-traitance à une machine. Plus de présence chez le client et plus de profondeur d'analyse, c'est du conseil augmenté

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager | Sweden | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs  is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

We’re looking for an enthusiastic, tech-forward product marketer to grow our Observability products by boldly positioning them and running campaigns to attract, convert and retain customers. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will be in charge of the messaging and positioning for a broad product area. Product Marketing lives within the Product org rather than the Marketing org at Grafana Labs, and we think differently about the job. Rather than purely executing launches or campaigns, we want PMMs to teach product managers and engineers in our org how to think about growth and demand, and to codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone in the organization can use. For example, we all contribute product information to a shared knowledge base, which we use to generate enablement materials and decks.

Grafana Labs is a fast-paced and growing organization. As such, this role requires strategic skills, an interest in teaching, and hands-on tactical execution (blogs, webinar outlines, video scripts, etc). Our team is full of people who crave impact and independence - if you are seeking a role with narrow scope where you run a defined playbook, this is not the job for you.

What You'll Be Doing:

Actively partner with and teach product managers to define product value, messaging, and go-to-market strategy, from competitive positioning to sales enablement collateral.

jobs.description:
Hi there! We are  Testlio , a global software testing company with its own freelance network. Our freelancers test apps from companies across the globe. Testlio is a great place for people who value the freedom and flexibility of remote work.

At the moment, we are looking for freelance software testers based in  Germany  &  the Netherlands  to participate in a moderated Usability study for one of our clients, a global financial technology company. More specifically, you will be a great fit for this study if you  regularly send money to India and have experience using money transfer apps to send funds to India/ Indian Bank accounts . We're very interested in hearing your feedback, as this will help our client improve their own app, further impacting thousands of global customers.

Benefits of being a freelancer at Testlio

Schedule: You can create your schedule and work on other testing runs that interest you.

Location: Testlio is a 100% remote company. Seriously, you can work from the coffee shop, your home, or while waiting for class.

Growth: You’ll be testing global-scale mobile apps and have the chance to boost your skills and grow your career.

Payment: You are paid by the hour, not by the bug. This means you get paid even if you did not uncover any bugs.

Requirements

Age: You have to be at least 18 years old.

Location: Must be physically located in  Germany  or  the Netherlands. The use of a VPN is prohibited.

Language: Must at least be comfortable speaking  English . Some knowledge of German and Dutch is also ideal.

Availability:  1.5 hours  needed for the study.

Devices: Laptop/ PC + iPhone/ Android Phone.

Experience: Digitally sending money to people in India/Indian bank accounts.

App Usage: Have never used the Wise app before.

What does testing look like?

Type of testing: Moderated Usability study.

Type of work: One time study. This is not a recurring project.

Type of test: You will meet 1:1 with a Testlio UX Researcher at a specified time for a live remote video call with your  camera on  and share your  device's screen to complete your testing .
Task Description: During the live testing session, you will be asked about how you currently send money from your country to India, including the services and methods you typically use. Then, you will make a real money transfer of about $20 using the application we are testing and share your thoughts and feedback as you go. We are interested in understanding what feels clear or unclear, what you expect throughout the experience, and your overall impressions.

About the Money Transfer: The $20 you will send will during the test will be to one of our trusted Test Leads. They will send the money back to you within ~1 business day to your paypal account.
Recording: Please note we will be recording this live testing session for research and analysis purposes. We will redact any sensitive PII information.

Pay rate: $100 USD.

Payment: Payment will be made via PayPal or Payoneer.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Product Catalogs
jobs.description:
Reddit  is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit  www.redditinc.com .

This role is open to candidates based in the UK or the Netherlands.

Our ads team is developing Dynamic Product Ads, enabling us to match users to specific advertiser products. Our vision is for Reddit’s product ads to be highly relevant and contextual. A user browsing r/golf sees ads for popular golf clubs. A user reading a thread on r/buyitforlife about sunglasses sees ads for the exact models being discussed, just a few clicks away from a purchase. To achieve this vision, we need a highly scalable catalog infrastructure and intuitive user experience to onboard thousands of advertisers and ingest millions of products into our systems.

As the Engineering Manager for the Product Catalogs team at Reddit, you will lead the full stack team responsible for our entire advertiser-facing experience. You will build UIs, APIs, and backend systems that manage advertiser’s products. The team also works closely with the knowledge graph teams to power organic shopping. This role combines technical expertise, leadership abilities, and drive to understand and deliver on customer needs.

Responsibilities:

Create a world class catalogs system that can scale to support billions of products

Work closely with product managers and designers to craft compelling user experiences

Collaborate with a wide range of teams from Ad Formats to Ad Delivery to ensure successful end-to-end delivery of product ads

Du bist Hauptansprechperson für unsere Kunden, meist Leitungen aus HR oder Learning & Development, sowie für die Coachees selbst.

Du verantwortest die Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung unserer Coaching-Programme.

Du bereitest regelmäßige Kundentermine mit Datenanalysen und Präsentationen vor, führst sie durch und stellst die Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden sicher.

Du treibst strategische und operative Sales-Aktivitäten bei Bestandskunden voran und entwickelst die Accounts zu ihrem vollen Potenzial.

Du bringst eigene Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Produkts ein und wächst gemeinsam mit uns in einem spannenden Markt.

Dein Profil

Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der BWL, Psychologie, Kommunikation oder einer vergleichbaren Richtung.

Idealerweise erste Berufserfahrung im Account Management, Partnermanagement, Recruiting, Service, Community Management oder im direkten Kundenkontakt.

Einen offenen, positiven und beziehungsorientierten Kommunikationsstil, mit dem Du überzeugst.

Geschick im Aufbau von Beziehungen und die Fähigkeit, auch schwierige Gespräche mit Klarheit und Wertschätzung zu führen.

Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Daten fundierte Entscheidungen ermöglichen.

Eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, mit der Du mühelos mehrere Bälle in der Luft hältst.

Begeisterung für Coaching und Startups, eine eigene Coaching-Ausbildung ist ein Bonus.

Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

Vorteile

Eine attraktive, leistungsgerechte Vergütung.

Eine steile Lernkurve, viel Verantwortung und aktive Mitgestaltung eines wachsenden Unternehmens.

Persönliches 1:1-Coaching durch unsere Top Executive Coaches.

Ein schönes Office im Herzen von Berlin (alternativ hybrid) und ein dynamisches Team mit tollen Kolleginnen und Kollegen.

Alle klassischen „Startup-Perks“ wie frisches Obst, Snacks, Getränke, guter Kaffee & Teamevents.

Sparrks steht für Chancengleichheit, deshalb freuen wir uns über Deine Bewerbung, unabhängig von Deinem ethnischen Hintergrund, Geschlecht oder Deiner sexuellen Orientierung.

Deine ersten Monate bei Sparrks  Du übernimmst von Anfang an viel Verantwortung und eigene Kundenaccounts und arbeitest direkt mit den beiden Gründern und unserem Customer-Success-Team zusammen. Du lernst unsere Kunden, Coaches und Programme kennen und wirst schnell zur festen Ansprechperson für Deine Accounts. Bewirb Dich auch dann, wenn Dein Profil nicht alle Anforderungen zu einhundert Prozent erfüll

    • Use customer research, website data and market insight to identify friction and opportunities
    • Ensure the core website, event pages and email experiences work together where they form part of the same journey.

    Narrative, copy and content quality

jobs.description:
About the job

Explore how a next-generation AI architecture behaves from rack scale to data centre scale.

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will investigate a novel AI computing architecture under demanding real-world workloads. You will work on problems where answers aren't readily known, turning curiosity into measurable evidence.

You will design experiments, benchmark representative AI workloads and explore how hardware components and software interact at scale. When behaviour is unexpected, you will turn this into new measurements.

Your work will help infrastructure engineers, architects and application specialists understand system behaviour, performance, scalability and reliability across the stack. You will also help develop tooling and automation to collect, analyse and visualise system metrics.

You do not need to be an AI expert. You will need strong judgement, curiosity and a clear preference for evidence over opinion. You will love this role if you are someone who takes initiative, questions assumptions and enjoys working in areas where the answers are not yet known.

The team and culture

The System QA team is distributed across multiple locations. We work hard to stay connected and collaborate closely. Our daily team meetings feel more like a virtual coffee break than a formal status update with space to share ideas, ask questions, discuss discoveries and solve problems together.

We value trust, autonomy and openness, and we understand that great engineers don't all follow the same career path. What matters is the quality of your work, your curiosity, and your willingness to explore challenging problems.

You will have regular 1:1s with your people manager where you will have the opportunity to discuss things that matter to you. You will have dedicated time each week to focus on your CPD. The technical lead will provide direction and help set priorities, but everyone in the team is there to support each other.

One of our core principles is that we measure and report what we observe without trying to make results look better or worse than they are.

  • Confidence to work independently, take responsibility and collaborate across engineering teams.
  • Experience in some of the following would be valuable: AI workloads and benchmarking, systems architecture, parallel and distributed computing, automation, containers or modern orchestration infrastructure

As Director of System Software, you will report to the VP of Software and turn software strategy into clear priorities, plans and outcomes. jobs.title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
500M+ downloads. 80M+ monthly users. A decade of building – and we’re still accelerating.

Flo is the world’s #1 health & fitness app worldwide on a mission to build a better future for female health. Backed by a $200M investment led by General Atlantic, we became the first product of our kind to reach a $1B valuation in 2024 – and we’re not slowing down.

With 7M paid subscribers and the highest-rated experience in the App Store’s health category, we’ve spent 10 years earning trust at scale. Now, we’re building the next generation of digital health – AI-powered, privacy-first, clinically backed – to help our users know their body better.

The job

Principal Infrastructure Engineer

More than 80 million women open Flo every month to understand their bodies and their health. Every one of those sessions runs on infrastructure we build, and the data behind it is as personal as data gets. Keeping that fast and private at this scale is the job.

Velocity runs the platform that every Flo engineer builds on: Kubernetes on AWS, the data stores behind our services, and the golden paths that let product teams ship without needing to be infrastructure experts. We treat our internal developers as our customers. You will:

  • Own the foundations: Design and run the Kubernetes and data infrastructure behind 80 million monthly active users, and make it boring in the best sense.
  • Turn expertise into self-service: Take what you know about running clusters and databases well, and build it into the defaults so product teams get it for free.

What You Will Do

  • Kubernetes at scale: Architect and evolve our EKS estate: cluster lifecycle and upgrades, networking, autoscaling, workload isolation, and the Helm and Terraform that deploy onto it.
  • Data infrastructure: Shape how our services use PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and Kafka. Set the patterns for provisioning, access, backup, failover and capacity, so teams aren't solving these problems one service at a time.
  • Golden paths: Build self-service tooling and Terraform modules that give product teams autonomy without sacrificing stability or security.
  • Reliability: Lead resilience work, including business continuity planning, disaster recovery testing and a sustainable on-call rotation.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We're hiring a  Head of Engineering  to lead engineering for one of our product tribes. You'll manage 15 to 20 engineers directly, with tech leads in each squad owning technical direction but no management layer between you and the team. You report to the CTO and sit in a tribe leadership trio with the Product Tribe Lead and Design Lead. Which tribe you'd lead is something we'll work out with you during the process.  This is a people leadership role with a hard technical requirement. The engineers report to you, so hiring, development, performance and pace are yours. At the same time you have to hold your own on system architecture: challenge estimates from your engineers, spar with the Product Tribe Lead on solutions, and know when a design is wrong before it ships. This role needs both.

How we're set up

Tribes are the organisational body: people management, capacity, planning and reporting live there. Squads are assigned to problem spaces and run discovery and delivery, each led by a trio of Tech Lead, Product Manager and Product Designer. Tech Leads own the technical decisions in their squad, including estimates, and write code alongside their engineers. They don't manage people. You do.  We keep the structure deliberately flat. Management is anchored at tribe level, squad composition flexes to serve the most important work, and structure changes as we learn (roughly every six months in practice, not on a schedule). Discovery and delivery run in parallel: the next mission is scoped before engineers finish the current one, so engineers weigh in on architecture early and have the context to unblock themselves.

What you'll own

Feasibility and delivery for the tribe.  You're accountable for tribe-wide delivery outcomes and velocity: the right problems, solved at the right quality, as fast as possible.

The people.  15 to 20 direct reports. Hiring, onboarding, expectations, feedback, development, compensation and promotion recommendations, and the tough calls that keep talent density high. Tech Leads feed you performance signals; the decisions and the conversations are yours.

Technical judgement across squads.  Broad understanding of the tribe's systems and how they fit into the wider Moss architecture. You challenge estimates and technical proposals from your engineers; you don't produce the estimates yourself.

A seat in the tribe trio.  Roadmap and planning input through a feasibility lens. You argue solutions and trade-offs with the Product Tribe Lead as a technical peer, and push back on scope and timelines when the engineering picture says so.

jobs.description:
We are an AI company operating at the cutting edge of the industry, growing quickly in a fast-moving environment. As we scale and prepare for a future IPO, we are building our Procurement function from the ground up. This is our first Procurement Analyst role in the company, so you will help define how we buy, not just execute it. Your passion for Procurement will help build and run our source-to-pay processes with strong internal controls, clear segregation of duties between procurement and payment, and audit-ready documentation. This is a global role: you will support stakeholders and suppliers across regions and work closely with the rest of the Procure to Pay (P2P) and Finance teams.

Key Responsibilities

Procurement operations

  • Manage the end-to-end purchasing operations across all spend categories (software, cloud, professional services, hardware, facilities, and more), from requisition intake and PO issuance in Zip / Coupa.
  • Review purchase requests for completeness, budget and policy compliance before approval.
  • Issue and track purchase orders, and follow up with suppliers on delivery, pricing, and service levels.
  • Support RFQ/RFP processes: gather requirements, solicit/compare bids, and document selection rationale. Support negotiations and renewals in partnership with Legal and business owners.
  • Support requesters across time zones and regions, handling multi-currency and cross-border purchasing needs.

Controls and audit readiness

  • Help design and implement procurement policies, approval matrices (delegation of authority), and procedures aligned with IPO and audit requirements.
  • Enforce segregation of duties between procurement (requisition, sourcing, PO creation, vendor selection) and payment (invoice processing, payment execution), in coordination with Accounts Payable and Finance.
  • Maintain complete, organized documentation for every purchase (quotes, approvals, contracts, POs) so it is available for internal and external audits.

  • Support internal and external audit requests and help remediate findings.

Vendor management

  • Maintain accurate vendor master data and a centralized vendor and contract repository.
  • Run supplier onboarding, including due diligence, documentation, tax compliance validation, and conflict-of-interest checks for domestic and international suppliers.
  • Track supplier performance and support periodic vendor reviews using AI and other tools.

Analysis and reporting

  • Use AI to analyze spend data across categories and regions to identify savings opportunities, consolidation potential, and compliance gaps.
  • Build regular reports and KPIs, such as spend under management, PO compliance, cycle times,

jobs.title: Senior Counsel (Regulatory)
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

LEGAL

What We Do

Epic's multi-specialized team of attorneys and legal professionals partner across our organization to provide legal solutions as well as consult and inform on the products we build and games we develop.

What You'll Do

Epic’s regulatory team advises the company on newly enacted laws and regulations around the world as well as works alongside our Public Policy Team to monitor regulatory developments. Partnering closely with our subject matter experts, Product Counsel and Compliance Team, you will manage the design of compliance programs and educate counsel regarding regulatory requirements. You will also assist with the company’s response to regulatory investigations and requests for information from regulators.

In this role, you will

  • Advise Epic senior management, Product Counsel, the Compliance Team and Legal leadership on key global laws and regulations, including online safety frameworks
  • Lead multi-stakeholder regulatory compliance strategies
  • Provide legal analysis of legislative and regulatory drafts to the Public Policy team
  • Support advocacy and engagement with regulators and trade associations
  • Respond to global regulatory inquiries and investigations

What we're looking for

  • A qualified attorney with at least 8 years of experience working in regulatory compliance, either within a regulatory body, in-house or at a law firm
  • Experience handling regulatory enforcement actions brought by regulatory bodies
  • Prior work and/or substantial knowledge of the tech industry; A good working knowledge of tech or videogames is an advantage
  • An individual who is comfortable working in a multi-stakeholder environment, navigating complex issues, driving high-risk/impact projects, and working and making sound judgments and decisions in ambiguous situations where clear guidance is lacking or may not exist
  • Must be able to work proactively, independently, and reliably under tight timeframes in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively with a broad range of individuals and teams

This role is open to multiple locations across the US (including CA, NYC, & WA).

Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive.

jobs.title: Anthropic Research Resident
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The Anthropic Residency is our paid, fixed-term research program, with placements lasting between six weeks and six months. We are looking for people who have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields and want to transition to full-time work focused on making sure AI systems are safe and beneficial for all of humanity. If you are a professor in a quantitative discipline, a technical founder or a staff-level engineer and want to transition to work on transformative AI, we want to hear from you. Background in machine learning is not required.

What to expect

  • A concrete, scoped project matched to your background, with direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers
  • Access to Claude models and GPU compute
  • Connection to the broader AI safety and security research community

Interview process

The interview process will include an initial application, recruiter screen, technical assessment, research discussion and a reference check.

Applications for this round close on November 22, 2026 (11:59 PM PT). We expect to make offers in January 2027.

You may be a good fit if you

  • Are motivated by making sure AI is safe and beneficial for society as a whole
  • Are excited to transition into working on empirical AI research full-time
  • Have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields (professor in a quantitative discipline, a technical founder or a staff-level engineer)
  • Thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments
  • Can implement ideas quickly and communicate clearly

Strong candidates may also

  • Have experience authoring research papers in machine learning, NLP, or AI safety
  • Have experience with LLMs, reinforcement learning or Kubernetes clusters and complex shared codebases

Mentors and research areas

Potential Anthropic mentors include:

  • Sara Price: leads the Alignment Training team; background in data science
  • Ethan Perez: leads the Alignment Science team; background in machine learning
  • Evan Hubinger: leads the Alignment Stress-Testing team; formerly at The Machine Intelligence Research Institute (MIRI)

jobs.description:
Location(s):  US (remote), Boston (hybrid), or New York (hybrid) -  EST preferred

Toast  is expanding into the B2C market and is looking for a Brand Experience Designer to define and build the consumer-facing brand that millions of diners will come to know. This role is critical for turning a fledgling brand into one that feels distinct, trusted, and alive at every touchpoint, across product and marketing. The Brand Experience Designer will shape how the Consumer brand looks, sounds, and behaves end to end, setting the standard for how Toast shows up to guests and giving the product and growth teams a shared identity to build on.

Toast is investing in becoming a consumer innovator. We’re using our restaurant and guest data to make dining feel personal and frictionless, and with AI in the mix, we want discovery, booking, and dining to feel genuinely memorable. Our Toast Local app is only one surface. We’re adding social features, exclusive deals, and new ways to reserve and pay. A brand that guests recognize and love is how that experience becomes more than a set of features.

About the team

You’d join a small, ambitious Consumer Design team that feels and operates like a startup within a larger company. We have autonomy and the runway to reimagine dining, and we all love to roll our sleeves up and jam together. You’ll report to the Consumer Product Design leader and work shoulder to shoulder with product designers, product managers, engineers, and our marketing and growth partners.

The competition is fierce. We’re up against established brands consumers already recognize. We’re building so that consumers and restaurants thrive and form deep relationships that keep dining a core, sustainable business in our communities. With a brand still finding its shape and a nimble, driven team raring to go, this role is where the brand gets its voice.

The Consumer brand is a sibling to the Toast Core brand, not a sub-brand of it. We honor what makes Toast trusted by restaurants, and we give guests something that feels made for them. What’s shared and what’s distinct is still being decided, and this role helps decide it. If you want a brief with every answer already in it, this isn’t that role. If you want to shape the answers, it is.

We’re looking for a Brand Experience Designer with a proven track record of building consumer brands that people recognize, remember, and feel something about. You’ll be at the heart of our consumer push, defining how Toast shows up to millions of diners and making sure every touchpoint, from a push notification to a receipt, feels like it came from the same place. You’re the type of designer who loves to lead the way but feels there’s nothing too small to dive into.

Discord's Enterprise Technology org is building a software engineering discipline from the ground up, and this is the founding engineering hire. There is no Enterprise Platform team yet. You will not be maintaining a status quo or joining an existing backlog: you will define the discipline, set the technical foundation, and build the platform that lets the internal systems enabling Discordians scale with the company.

Discord's mission is to cultivate belonging, and doing that at scale requires internal systems that move as fast as the product itself. The mission of this role is to turn our enterprise infrastructure into self-service software. Your job is to replace manual consoles and tickets with a platform of reusable primitives, building blocks like "provision a device" or "push an IAM policy or app integration through code," exposed through clean APIs and self-service portals. As a code-forward Staff engineer, you will design abstractions that hide the messy reality of Okta, Jamf, and Terraform (our identity, device management, and infrastructure-as-code tools) behind interfaces people actually want to use, operating with a platform-as-a-product mindset.

Manage the device fleet as code: Move device configuration off consoles and into versioned, API-driven infrastructure for endpoint management and hardware provisioning.

Automate the identity layer: Manage identity systems and their connections to downstream apps as code, from SSO and SCIM integrations to account workflows, so changes ship through version control and CI/CD instead of an admin console.

Own app delivery and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Build deployment pipelines and provisioning patterns that let internal systems be built and changed safely, establishing CI/CD standards.

Build the self-service layer: Design and ship the APIs, CLIs, and portals that compose primitives into paved paths, like a new hire's first day, where software access and group memberships land in one automated, auditable flow.

Set the foundation: Define the technical direction and architecture for the discipline, writing the RFCs and documentation that future hires will build on.

6+ years building and operating production software and systems at a technology company, with a track record of owning ambiguous projects end to end.

Strong software engineering fundamentals. You write production code (we lean on Python, TypeScript and Rust), and design, test, and ship it. This is not a systems admin role.

Deep, hands-on IAM experience (SSO, SCIM, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC) and fluency with infrastructure as code

jobs.description:
About Nexoya  We help marketing teams unlock their growth potential with AI. Our attribution shows how advertising investments perform across channels, and our optimizations shift budgets to where they drive the bottom line. Leading European brands in e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance, energy and more rely on us.  The role  You build and run the Node.js/TypeScript services behind the Nexoya app: the GraphQL API, ad channel integrations and data ingestion, and new LLM- and agent-based features. You join a team of about 10 engineers across backend, ML, frontend and platform, and you own your features from design to production.  How we build software  AI coding agents change how software gets built, but not who is responsible for it.

Decisions are made together.  Important technical decisions start as an Architecture Decision Record reviewed by the team. Good arguments win, not seniority.

Engineers design, agents implement.  Your design is the input for our coding agents, guided by a shared rule set in our agent harness that the team evolves together.

Working is not done.  Code is ready when it is maintainable: readable, tested, robust on unhappy paths. Larger changes are reviewed, so at least two engineers know every change.

You build it, you run it.  A rotating internal support duty shows us which decisions worked.

What you will do

Ship backend features end to end on our Kubernetes-based Azure cloud.

Evolve our GraphQL API with clear schemas and stable contracts.

Build reliable ad channel integrations and data ingestion with MySQL and RabbitMQ.

Build AI features such as our in-app assistant (tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs), with evaluation, monitoring and guardrails.

Help evolve our agent harness and raise the bar for tests, reviews and documentation.

What you bring

[3+] years as a Backend Engineer with Node.js and TypeScript.

Solid API design (GraphQL or REST) and MySQL experience.

Experience with message brokers and running services on Docker, Kubernetes and a major cloud (Azure preferred).

You enjoy discussing design trade-offs in writing and care about code others can maintain.

Fluent English.

Direct impact on how enterprise marketers allocate their budgets.

Real ownership in a team that takes engineering quality seriously.

A genuine AI-first culture: experiment, automate, share.

A transparent culture at eye level, with regular team events.

Strategy Days twice a year where the whole team shapes company strategy (past: Helsinki, Berlin, Belgrade, Swiss Alps, Zurich).

Profile review and phone screen

Take-home assignment: a backend feature

Technical discussion with the engineering team

[On-site] interview and team evaluation

jobs.description:
The Role

The UK is making a wholesale shift to AI: government, from the AI Opportunities Action Plan through to the tools the Incubator for AI is putting in front of civil servants, and enterprises racing to put AI to work. Scale wants to play a foundational role in building the reliable AI applications both will run on. Our work spans building custom AI applications that reach millions of users, generating high-quality training data for custom LLMs, and providing upskilling and AI advisory services. We're building our UK business from a standing start, and we need someone with a lot of energy to help it move.

As a Strategist, you'll help grow Scale's UK business, partnering with technical stakeholders to identify and win opportunities across public sector (central government and defence & security) and enterprise. Public sector is the main focus, but we're a small UK team and you'll flex onto enterprise opportunities where they matter. You'll sit at the centre of our go-to-market effort, combining business development groundwork with the bids and tender work that turns an opportunity into a contract. You'll work in a dynamic and often unstructured environment, and you'll learn how big AI programmes get sold and delivered into government and large organisations, working right next to the people doing it.

jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist, Lead Generation
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato  is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including  FinanceBuzz ,  All About Cookies , and  OnlyInYourState . We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at  Launch Potato .

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier

Launch Potato  is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including  FinanceBuzz ,  All About Cookies , and  OnlyInYourState . We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Agentic Search) – Web Rendering (Chromium)
jobs.description:
About  Nebius :

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible. We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work on the rendering infrastructure of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.

In this role, you will focus on loading modern web pages in a browser that we patch and build ourselves, so that content is rendered completely and reliably at a cost that works across billions of pages. You will work inside Chromium to remove what we do not need, make the rest faster and cheaper, and keep our build current as Chromium moves. Your work ensures that high-quality content is consistently available to the indexing and retrieval systems downstream.

In this position, your responsibility will be to

Change Chromium in its heavy core (Blink, the V8 integration, the compositor, the network service) to cut CPU, memory and startup cost per page

Strip Chromium down for agent workloads: skip what nobody needs, such as image and media decoding, web font downloads, and rasterization and GPU work where no one needs pixels, while keeping what page scripts depend on to run correctly (style, layout, animation frames, observers), and work out what breaks, or renders differently, when you do

Keep the browser compatible with the web: make sure that what we remove does not change how the sites we load behave or render

Profile and tune fleets of browsers: the process model, memory per renderer, startup, isolation and crash handling

Build the production system around it: how browsers are launched, pooled, recycled and monitored

You may be a good fit if you

Have 5+ years of experience building production systems, and are an expert in several of the following areas.

Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living  our values  and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to join our Connectivity team to collaboratively architect, design and develop lower-level functionality for the Oura iOS app. This team works closely together with the Firmware and App Feature teams in the very essential interface between hardware and software. The responsibilities of the Connectivity team include - but are not limited to - developing our Bluetooth layer to enable efficient and secure communication between Oura ring and application along with implementing support for next generation products and maintaining the app-ring connectivity between millions of devices on the field. We care deeply about maintaining and upgrading our code base so that it is at the forefront of technology, and actively work to get rid of legacy implementations.

What You will do:

Architect, design and build new features in the Connectivity team

Collaborate closely with our Firmware and Platform teams

Ensure consistency across our apps

Keep an eye on where iOS development is going and actively prototype and try out new frameworks and ways of working that improve our productivity

Work with us to develop systems to ensure we provide performant, maintainable apps and improve the developer experience as we scale

We would love to have You on our team, if You have:

5+ years of professional development experience shipping iOS apps.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, QA Engineering & Automation
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior QA Manager, Automation & Tooling to join our team supporting a soon-to-be-announced AAA mobile game title. This role can be remote in the US and Canada, or hybrid in Culver City.

You will lead the automation strategy for a live game, building the people, processes, frameworks, and tooling required to scale quality across frequent releases and a large, active player base. You will partner closely with Engineering, QA, Live Operations, and other disciplines to establish a development culture where automation is a shared responsibility and a core component of product quality.

At Scopely, we create and operate games played by millions of people around the world. This role is an opportunity to shape how quality engineering evolves from the ground up for a high-scale live mobile game.

What You Will Do

  • Define and execute the QA automation strategy for a live mobile game, including scalable frameworks, tooling, standards, and quality gates.
  • Build and lead an automation team from the ground up, including hiring, team structure, processes, mentorship, and career development.
  • Design, build, and implement automated testing across UI, API, integration, regression, end-to-end, mobile, and live-operations workflows.
  • Evaluate automation approaches, frameworks, platforms, and traditional or AI-assisted tools based on coverage, maintainability, speed, and value.
  • Establish automation standards, coding practices, test architecture, reporting, observability, and quality gates that can scale with the game and organization.
  • Partner with Engineering and QA to prioritize automation, improve testability, integrate testing into CI/CD, and establish shared ownership of automated tests, ensuring automation is part of the definition of done for every feature.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership through framework design, prototypes, code reviews, automation implementation, and test-script development.
  • Mentor manual testers as they develop coding and automation skills, while defining metrics for coverage, stability, flakiness, execution time, and defect detection.
  • Communicate quality risks, automation progress, and investment needs while partnering with Product, Live Operations, Marketing, Customer Support, Localization, and external development teams.
  • Champion quality and release excellence across the organization while ensuring automation supports—not replaces—strong exploratory and risk-based testing.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience in QA, test automation, or quality engineering, including 4+ years leading or building automation teams.
  • Proven experience creating automation strategies, frameworks, tooling, and infrastructure for complex products, ideally from the ground up.
  • Experience evaluating automation app

jobs.title: Principal Program Manager, Strategy & Operations (12 Month Contract)
jobs.description:
Remote Broadcast Centers - Principal Program Manager, Global Broadcast Strategy & Operations

Riot Games is looking for a Principal Program Manager to lead strategic, high-impact initiatives across our RBC global broadcast and remote production capabilities. This is a 12-month contract based in Dublin, supporting leadership in both the Dublin and Seattle Remote Broadcast Centers (RBCs).

You will work closely with RBC Leadership to solve complex business challenges, develop long-term plans, and help improve how our global production network operates.

This is a senior individual contributor role where you will help set priorities, bring teams together, and turn strategy into action, this role will be based onsite in the Remote Broadcast Center (RBC) in Swords, Dublin, Ireland.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead strategic programs and initiatives from initial planning through implementation, ensuring clear priorities, ownership, and measurable outcomes.
  • Develop business and financial models to help leaders assess opportunities, investment decisions, capacity needs, and long-term plans.
  • Shape the future of Riot’s broadcast capabilities, partnering across production, technology, finance, facilities, and other teams to improve operating models and ways of working.
  • Lead capacity and resource planning across the Remote Broadcast Center network, connecting demand with staffing, facilities, technology, cost, and service needs.
  • Partner with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to solve complex business challenges, provide clear recommendations, and drive strategic change across the organization.

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of relevant experience, including 6+ years in strategy, business operations, financial planning, transformation, management consulting, or a related field.
  • Experience leading strategic work across multiple regions or teams, turning business priorities into clear plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong strategic planning and analytical skills, with experience developing business cases, financial models, forecasts, scenarios, or strategic roadmaps.
  • Proven ability to work through ambiguity, defining problems, identifying stakeholders, and creating a clear path forward.
  • Experience partnering with and influencing senior leaders, including presenting recommendations and driving decisions without direct authority.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience working across global, distributed, and cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in global broadcast production, live production, media, entertainment, advertising, digital consumer businesses, technology, facilities, infrastructure, consulting, or another

jobs.title: [KRAFTON JUNGLE] 정글 과정 마케팅 실행 및 운영 지원 (3~5년 / 계약직)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

  • 크래프톤은 2022년부터 사회 공헌 사업의 일환으로 ‘크래프톤 정글’을 출범하여 기술 산업의 미래 인재, SW 개발자를 양성해오고 있습니다.
  • 크래프톤 정글은 경기도 용인에 위치한 크래프톤 정글 캠퍼스에서, 자기 주도적 학습과 몰입 경험, 팀 기반의 프로젝트 수행을 바탕으로 기본기가 탄탄한 개발자로 성장하게 하는 교육 과정을 운영하고 있습니다.
  • Jungle Operations & Outreach Team은 정글의 사업을 관리하며, 정글 브랜드 관리, 교육생 모집을 위한 마케팅 캠페인 실행, 지원 및 선발 절차, 교육 과정의 주요 행사, 교육생 지원과 같은 크래프톤 정글의 전반적인 사업과 운영을 담당합니다.
  • 정글의 지속 성장을 위하여 더 효과적인 마케팅 운영안을 설계/실행하고, 팀과 협업하여 정글을 성장시키는 여정에 참여하고 싶은 분을 기다립니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

Jungle Operations & Outreach Team은 동료를 존중하는 태도와 끈기 있고 성숙한 사고, 긍정적인 에너지를 바탕으로 팀의 방향성에 맞추어 적극적으로 협력하는 팀 플레이어를 찾고 있습니다.

  • [주요 역할]
    • 정글 교육 과정의 성과 극대화를 위하여 효과적인 캠페인 전략을 기획/실행하며, 타 사례와 정글의 캠페인 결과를 분석하고, 더 효과적인 실행 방안을 도출합니다.
    • 캠페인 정성/정량 데이터를 수집하고, 데이터 기반의 성과 분석 프로세스 및 대시보드 구축을 실행합니다.
    • 교육생 모집 선발, 학사운영 및 입소식, 수료식, 발표회 등 주요 교육 행사와 프로그램의 준비 및 실행, 운영을 지원합니다.
    • 교육과정이 원활하게 운영될 수 있도록 기타 운영 업무 전반을 지원합니다.
  • 이 직무를 통해 이런 경험을 할 수 있습니다.
    • 교육 사업 기반의 캠페인 설계 및 실행, 교육 사업 분야에 대한 전문적 인사이트와 업무 경력을 축적할 수 있습니다.
    • 교육 사업의 브랜드 관리와 마케팅 실행, 사업 및 학사 운영을 아우르는 통합적인 브랜드 육성 경험을 쌓을 수 있습니다.

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 기업(교육, 서비스, IT 계열) 또는 전문 에이전시에서 통합 마케팅 기획/실행의 PM 수행 경력
  • 능동적으로 솔루션을 제시할 수 있는 적극적인 마인드와 긍정적인 에너지
  • 맡은 업무를 꼼꼼하게 확인하고 책임감 있게 마무리할 수 있는 분
  • 다양한 사람들과 원활하게 커뮤니케이션할 수 있는 분
  • 해외 출장에 결격 사유가 없는 분

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니
