jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role
Elastic, the Search Analytics company, is seeking a Jnr Public Sector Account Exec. You’ll own a greenfield Dutch public sector territory: municipalities, healthcare, education and research. This is a hunter seat with loads of potential, Elastic has the momentum in this segment. You’ll open doors, build champions, and turn Search, Observability and Security use cases into new projects, with a main focus on applying AI.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Build and run a territory plan that prioritizes where to hunt first, using account tiering and contact coverage.
  • Generate your own pipeline through outbound, events, partners and public sector networks. Many accounts have no contacts yet, so you’ll build coverage from scratch.
  • Run full-cycle deals with MEDDPICC discipline: economic buyer, champion, decision process, paper process.
  • Navigate Dutch public procurement: tenders, Europese aanbesteding, framework agreements, and partner and reseller routes.
  • Expand the existing customers, especially in universities and research.
  • Forecast accurately and keep Salesforce clean.
  • Work with Solutions Architects, partners and Elastic specialists to land technical wins.

What You Bring

  • We want to hire a sales talent, with <5 years of B2B enterprise software sales, with a proven new logo track record or proven SDR capacity
  • A preference for Public sector experience in the Netherlands (government, healthcare or education). You understand procurement cycles and can build a deal around them.
  • Experience selling technical solutions in search, observability, security, data or cloud.
  • Fluent Dutch and English. You’ll write and sell in Dutch to Dutch-speaking buyers.
  • Strong qualification habits. You know when to push, when to pivot, and when to walk away.

jobs.title: Stage Software Engineer - Paris - H/F/X
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Fondée en 2014, Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de l'IA et de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en IA, transformation data et en data & digital marketing. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 collaborateurs répartis dans 27 bureaux à travers le monde allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit de l’innovation business des entreprises.

La mission des Artefactors ? Transformer la data de nos clients en impact business. Dans ce sens, nous collaborons avec plus de 1000 clients, leaders de leurs industries (Orange, Carrefour, Samsung, AccorHotels, L’Oréal, LVMH, Decathlon) et sommes partenaires privilégiés de Google (GMP/GCP), AWS ainsi que Microsoft Azure.

En tant que stagiaire Software Engineer, tu seras ammener à:

  • Participer activement à la conception et à l'implémentation de solutions techniques robustes et scalables.
  • Architecture logicielle : Contribuer à la réflexion sur l'architecture de nos applications, en veillant à la performance et à la maintenabilité du code
  • Déploiement et opérations (DevOps) : automatisation des tests et des déploiements cloud avec des pipelines CI/CD et une infrastructure en tant que code (ex : Terraform), packaging d'applications dans des conteneurs (ex : Docker), implémentation d'outils d'observabilité des données (ex : DBT)
  • Déploiement de ton logiciel sur le cloud : GCP, AWS ou Azure
  • Déploiement d’une ou plusieurs expertises techniques suivantes : développement logiciel, ingénierie analytique, ingénierie ML, architecture cloud ou ingénierie de sécurité et de fiabilité des sites
  • Veille technologique : Explorer de nouvelles technologies et outils pour optimiser nos méthodes de travail.

Profil recherché

  • Formation : Tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année de cycle ingénieur, Master 2, ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en sotware engineering, génie logiciel, informatique, ou développement web et tu recherches ton stage de fin d’études à partir de Janvier 2027
  • Compétences techniques :
    • Maîtrise d'un ou plusieurs langages de programmation comme Python, Java, JavaScript (Node.js), Go ou Scala.
    • Connaissance des principes de la programmation orientée objet et/ou de la programmation fonctionnelle.
    • Expérience avec des bases de données SQL ou NoSQL.
    • Une familiarité avec le Cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure) et les conteneurs (Docker, Kubernetes) est un atout.
    • Connaissance des outils de versioning, en particulier Git.

Co-creëer de marketingstrategie met de Sales Director en directie en bewaak de realisatie.  ·

Leid en coach het team (growth & automation, campagnes, product marketing, design, content).  ·

Manage budget en martech‑stack; rapporteer KPI’s (leadvolume, conversie, CPL/CAC, CLV).

·

Brutosalaris €7.500 – €8.500 (40 u/pw), afhankelijk van ervaring.  ·

30 vakantiedagen (op basis van 40 uur)  ·

Een werkplek in de fijne kantoorruimte van SnelStart in het midden van Nederland.  ·

Maandelijks vakantiegeld en pensioenbijdrage.  ·

Laptop, ergonomische werkplek (zit‑sta), goede koffie/thee, fruit en noten.  ·

Als laatste een finale selectie en arbeidsvoorwaarden worden vastgesteld in afstemming met de CEO en het MT.

Deze functie is bedoeld voor een daadkrachtige verbinder die marketing discipline  met pragmatisme combineert. Neem contact op met Sound People via Sven Fremeijer (

Aantoonbare resultaten in digitale marketing op strategisch niveau (focus op wat je hebt neergezet).  ·

Ervaring met het leiden/opbouwen van een marketingteam, bij voorkeur in B2B SaaS/tech.  ·

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer, Internship
jobs.description:
Le poste

Les Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSE) travaillent directement avec les clients afin de comprendre rapidement leurs problèmes les plus importants et ainsi concevoir et implémenter des solutions qui vont utiliser leurs données afin de résoudre ces problématiques. Nos clients s’appuient sur les plateformes de Palantir pour certaines de leurs opérations les plus critiques, et les projets débutent souvent par une question ouverte, par exemple : « Comment évaluer le risque d’incendie de forêt et, par conséquent, comment optimiser le réseau électrique ? » ou « Comment évaluer rapidement notre chaîne d’approvisionnement alimentaire et l’adapter afin d’apporter à temps une aide vitale ? » En tant que FDSE, vous appliquez votre capacité à résoudre les problèmes, votre créativité et vos compétences techniques pour aider les organisations à exploiter au mieux leurs données et avoir ainsi un impact réel sur le monde. Vous avez l’opportunité d’obtenir des informations rares et de contribuer à certaines des industries et institutions les plus importantes au monde.

Responsabilités principales

En tant que stagiaire chez FDSE, vos responsabilités s’apparentent à celles que l’on trouve dans une petite start-up, tout en bénéficiant des ressources, de la stabilité et de l’accompagnement d’une entreprise technologique bien établie. Vous travaillerez en petites équipes avec une supervision minimale et serez responsable de l’exécution de bout en bout de projets à enjeux élevés. Votre journée peut consister à discuter de l’architecture avec d’autres ingénieurs, à gérer des données à grande échelle, à coder une application web personnalisée, à discuter avec l’équipe dirigeante du client ou à établir une stratégie pour votre équipe.

Les stagiaires FDSE sont traités exactement comme des ingénieurs à temps plein, et bénéficient d’une grande liberté et d’une grande autonomie dans leur travail. Ils assument la responsabilité des projets et des résultats réels sur lesquels nos clients comptent.

Nos principes:

Impact : nous gérons des projets significatifs et enthousiasmants qui rendent le monde meilleur.

Responsabilité : nous menons nos projets du début à la fin, en surmontant tous les obstacles que nous pourrions rencontrer. Nous nous faisons mutuellement confiance afin de gérer efficacement le temps et les priorités et donner aux individus l’espace nécessaire pour réfléchir par eux-mêmes.

Collaboration : nous travaillons en interne avec des personnes d’horizons variés, tels que d’autres FDSE, des équipes Produits et des Deployment Strategists. Nous travaillons également en externe avec nos clients, souvent sur site, afin de comprendre et de répondre à leurs problèmes.

Développement : nous pensons que l’apprentissage par l’expérience est l’une des meilleures écoles et nous nous encourageons nous-mêmes tout comme nos pairs à rechercher de nouveaux défis et de nouvelles opportunités de croissance, ainsi qu’à trouver de nouvelles façons d’innover et de

Wanna join the adventure?

At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry.

We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast.

This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company.

You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a  BD  call with an institutional customer, and present a recommendation to the executive team. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Cloud Support Engineer to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have an affinity for open source development and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

While our engineers regularly solve deeply interesting, complex technical problems - from triaging cloud environments to root-cause analysis on unseen Linux kernel crashes - this is fundamentally a role rooted in human connection. You will act as a trusted peer and technical guide to external engineering teams, translating intricate open-source challenges into clear, empathetic solutions. We are rapidly expanding and looking for brilliant problem solvers who are just as passionate about building strong, collaborative relationships with customers as they are about the next generation of Canonical solutions.

Location: This is a globally remote role.

The role entails

Empathetic Engagement:  Partner directly with customers across remote sessions, ticketing,, and live conversations to deeply understand and resolve their technical roadblocks.

Collaborative Problem Solving:  Work hand-in-hand with internal engineering teams and regional peer groups to bridge the gap between complex code fixes and real-world customer satisfaction.

True Ownership:  Manage your support cases with a strong sense of personal integrity, ensuring commitments are honored and customer expectations are communicated transparently and predictably.

Ubuntu Lifecycle Guidance:  Develop a rich understanding of the Ubuntu development process, empowering you to give customers clear, human context regarding timelines for engineering fixes.

Knowledge Advocacy:  Author and maintain accessible knowledge base articles, ensuring lessons learned are shared openly to elevate the entire open-source community.

Operational Reliability:  Participate in a regular weekend working rotation to maintain seamless, high-touch continuity of care for our global partners.

What are we looking for in you

Communication Excellence:  Exceptional written and spoken English, with a natural ability to convey technical complexity clearly, warmly, and compellingly.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Portworx - Strategic Accounts - Telco (EMEA)
jobs.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Pure Storage is seeking a Strategic Accounts Account Executive to accelerate growth of the Portworx platform across Strategic Telco accounts in EMEA. You will own a small number of named Telco customers and prospects, build and execute multi year account plans, and drive platform adoption with a focus on business outcomes such as resilience, risk reduction, faster application delivery, and operational efficiency.

You will work closely with cross functional teams across Pure and Portworx, including Systems Engineering, Customer Experience, Marketing, Partner teams, Product, and field leadership. This is a high impact individual contributor role with a strong emphasis on strategic planning, disciplined execution, and customer intimacy.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and grow a portfolio of named Strategic Telco accounts, delivering against annual and multi year revenue targets.
  • Build and execute account plans that map buying centres, application priorities, Kubernetes roadmaps, and transformation programmes.
  • Develop executive relationships across CIO, CTO, CISO, Head of Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, SRE, and Application leaders.
  • Lead complex sales cycles from discovery through close, including security, risk, procurement, architecture review, and legal processes common in Telco.
  • Position Portworx around measurable outcomes: application resilience, ransomware recovery, data protection, regulatory compliance, cloud portability, and modernisation at scale.
  • Orchestrate account teams and partner ecosystems, including GSIs, cloud providers, and regional partners, to drive pipeline creation and deal execution.
  • Run a rigorous, value based sales process tailored to cloud native software, with accurate forecasting and strong hygiene in Salesforce and forecasting tools.
  • Partner with Customer Experience to expand adoption post sale, identify expansion triggers, and build customer advocacy within the Telco community.
  • Stay ahead of competitive dynamics in Kubernetes data services, backup and recovery, and container storage, using insights to sharpen strategy and messaging.
  • Represent Portworx in customer meetings and relevant industry events, with a field first mindset.

What You’ll Bring

jobs.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

We are seeking an experienced engineering leader to become our Senior Director of Engineering for Civil Government and Commercial. In this role, you will lead the engineering strategy, execution, and team development for a rapidly growing organization of 70+ engineers spanning multiple global Planet offices. This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem, or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.

jobs.description:
Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun.  Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine.  Après avoir digitalisé le secteur de la beauté dans plusieurs pays d'Europe, nous recherchons nos premiers commerciaux pour faire de la France une de nos plus grandes réussites.

L'opportunité

Rejoins notre équipe en tant que représentant(e) commercial(e) et deviens l'un des visages de la révolution digitale du secteur. Chez Salonkee, tu as l'opportunité unique de piloter des projets ambitieux, de collaborer avec des experts passionnés et de marquer de ton empreinte l'expansion d'une scale-up en plein essor.

Tes missions

Maîtrise du cycle de vente (A à Z) :  tu pilotes l'intégralité du parcours d'acquisition de nouveaux clients pour Salonkee. Cela inclut la chasse initiale, la prise de rendez-vous qualifiés, la réalisation de démonstrations percutantes et le closing des contrats.

Ambassadeur(rice) de terrain :  tu mènes des présentations produits directement sur site pour démontrer, avec clarté et conviction, la valeur ajoutée de nos solutions pour le business de tes clients.

Conseil stratégique & optimisation :  tu accompagnes tes prospects avec expertise en leur proposant des solutions digitales sur mesure pour optimiser leurs processus et libérer tout leur potentiel de croissance.

Stratégie multicanale :  tu utilises différents canaux de communication pour approcher les clients potentiels et développer des relations de confiance durables.

Accompagnement & formation :  tu assures la formation de tes nouveaux clients pour garantir une adoption parfaite de l'outil et un succès immédiat dès le premier jour d'utilisation.

Ton profil

Expérience sales :  pas besoin d'un CV parfait; ce qu'on cherche avant tout, c'est quelqu'un avec la fibre commerciale et le drive pour aller chercher le client. Une première expérience en vente terrain B2B ou en prospection téléphone/physique est un vrai atout: tu sais ce que c'est que d'aller chercher le client là où il est

Tempérament chasseur :  tu as le goût du challenge, une résilience à toute épreuve et une appétence naturelle pour la prospection active

Autonomie & organisation :  véritable self-starter, tu planifies tes journées de façon stratégique et trouves les meilleurs leviers pour établir Salonkee dans ton secteur

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
Make security the reason people trust Ockto

Own security at the platform people use to share their most personal data

Every day, people use Ockto to share their identity, income, assets and bank data: when they apply for a mortgage, rent a home or take out a lease. Banks and other large organisations choose Ockto partly because of the level of assurance we offer around that data. At Ockto, security is not a support function. It is part of the product and organisational culture.

As our CISO, you make sure it stays that way as we grow. Part of that growth is adopting an AI driven operating model with strong guardrails. You own Ockto's security programme, from risk and controls to incidents, suppliers and audits. You set the standard, check that it is met, and make security measurable in a way that the whole organisation (and specifically our engineers and spec leads), clients, auditors and regulators all recognise. You do this with a real mandate and short lines to the people who decide.

What you'll do  You own the information security programme of a supervised financial company and make it work in daily practice, not just on paper. As CISO, you:

Own Ockto's ISMS and security policy framework, and keep our ISO 27001 certification (held since 2017) and our SOC 2 assurance current and credible.

Translate the risk appetite set by management into a security strategy, an annual plan and clear standards that teams can build to.

Keep Ockto ahead of what's coming. You track developments such as eIDAS2 and the EU Digital Identity Wallet, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and the AI Act, assess what they mean for Ockto and our clients, and translate them into our security strategy and standards in time.

Verify and challenge. Our engineering teams operate the technical controls; you check that they work and that findings get fixed. You approve risk acceptance for serious vulnerabilities and commission penetration tests. All control owners are challenged and prepared to show evidence and reproduce controls.

Lead the response to security and privacy incidents, approve notifications to regulators, and make sure root causes lead to structural fixes.

Manage security risk in our supply chain, from onboarding new suppliers to the annual review of critical ones, in line with DORA.

Make sure our continuity and recovery arrangements are tested and hold up, together with Engineering.

Make security measurable. We judge it by how quickly and how structurally we resolve what we find, not by counting incidents.

Represent Ockto's security towards clients, auditors and supervisors: from a bank's due diligence questionnaire to our external audits and contact with DNB and AFM.

Build a security-aware culture with an awareness programme people actually remember.

Who you work with  You report to our Product & Trust Director, who sets Ockto's trust framework and risk appetite. Within that framework, the security strategy and its execution are yours. On security matters

Develop and deploy  reinforcement learning  (and adjacent policy-learning methods) that make Skydio aircraft  plan, navigate, and control  themselves more intelligently, safely, reliably, and efficiently across our ecosystem: handheld apps, ground control, cloud autonomy services, and fleet workflows.

Navigation & avoidance in the wild:  Train policies that adapt online to cluttered 3D scenes (forests, bridges, urban canyons), complementing our stack for robust obstacle avoidance and dynamic goal-seeking.

Proficient in  Python  (PyTorch/JAX/Ray RLlib) and at least one of  C++  or CUDA.

About the role

Linkup is the web search engine built for AI. Our infrastructure crawls, indexes and serves the live web to AI agents, and it’s scaling fast.  We’re looking for a top‑tier  Machine Learning Engineer  to join Linkup and work hand‑in‑hand with our CTO,  Denis Charrier , and the rest of the tech team.  Your core responsibilities will be to:
Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

Bring new ranking signals into the engine, beyond pure relevance

Build the evaluation framework that tells us what really improves search quality

Optimize model serving for latency and GPU cost

Turn customer and benchmark feedback into ranking improvements, with clear before/after numbers

Requirements

You’re a great match if you:

Are excited to help build Google for AI agents- and believe in  Linkup’s mission

Have strong hands-on experience in information retrieval, ranking or search in production.

Build rigorous evals and check the data behind every number

Care about latency, cost and reliability as much as model quality

Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment

Example Projects

Ship a new ranking model to production and prove the gain on our eval sets

Push our models to the next level: better answers, lower latency, lower cost per query

Build and maintain the evaluations framework that measures every change to our search engine

Our Stack

Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, Ray, Spark / Databricks, Vespa, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform

Details

The ideal candidate will play a central role in our engineering team, partnering closely with the founders. The models you ship will decide what thousands of AI products read every day.  We offer a flexible remote‑work policy- see the details  here .  Join us and leverage your expertise to push the boundaries of AI!

About Linkup

Our Vision

We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web . These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.

AI agents need web search . To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.

Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs . Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.

Web 2.0 is sunsetting . The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.

jobs.title: (Staff / Senior Staff) AI Inference Reliability Engineer, Compute Infra
jobs.description:
About The Role

We're looking for a software engineer, reliability-minded but still a builder, to own what happens in production to the Kubernetes-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. The platform team builds the manifest-driven API and controllers that let the inference team declare what they need, a cluster, a model deployment, a capacity change, and get it reconciled underneath. Your job is to keep that promise true in the real world: triaging InfiniBand issues when prefill and decode nodes stall exchanging KV cache over RDMA, diagnosing hero-model and LoRA-serving faults that don't show up in generic health checks, and extending the automated self-healing system so each new failure mode becomes a permanent fix instead of a recurring page.

The core value we're after is keeping the decoupling real even when things break, and keeping the fleet efficient without that efficiency becoming a new source of instability. You'll own SLOs and error budgets for inference serving, lead incident response, and turn what postmortems teach you into actual changes in the controllers and automation, not just updated runbooks. You'll also work the reliability side of capacity efficiency, since a mistuned defragmentation or bin-packing pass is itself a production risk. Strong candidates have hands-on production-reliability experience on large-scale distributed or GPU-serving systems, are comfortable troubleshooting InfiniBand/RDMA and Kubernetes controller/CRD-based platforms, and think about GPU infrastructure, and the tools that keep it reliable, as software to be engineered.

A product mindset applies: the on-call experience, the clarity of an alert, and the judgment built into an automated remediation are things you ship and iterate on.

Responsibilities

  • Operate the provisioning state machine in production: own the health of the host lifecycle pipeline, discovery, inference bring-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA, triaging stuck or failed state transitions at fleet scale and feeding real failure patterns back into how the states and transitions are designed.
  • Triage and extend automated self-healing: when the node-scanning and remediation platform misses something, a new failure mode, an InfiniBand issue in disaggregated prefill/decode serving, a GPU Xid variant, a hero-model or LoRA-specific fault, diagnose it live, drive the fix to production, and turn it into a new detection/remediation plugin so it's automatic the next time.
  • Own end-to-end reliability of the pipeline: hold the SLOs and error budgets for provisioning and fleet health, lead incident response when idempotency, retry, rollback, or drift assumptions break down in practice, and drive the systemic fix, not just the hotfix.
  • Partner with the inference/ML platform team from the production side: be the one who knows how real cluster

jobs.description:
Lightly AG is a Zurich-based AI company and ETH/HSG spin-off, backed by Y Combinator and top-tier investors. Our machine learning and computer vision technology is trusted by global leaders in autonomous driving, medical imaging, and visual inspection.

We’re looking for experienced ML/AI researchers with a strong publication track record at top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) to support an advanced AI research evaluation project. Tasks

What you'll be doing

What you'll be doing

Critically evaluate AI-generated ML/AI research papers , assessing their scientific contributions, technical correctness, methodology, experimental design, and conclusions

Assess scientific novelty and significance , determining whether proposed approaches represent meaningful advancements over existing state-of-the-art research

Evaluate experimental rigor and validity , including baseline comparisons, benchmark selection, evaluation metrics, statistical evidence, and ablation studies

Identify methodological flaws, unsupported claims, inconsistencies, or misleading results  that undermine the scientific validity of proposed contributions

Assess reproducibility and technical soundness , including whether reported findings are sufficiently supported by experimental evidence and, where available, accompanying code and implementation details

Review and verify relevant academic literature , identifying overlooked prior work, inaccurate citations, and unsupported novelty claims

Evaluate whether AI-generated research meets the scientific standards of top-tier ML/AI conferences , such as NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR

Provide structured, evidence-based assessments  of research quality, including strengths, weaknesses, critical technical concerns, and overall scientific merit

Apply detailed evaluation rubrics consistently , providing clear, well-reasoned justifications for your assessments

The project focuses on evaluating advanced AI-generated scientific research, with an emphasis on technical validity, scientific novelty, experimental rigor, and overall research quality. Your role is to provide expert human judgment on whether the resulting research is scientifically valid, genuinely novel, and of a quality comparable to work accepted at leading ML/AI conferences.  Requirements

You're a strong candidate if you:

Have a PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Statistics, or a closely related technical field, or equivalent demonstrated research expertise

Have published at least 3 peer-reviewed research papers at NeurIPS, ICML, and/or ICLR (hard requirement) , ideally including first-author

jobs.title: Trainee Marketing, Analytics & AI
jobs.description:
Ready to go from graduate to trusted advisor for Europe’s best-known brands in just 12 months? Expect a steep learning curve, real responsibility, and hands-on experience working with AI every day.

💚 About us

Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. Most companies still judge their marketing by last-click. Our AI-powered attribution shows which channels actually drive revenue, and our platform automatically moves ad budgets to where they have the most impact. As a Zurich-based AI scale-up of around 30 people, we support leading European brands in e-commerce, telecommunications, banking, insurance and energy.

🚀 Your mission

Get future-proof.  In our 12-month traineeship you learn, at the intersection of marketing, analytics and AI, how modern marketing is measured and optimized with algorithms. You will have a dedicated expert buddy to show you the ropes. You won't learn how AI replaces your job, but how to work with it and achieve more. After one year, you look after your own clients and move into a permanent role in our Customer Success & Account Management team.

🗺️ Your year at Nexoya

Foundations (Months 1 to 3):  You learn how digital advertising works, from search to social to display, using Google, Meta, TikTok and Snapchat as examples. Then you dive into analytics and attribution, understand how our algorithms optimize budgets, and get your personal AI toolkit.

Applied (Months 4 to 8):  Together with your buddy you look after your first clients and lead your first calls yourself. You also spend time in marketing, sales and product, and join a sprint with our Founder & CEO.

Ownership (Months 9 to 12):  You look after clients fully on your own and take responsibility for your own projects.

🧑‍💻 Your tasks

Analyze cross-channel performance data (Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Snap, etc.)

Master attribution, marketing mix modeling and incrementality, and explain them clearly to our clients

Prepare, interpret and present the budget optimizations from our platform

Work with AI tools every day for analysis, reporting and client meeting preparation

Understand what a client really needs, challenge assumptions with data and turn insights into clear recommendations, in German and English

Own projects that move our team and our platform forward

🎯 What you bring

You are at the start of your career, eager, like taking responsibility and want to learn fast

Enthusiasm for AI and analytics: you don't need to be a developer, but you should want to work with AI every day

A completed or soon-to-be-completed degree in business, data science, marketing or a related field

Enjoy working with numbers and data, for example in Excel or Google Sheets

Fluent in German and English is a must , Italian is a plus

A plus: your own AI projects, an internship in performance marketing, first experience with Claude, SQL, Python or BI tools

Why Nexoya?

✨ Future-proof skills: AI, marketing and analytics in one program  ✨

jobs.title: Creative Advisor - Human Frontier Collective
jobs.description:
About the Collective

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI. As a Creative Advisor, you’ll bring your creative practice into direct collaboration with Scale’s research and ML teams. You’ll help them understand how work gets made in your field, develop new work together, and provide feedback on how AI models support—or fall short of—real creative processes.

What You’ll Do

  • Connect with other creators: Meet and learn from creatives and researchers across HFC and your industry.
  • Shape work in your domain: Share the taste, judgment, methods, and creative decisions behind your practice to help inform model development.
  • Create alongside the team: Collaborate on briefs and develop new work that helps explore what models can and cannot do in your field.
  • Partner with ML and research teams: Define what “good” looks like in your field, review model outputs, flag where AI falls short, and give feedback that shapes how models learn your craft.
  • Help peers understand the opportunity: Introduce other creators in your field to the program and share your experience contributing work.

Who Should Apply

We’re looking for leading creators in their field who are interested in shaping AI and how it’s changing creative work. No AI experience needed. Your expertise in your craft matters most, and being connected to others in your field is a plus. This is a paid, part-time role with a flexible schedule.

Why Join

  • Have a voice: Contribute your subject-matter expertise and perspective in your domain. Build the future by shaping frontier models.
  • Collaborate across disciplines: Work with ML and research teams and connect with other leading creatives.
  • Explore new creative possibilities: Make new work through paid, commissioned briefs that challenge what models are capable of doing.
  • Get paid for your expertise: Paid $300 hourly, with compensation, time commitment, and project scope shared during your interview.

Application Process

  1. Apply: Share your background and a link to your portfolio. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
  2. Portfolio Review: Share one past project you’re proud of. Nothing is used without a signed agreement and payment, and we’ll follow up with next steps.
  3. Meet the Team: A paid conversation with our research and ML team to walk through your work.
  4. Get Started: Successful candidates are invited to join the Human Frontier Collective as a Creative Advisor.

Stumble Guys is one of our most recent hits, with millions of fans joining the party every single day, constantly keeping it at the top of the charts in over 50 countries and with the ambition of becoming nothing less than a beloved franchise and to be played for many years to come.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

WE ARE GAME MAKERS

Who We Are:

As an Expert Character Artist, you’ll be a key contributor to the quality and evolution of our project's character art. You’re an exceptional 3D artist and visual problem solver who can translate character concepts and broad creative goals into compelling, production-ready assets.

Working closely with the creative team and cross-discipline partners, you’ll take on complex, high-impact assignments and turn ambiguous artistic or technical problems into practical solutions. Through the quality of your craft and collaboration, you’ll raise the bar for character art across the studio.

  • Own complex character assignments, translating concepts and briefs into visually compelling, technically sound assets that support gameplay, animation, narrative, and project-wide art direction.

Naughty Dog is seeking a Visual Effects Artist to come join our team! This talented individual should be able to work with minimal input and feel comfortable working in a team environment. Our ideal candidate has a background in VFX and a passion for video games.

What you will do:

  • Create effects that work optimally on the target platform
  • Be proactive and self-motivated, seeking out tasks remaining to be done
  • Collaborate with other effects artists, and the rest of the development team to make the best game possible
  • Additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed

What skills you will use:

  • Technical knowledge and artistic abilities working with sprite type particles and materials within a game engine

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

jobs.title: Senior Language Programmer
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is seeking an experienced Senior Language Programmer to join our Verse team, which owns the toolchain (compiler, VM, and runtime) that powers game development in Unreal Engine and UEFN. You'll work on the systems every UE and UEFN developer relies on to build and ship games with Verse.

In this role, you will

  • Extend, evolve, and maintain the Verse compiler toolchain, transactional memory runtime and VM, add new platform support, implement new language features and integrate with Unreal Engine's content, build, and cooking pipelines
  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and iteration times across the Verse toolchain, runtime and UE/Verse boundary
  • Work closely with language consumers to ensure an exceptional user experience
  • Establish test workflows to validate improvements and prevent regressions
  • Design and maintain the scripting interface to Unreal Engine, working in close collaboration with the Verse Language team and the broader UE engineering organization

What we're looking for

  • Expert knowledge of C++17 or later
  • Experience in compiler or toolchain development (e.g., compiler internals, VM design, Clang/LLVM, or linker/platform ABI specifics)
  • Experience developing and optimizing large codebases, with the ability to make tradeoffs between usability, performance, and power
  • Strong ability to reason about large, interconnected systems
  • Solid grounding in software engineering principles, including API design
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work autonomously and deliver practical solutions
  • Experience with Unreal Engine integration is a plus

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

jobs.title: Social Creative
jobs.description:
Intro

Wil jij als creative deel uitmaken van een snel groeiend en tech gedreven creatief advertising & content bureau in de Houthavens en samen met een leuk team werk maken dat opvalt, werkt én connact? ACT. Now!

Advertising, Content en Technology, samen met jou

ACT.agency staat voor Advertising, Content & Technology together. Wij geloven dat advertising en content via een geïntegreerde aanpak ontwikkeld moet worden, versnelt door technology. Met onze ACT.vertising aanpak zorgen we ervoor dat merken zich strategisch en creatief onderscheiden, always-on communiceren en zo consistent blijven op de lange én korte termijn. In ons kantoor in de Amsterdamse Houthavens werken we met 32 mensen aan accounts als Odido, PwC, Mercedes-Benz Trucks, Schiphol, Museumkaart, Noordhoff en Prinses Máxima Centrum.  ACT zoekt een medior Social Creative. Of ben je juist een medior creatief met veel social ervaring? Allebei kan. Want dat is ook precies waar wij ons als ACT begeven: tussen advertising en content, met veel social werk. Je bedenkt alleen of samen in een team het concept, schrijft het uit en maakt het zelf, snel en met de nieuwste technologie.  Taken  Als creative bij ACT bedenk je concepten die kloppen, de kern raken en waar iedereen energie van krijgt. Social is jouw vak: ongeveer 80% van je werk. De rest is breder creatief werk, zoals campagne-ideeën en pitches.  Je schrijft het script, pakt zelfs eventueel de camera en kan het ook zelf monteren. Van idee tot eindresultaat is het van jou. Je idee staat als t moet als eerste versie binnen een dag. Je weet wat er speelt op Insta, TikTok en YouTube Shorts.  Je presenteert je ideeën intern en bij de klant, onderbouwt ze op basis van de briefing en denkt tactisch mee, met gelaagdheid in je campagnes. Je spart dagelijks met de creative directors en werkt samen met strategie, account, social media manegers en community management.  Wij vragen

Je hebt minimaal 2 tot 3 jaar ervaring als creative bij een creatief bureau, met veel social ervaring

Je hebt een portfolio met werk dat je zelf hebt bedacht én gemaakt, met aantoonbare resultaten

Je kunt idealiter zelf filmen en monteren, bijvoorbeeld in Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut of DaVinci

Je maakt zelf content en brengt een idee in korte tijd van concept naar een eerste versie

Je bent nieuwsgierig naar technologie en gebruikt AI-tools in je dagelijkse werk, bijvoorbeeld voor beeld, video, geluid of tekst.

Je schrijft soepele social en short copy

Je bent een nieuwsgierige, sterke persoonlijkheid met humor en energie, die goed kan samenwerken maar ook goed alleen kan werken

Je weet wat er speelt in het vak en je ideeën plus tone-of-voice zijn van deze tijd

Je hebt smaak, oog voor detail en werkt gestructureerd en nauwkeurig

Je werkt het liefst samen met je team op kantoor. Dit is geen hybride functie!

Wat we bieden

Een ambitieus bureau waar goed werk en samenwerken centraal staan

Een klantportfolio dat je elke dag uitdaagt om je talent te laten

jobs.title: AI platform engineer
jobs.description:
Wil jij werken op het snijvlak van cloud, platform engineering en AI? Bij Itility krijg je de ruimte om te bouwen aan een platform dat onze engineers en klantenteams helpt slimmer, efficiënter en veiliger te werken. Je ontwikkelt niet alleen nieuwe functionaliteiten, maar denkt ook actief mee over hoe we AI en automation kunnen inzetten om onze dienstverlening verder te verbeteren.

Wat jij gaat doen

Je bouwt mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van ons platform en vertaalt behoeften vanuit onze klantenteams naar concrete, herbruikbare oplossingen. Je werkt aan features vanuit de roadmap, maar signaleert ook zelf waar verbeteringen mogelijk zijn.  Een belangrijk onderdeel van je werk is het toepassen van AI en automation. Je ontwikkelt bijvoorbeeld AI-agents die informatie verzamelen en analyseren, engineers ondersteunen bij troubleshooting of binnen duidelijke kaders zelfstandig acties uitvoeren. Je zorgt ervoor dat deze oplossingen niet bij een proof of concept blijven, maar daadwerkelijk in productie worden gebruikt.  Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

Het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van nieuwe platformfunctionaliteiten.

Het doorontwikkelen van onze centrale dashboard- en beheeromgeving.

Het bouwen van AI-agents, agentic workflows, API's en integraties.

Het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van Terraform-modules en andere automatiseringen.

Het inrichten van human-in-the-loop-processen, approvals en guardrails.

Het analyseren en automatiseren van terugkerende operationele werkzaamheden.

Het ondersteunen bij incidenten, troubleshooting en wijzigingen wanneer dat nodig is.

jobs.title: Senior Stack Scientist
jobs.description:
Senior Stack Scientist

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.  As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities

Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression.

Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners.

Skills and Experience Required

PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field.

12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred).

Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression.

Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols.

Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms.

Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar).

Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

Management experience

English is mandatory; French or German is a plus.

Start date: Immediately

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. About the role

Frontier AI is on track to be among the most consequential and most adversarially-targeted technology in the world. The capability curve is steep, the adversaries who want these systems are extremely well-resourced, and the security bar this will eventually require is well beyond where the industry operates today. Incremental hardening alone is not going to close that gap, so we need breakthroughs and a group of people to go find them.

Security Labs is that team. We run a portfolio of high-risk, high-expected-value security projects: the work that seems impractical until someone optimistic and stubborn enough actually tries it. Projects run on the order of weeks rather than quarters, and each one is either handed off to the Anthropic team that will own it in production or wound down with a writeup of what we learned. We expect a meaningful fraction of our bets not to land.

This team is intentionally scrappy and ambitious. We're intentionally iterating fast on high-risk research bets and we expect a meaningful fraction not to land. If a 30% project success rate sounds uncomfortable, or uncharted and chaotic territory isn’t both frightening and exciting, this probably isn't the right fit. There are other places in Anthropic Security doing important work with more structure, less risk, and more certain paths to positive outcomes.

The questions we're trying to answer include:

  • Can our core research workflows survive extreme isolation?
  • Can we replace trust with cryptographic guarantees?
  • Can the models themselves become our most effective security control?
  • What would it actually take to defend against a tier-1 state adversary, and how much of that can we build now?

Who we're looking for. We're hiring generalists with rare depth. Anthropic is working on frontier AI systems that handle sensitive information at enormous scale. How we protect that data, and how we build privacy into our systems rather than bolting it on afterward, is central to our mission of building AI that is safe and beneficial.

This is a foundational role. As one of our first dedicated privacy engineers, you will help establish the privacy engineering function at Anthropic and shape how privacy is designed into our AI systems from the ground up. You'll sit within our Data Infrastructure team, architecting privacy-preserving systems, leading the implementation of privacy-enhancing technologies across our infrastructure, and providing technical leadership on privacy across engineering, research, and product teams.

You'll work at the intersection of privacy engineering, AI safety, and distributed systems, solving problems that don't yet have established answers. This is a senior individual contributor role with high autonomy and broad influence.

Key responsibilities

  • Design and implement privacy-preserving architectures for AI training and inference systems operating at very large scale, using techniques e.g. differential privacy, federated learning, and secure multi-party computation

  • Partner with researchers to implement privacy-preserving training methods that protect user data while maintaining model quality

  • Build foundational privacy infrastructure, including automated data discovery, classification, access controls, audit logging, and lifecycle management

  • Translate regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, the EU AI Act) into technical implementations and automated compliance controls

  • Architect data governance systems for tracking data lineage, purpose limitation, and retention across distributed AI systems

  • Lead privacy reviews and threat modeling for new models and features, identifying risks and designing scalable mitigations

  • Partner with product and infrastructure teams to embed privacy controls into Claude's inference systems, user interfaces, and data pipelines

  • Develop privacy engineering toolkits and frameworks that enable other engineers to build privacy-preserving features by default

  • Design privacy-preserving analytics and measurement systems that surface useful insights without exposing individual user data

  • Evaluate emerging privacy

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for an experienced Hard Surface Outsourcing Lead to support and supervise creative hard surface content provided by outsource partners. Working alongside Hard Surface Art Leads, and reporting to the Hard Surface Cosmetics Lead, the Outsource Lead will provide front-line creative feedback for work submitted for Fortnite. Though the role will be mainly supervisory, the individual should be an experienced artist, having worked in AAA titles before, and have a solid hands-on art background, with a very strong foundation of 3D modeling for both hard and soft surfaces. The ideal candidate would be a talented 3D artist who is able to communicate equally effectively, both with outsource partners and internal teams, to ensure the timely delivery of high quality assets to the next stage in the art pipeline. Their skills will include; a keen artistic eye for ‘clean’ 3D modelling, documenting existing pipelines, creating blockouts, paintovers and exemplar assets and, ultimately, providing clear visual feedback to vendors at each stage of the process.

In this role, you will

  • Work closely with the HS Cosmetics Lead and HS Art Leads to pull together clear creative direction for the assets to be created, and then ensure this information is packaged and conveyed to the Vendor as clearly as possible. Work with Directors, Production, and internal partners to evaluate, hire, and onboard vendors
  • Collect or generate detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support the external vendors
  • If required, making any needed fixes to keep assets consistent and technically game ready as they’re handed off from the outsource partner
  • Clearly communicating modeling and paint feedback to the outsource partner, and ensuring those creative notes and goals are met. Informing leadership in the event that isn’t happening
  • Communicating and partnering with the HS implementation team ensuring outsourced assets are ingested into the pipeline and engine correctly

jobs.description:
Riot engineers bring deep knowledge of specific technical areas but also value the opportunity to work in a variety of broader domains. As Engineering Managers, we gain organizational alignment by building a strong engineering vision and offering creative solutions to organizational design. We also serve as mentors for a team of engineers, overseeing their performance and trying to find stretch opportunities for their growth while maintaining a focus on results.

As a Manager, Software Engineering within Riot Discovery Studio, you will report to the Tech Director on an unpublished R&D product, leading a team of internal and external engineers to support product exploration, integrate and extend critical backend technologies, and scale our technology to meet the needs of a live Riot title. You will be accountable for all technical decisions of your team’s focus areas and help shape the product. You will own the technical health of the product's backend services from prototype through live operation, including architecture, scalability, reliability, observability, deployment, incident response, and infrastructure cost. You will be hands-on in implementation, at least initially.

Responsibilities:

  • Support defining the engineering strategy and technical roadmap to develop our global backend infrastructure with an understanding of our audience and product goals
  • Manage and scale an engineering team to support product needs through various development stages (i.e. pre-production, production, and post-launch)
  • Partner with product and delivery as they define product features and product roadmap
  • Collaborate and coordinate with Riot Central technology teams to efficiently deliver world-class solutions
  • Direct development and manage performance of external engineers in other geographies
  • Collaborate in technical/architectural discussions, provide direction and drive decision-making
  • Drive the planning and execution of engineering work including requirements gathering, technical discovery, technical design, and work breakdown and estimation.
  • Own the technical success of the services team, including operational excellence and cost in live environments
  • Identify, interview, and hire software engineers to support team and Riot hiring goals
  • Support engineers with performance management and career development, including stretch opportunities for them to grow
  • Create a culture of leadership across engineering by seeking different perspectives at all levels to solve problems and contribute ideas

Required Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of experience as a software engineer
  • 4+ years of game development experience working in various platforms (i.e. mobile, console, PC, etc.)
  • 2+ years experience in a leadership position, working directly on the production of a game as an Engineering Manager

jobs.title: Social Media Strategist, League of Legends (12 Month Contract)

The team also establishes and maintains internal services such as platforms, vendor management, project management, RFPs, and working with player insights.

The team is dedicated to providing platforms for authentic local interactions and channel experiences for players and Rioters, both online and offline. The team also ensures that our pan-EMEA content will reach players through the right channel, collaborating closely with EMEA and country-based publishing teams.

The Role

Reporting to the Regional Community Lead, EMEA, you will be based in Berlin (Germany).

As Social Media Strategist II, EMEA, you will work on League of Legends, collaborating with the EMEA Community, Brand, Esports, Local Publishing Teams, Global Publishing, and partners to deliver impactful campaigns, content, and initiatives across all our products and social channels, including LEC.

You will be responsible for driving the ongoing success and sustainable strategy for our regional and LEC socials, and positioning Riot for success in the years ahead, working closely with our partner agencies. You will work closely with the Regional Community Lead, EMEA, to create campaigns that resonate with our players and ensure these campaigns deliver on their objectives.

You will also bring a high level of social media expertise, supporting local publishing teams in their channel efforts to target different audiences and contributing from a social operations perspective. This is a 12 month contract role starting in January 2027 and based onsite in Berlin on a hybrid basis.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with EMEA Publishing teams to provide social media expertise, share best practices, and inform social-first approaches across the broader League of Legends product portfolio
  • Contribute to the development of EMEA-wide Publishing campaigns by bringing a social media perspective to campaign strategy, content planning, and audience engagement
  • Identify opportunities to connect esports initiatives with broader Publishing priorities, ensuring social strategies contribute to a cohesive experience for players and fans across the ecosystem
  • Collaborate with a partner agency to develop and refine channel strategies for LEC, ensuring alignment with Riot's overarching goals and objectives
  • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for social media performance, delivering regular reports and actionable insights to internal stakeholders
  • Support the Social Media strategy and coverage on-site for LEC events & roadtrips
  • Partner with the EMEA Comms and Esports Team to ideate and produce innovative content that resonates with esports fans

jobs.title: Corporate Development Lead, Life Sciences
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is seeking an experienced Corporate Development leader to drive our strategic transactions in life sciences and biotech. Frontier AI is beginning to change how drugs are discovered, developed, and brought to patients, and Anthropic wants to help build that future responsibly. In this role, you will source and execute acquisitions, investments, and strategic partnerships with AI-native life sciences companies, partnering directly with Anthropic's leadership, research, and product teams to shape our strategy in the sector, grounded in Anthropic's strategic priorities.

The ideal candidate combines deep life sciences domain knowledge with technical fluency in AI and a record of closing complex transactions. You understand how R&D, clinical, and regulatory workflows actually run, you can tell a durable AI-native business from a thin wrapper, and you can assess a target's science, data, and compliance posture as rigorously as its financials. You care about AI safety and Anthropic's mission to build AI systems that are helpful, harmless, and honest, and you recognize the stakes of applying AI where patient safety and scientific integrity are on the line.

Join us in shaping how AI accelerates science and medicine while keeping it safe and beneficial for humanity. This role sits at the intersection of frontier AI research and life sciences, with direct impact on Anthropic's growth in one of its most consequential sectors.

Key responsibilities

  • Define and execute Anthropic's corporate development strategy in life sciences, covering acquihires, tuck-in acquisitions, minority investments, and strategic partnerships
  • Build and maintain a target pipeline across AI-native companies in drug discovery, clinical development, regulatory and medical writing, lab automation, and healthcare data infrastructure
  • Lead end-to-end transaction processes, from sourcing through diligence, negotiation, signing, and integration
  • Partner with research, product, engineering, and go-to-market teams to assess the technical, scientific, and commercial value of opportunities
  • Run sector-specific diligence, including scientific and data validation, regulatory posture (FDA, EMA, GxP, 21 CFR Part 11), data privacy (HIPAA, GDPR), quality systems, and IP
  • Assess build/partner/buy tradeoffs and competitive dynamics against incumbents, AI-native entrants, and other frontier AI labs
  • Structure and negotiate complex deals, including earnouts

jobs.title: Events & Community Manager
jobs.description:
About us:

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.  Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the role:

Restaurant owners trust other restaurant owners. They listen to the chef down the street, their wine supplier and their accountant long before they listen to an ad. That's why our events work. When we launched in Berlin, we hosted a four-hands dinner with two local merchants and a well-known food creator. We believe that’s what builds credibility, trust, and ultimately a warm prospect list.  We’re hiring an Events & Community Manager to turn that into a program that runs in several markets at the same time. You’ll plan and run our partner and owned events, and find new ways to grow Tebi through the hospitality community in each city, neighbourhood and market. You’ll work closely with our local sales teams so every event and partnership turns into real conversations.  This is a hands-on role. One week you'll be hosting a merchant dinner in Milan, the next you'll be setting up a distributor breakfast in Amsterdam. You'll report to the Head of Marketing and work closely with our Marketing team to extend these programs to our channel ecosystem, plus align closely with the General Managers and Account Managers in each market.

What you'll be doing:

Run events across markets:  Plan and deliver partner and owned events in 2–3 markets at a time, from intimate merchant dinners and industry breakfasts to city launches. You own the calendar, budget, venues, suppliers, guest lists and the plan for the night.

If you enjoy writing software more than clicking dashboards, obsess over eliminating manual work, and want to build infrastructure that manages tens of thousands of GPUs autonomously, we’d love to talk.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build fleet automation systems that provision, validate, deploy, upgrade, repair, and retire GPU clusters with minimal human intervention.
  • Build AI Infrastructure Agents that automate deployment, root-cause failures, incident triage, and autonomous remediation.
  • Develop Fleet Intelligence platforms that continuously monitor hardware health, firmware, networking, storage, thermals, and workload performance to predict failures before they impact customers.
  • Build software that maximizes GPU availability, utilization, performance, and reliability across thousands of accelerators.
  • Create automated validation systems for GPUs, InfiniBand/RoCE fabrics, NVLink/NVSwitch, storage, and distributed AI workloads.
  • Build internal platforms and developer tools that allow infrastructure to be managed through software—not manual operations.
  • Continuously improve deployment velocity, reliability, and operational efficiency through automation.
  • Partner closely with hardware, networking, platform, and AI teams to push the limits of AI infrastructure.

Requirements

  • 3+ years building distributed systems, infrastructure platforms, or large-scale backend software.
  • Strong software engineering skills in Python, Go, or Rust.
  • Experience building platforms, automation systems, or developer infrastructure.
  • Experience with Linux, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, or similar infrastructure technologies.
  • Strong systems thinking with the ability to understand problems across hardware and software.
  • A passion for solving complex infrastructure challenges through software.
  • An automation-first mindset—if a task is repeated, your instinct is to build a system to eliminate it.

Bonus Experience

  • GPU infrastructure, CUDA, NCCL, NVLink/NVSwitch
  • InfiniBand or RoCE networking
  • Bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle management
  • Large-scale AI training or inference clusters
  • Hardware health monitoring and predictive failure detection
  • Distributed storage systems
  • AI agents and autonomous infrastructure operations

jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord is looking for a Staff Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team and partner with Consumer Revenue. Our mission is to make it easy for all users to discover, understand, buy, and keep Premium Products on Discord. In this role, you will set technical direction for the data systems that support Nitro, Shop, server monetization and gifting, and other consumer revenue experiences. You will build reliable data foundations that help teams understand performance, run experiments, and make better product and business decisions.

You’ll work closely with Data Science, Product, Finance, Data Platform, and engineering partners. If you’re excited to lead complex data engineering work, raise the quality of shared data products, and help a high-velocity consumer business grow, read on.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Set technical direction for Consumer Revenue data engineering: identify foundational gaps, define scalable architectures and standards, and lead high-impact initiatives from design through adoption.
  • Design and own canonical data models and datasets for consumer monetization, including subscriptions and subscriber states, purchases and payments, Shop, gifting, and Orbs. Make these assets reliable, well-documented, and useful across product analytics, financial reporting, experimentation, and decision-making.
  • Build and evolve production data pipelines that transform source events and transactional data into accurate, trusted data products. Balance freshness, reliability, cost, and maintainability across batch and, where the use case calls for it, lower-latency processing.

jobs.title: Senior Identity Security Consultant Microsoft Entra
jobs.description:
Dein künftiger Arbeitgeber ist ein unabhängiges, spezialisiertes Beratungshaus mit Standorten im deutschsprachigen Raum. Es begleitet Organisationen durch komplexe Transformationen und bringt Technik, Strategie und Menschen zusammen. Der Security-Bereich wächst gerade deutlich, neue Kundenmandate sorgen für anspruchsvolle Projekte. Gesucht ist eine Persönlichkeit, die Identitätslösungen von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung trägt und sie auch vor der Geschäftsleitung überzeugend vertritt.  Möchtest Du als

Senior Identity Security Consultant Microsoft Entra (a), 80-100%

nicht nur Teil des Ganzen sein, sondern aktiv Einfluss nehmen und mitgestalten? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.  Meine Herausforderungen

Lösungen für Authentifizierung, Conditional Access und Privileged Identity Management in Microsoft Entra ID entwerfen und umsetzen.

Phishingresistente Anmeldeverfahren wie Passkeys, FIDO2, Windows Hello for Business und Temporary Access Pass bei Kunden einführen.

Bestehende Tenants analysieren und Migrationskonzepte für Benutzer, Gruppen, App-Registrierungen, Service Principals, SSO, SCIM-Provisioning und Hybrid Identity erarbeiten.

Konfigurationsänderungen vorbereiten, sauber durch den Change-Prozess des Kunden führen und nachvollziehbar dokumentieren.

Eng mit Projektleitung, Architektur, Cyber Security und Fachbereichen zusammenarbeiten und Ergebnisse auch vor Entscheidungsträgern klar präsentieren.

In wachsenden Security-Mandaten Verantwortung übernehmen und das Identity-Angebot aktiv mitprägen.

Mehrjährige Projekterfahrung mit Microsoft Entra ID in mittleren und grossen Organisationen.

Fundierte Praxis mit Authentifizierungsmethoden und MFA, Conditional Access, PIM, App-Registrierungen und Enterprise Applications über SAML und OIDC.

Erfahrung mit Entra Connect oder Cloud Sync in hybriden Umgebungen.

Nachweisbare Projekt- und Konzeptarbeit, nicht ausschliesslich Betrieb oder Support.

Die Fähigkeit, technische Sachverhalte in klare Konzepte und Entscheidungsgrundlagen zu übersetzen.

Sicheres Auftreten beim Kunden, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude an Teamarbeit.

Fliessend Deutsch in Wort und Schrift für die Kundenkommunikation, gute Englischkenntnisse.

Von Vorteil: Passwordless-Rollouts in grossen Benutzergruppen, Zertifizierungen wie SC-300, AZ-500 oder MS-102 und Erfahrung in regulierten Branchen.

Meine Vorteile

Unbefristete Festanstellung in einem spezialisierten Beratungshaus.

Anspruchsvolle Projekte mit direkter Wirkung auf die Sicherheit grosser Organisationen.

Ein Team, das Technik, Strategie und Menschen zusammendenkt.

Kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Raum für eigene Ideen.

Gezielte Förderung von Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen.

Hybrides Arbeiten: Einsätze bei Kunden in der Nordwestschweiz, Homeoffice nach Absprache.

Stellenantritt per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung.

jobs.title: Senior Security IAM Engineer
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior IAM Security Engineer to join our Information Security team on a remote basis or hybrid basis if located in Barcelona. This role will focus on building, scaling, and securing Scopely’s identity and access management ecosystem across our cloud, SaaS, AI, and remote access environments, with a strong emphasis on Terraform-based IAM automation, access workflow engineering, least-privilege design, identity risk reduction, and AI-assisted operational workflows.

This is a highly technical, hands-on role for someone who can operate across AWS, GCP, Okta, AWS IAM Identity Center, Zero Trust access models, identity governance workflows, and modern AI-enabled engineering environments, while building scalable identity systems through Infrastructure as Code, workflow orchestration, and automation-first security engineering.

What You Will Do

Build and Evolve Modern IAM Architecture

  • Design and evolve Scopely’s IAM architecture to support a high-scale, cloud-first environment across AWS, GCP, SaaS applications, AI tooling, and remote access platforms.

Lead initiatives around:

  • Federated identity architecture using SAML, OIDC, OAuth, and SCIM
  • Workforce identity and access patterns across internal platforms
  • Least-privilege role design and access segmentation
  • RBAC and ABAC models for cloud and SaaS environments
  • Centralized access models using Okta, AWS IAM Identity Center, Google Cloud IAM, and cloud-native IAM services
  • Secure cross-account and cross-project access patterns
  • Service account, workload identity, and non-human identity governance
  • Zero Trust identity and access control design

Partner with engineering, infrastructure, and security teams to:

  • Standardize secure identity and access patterns
  • Reduce identity sprawl and excessive permissions
  • Improve access visibility and auditability
  • Build scalable identity controls for a fast-moving engineering environment

Own Terraform-Based IAM and Access Automation

  • Own and improve Terraform-based IAM and access automation across Scopely’s cloud and identity environment.

Design, build, and maintain:

  • Reusable Terraform modules for IAM roles, policies, permission sets, group mappings, and access patterns
  • Terraform workflows for Okta app assignments, group-based access, and IAM Identity Center automation
  • Standardized access modules that can be reused safely across teams and environments
  • Policy-as-code patterns for least privilege and permission boundary enforcement
  • Terraform-driven onboarding and offboarding flows for identity-related systems
  • Automation for service account and workload identity provisi

We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people worldwide daily.

Scopely is building the best SaaS gaming platform ever! The Marketing data team strives to create the world’s best products for UA, Ads, ASO, and Player Experience verticals. Powering many award-winning, loved-by-millions franchise games over mobile, web, and PC.
