jobs.title: Brand Manager - Unpublished R&D  Product
jobs.description:
Brand Management at Riot is focused on our players. Our mission is to make it better to be a player by building trust, inspiring fandom, and delivering meaningful experiences that resonate globally.

As a Brand Manager for an undisclosed R&D game, reporting to the Director of Global Brand Management, you will help introduce a brand-new product to players for the very first time. This is a rare opportunity to be an early pioneer, shaping how this product shows up in the world, how players first experience it, and how the brand and live service evolve over time.

You will be focused on driving go-to-market strategy and executing global player experiences that bring this new game to life, operating at the intersection of product, publishing, and creative to align teams, build momentum, and deliver key moments with clarity, craft, and operational excellence. This role is ideal for a highly organized, execution-driven brand marketer who thrives in ambiguity and loves bringing big moments to market.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver against global go-to-market strategy, translating global game experiences into clear, actionable marketing plans, briefs, and milestones that teams can execute against with confidence
  • Lead execution of cross-functional campaigns end-to-end, from framing objectives and defining audiences through creative development, production, launch, and post-launch evaluation.
  • Partner closely with external and internal partners such as Product, Publishing, Creative, Production, Community, Social, Comms, and Regional teams to align priorities, timelines, and execution plans across functions.
  • Own the development and execution of core go-to-market tactics, including channel planning, asset development, launch sequencing, and cross-channel coordination across owned, earned, and partner surfaces.
  • Serve as the accountable on-team owner for campaign rollout and tactical execution, overseeing end-to-end development of marquee moments, including briefing and alignment with external vendors and agency partners, while partnering with producers and channel owners who support day-to-day execution.
  • Drive cross-functional coordination and operational rigor, maintaining sources of truth such as campaign roadmaps, timelines, creative trackers, and status updates.
  • Ensure campaigns are delivered on time, on brief, and on budget, proactively identifying risks and dependencies and helping teams navigate tradeoffs.
  • Support the development of scalable campaign frameworks and go-to-market processes that can evolve as the product grows into a long-term live service.
  • Partner with Analytics and Insights to evaluate campaign performance, synthesize learnings, and apply optimizations to evolve the publishing playbook.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in brand management, product marketing,

jobs.title: Sales Enablement Trainer, Claude Products
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Sales Enablement Trainer, Claude Products, you'll teach Anthropic's global sales team how to use our products, both to do their own work better and to position Claude credibly with customers. Anthropic ships quickly, and the surface area of what we build is growing faster than any individual seller can track. The job has two components. The first is enabling our own people to be power users of Claude so the field is the most sophisticated user of the product we sell. The second is enabling them to position it: to run a credible technical conversation with a customer, anticipate the hard questions, and hold their own with a technical buyer.

In this role, you’ll help define what an AI-native sales team looks like. The best person in this role already uses Claude to help them excel in a sales or sales enablement role. You'll be embedded enough with Product and Applied AI to see around the corner and be opinionated enough to say which surfaces to invest enablement resources behind. You'll need enough technical credibility to earn the respect of engineers and enough commercial fluency to earn the respect of sellers.

Key responsibilities

  • Own product enablement for the global field organization, spanning new launches, existing capabilities, and the product roadmap ahead
  • Build the programs that make Anthropic sellers genuinely expert users of Claude in their own daily work
  • Create enablement that equips the field to position our products with technical and business buyers, including demo readiness, objection handling, and competitive framing
  • Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, and Applied AI to get early visibility into what is shipping and to shape how it reaches the field
  • Anticipate which new product surfaces will require enablement investment, and make the case for that investment before launch
  • Build and maintain the product certification path that credentials sellers on our core products
  • Create high-quality enablement content including demo scripts, technical talk tracks, solution guides, and competitive positioning material
  • Establish feedback loops that carry field and customer signal about product gaps back to Product and Product Marketing

Minimum qualifications

  • Experience in a sales or sales enablement role
  • Experience building AI automations into sales workflows and tooling
  • Hands-on, regular use of AI assistants and agent

About the role

Anthropic's customer-facing teams are often the first place a customer sees what Claude can do. As a Demo Engineer, you'll build the demos, reference implementations, and reusable tooling that help those teams make new capabilities tangible, relevant, and trustworthy, ideally within days of a product launch rather than weeks after.

This role sits between product engineering, technical storytelling, and GTM execution. You'll own ambiguous, high-leverage problems end to end: prototyping an agentic experience for a new capability, then hardening it into something reliable that other teams can run on their own. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, and our sales and solutions teams, and you'll bring what you learn from customer-facing work back to the people building the products.

Because a demo is frequently someone's first impression of what our models can and can't do, accuracy and honesty matter as much as polish. Success in this role looks like customer-facing teams demonstrating new capabilities sooner and with more confidence, recurring requests becoming reusable assets rather than one-off projects, and field insights shaping product and launch-readiness decisions.

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | New York City, NY | Washington, DC
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the team

Anthropic's Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team is the connective tissue that holds the company accountable to its security commitments. We translate regulatory, customer, and voluntary obligations into controls that teams act on, and give leadership a bird's-eye view of how well we're meeting them. We're building toward a fundamentally different kind of GRC: one that directs Claude, with the right humans in the loop, to challenge and evidence the performance of controls continuously rather than through periodic audits.

Within Security GRC, Audit & Assurance runs the integrated audit across our frameworks and maintains the Common Control Framework the program hangs off. This role sits in Audit & Assurance and helps run that integrated audit program, plan the audits we add next, and assess the frameworks and scope changes we are considering.

About the role

You'll help run Anthropic's unified audit program: quarterly audits across SOC 2, HIPAA and the ISO 27000 family including ISO 42001, plus the rest of our certifications, working with our audit firms, our GRC Partners, and control owners across the company. You'll plan new audits as we expand to new frameworks, platforms and regions, and run the gap assessments that tell us what each expansion takes before we commit to it.

You'll help build the audit operating model and runbook, and drive automation in the program so evidence is collected once and reused across frameworks, requests reach control owners once, and each audit cycle takes less effort than the last. Building with Claude is a normal part of the job, with you deciding where human judgment stays in the loop.

This is an individual contributor role for someone with program management experience who writes clearly, stays calm under deadlines, and likes making a busy program simpler.

  • Run audit readiness ahead of each fieldwork window: control owner prep, evidence pre-checks and walkthrough dry runs

jobs.title: Product Designer, Safeguards
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Design at Anthropic sits at the intersection of craft, research, and product intuition. We're a small team working on products that millions of people use daily—and on interactions that don't have established conventions yet.

Our work shapes how people experience AI: whether Claude feels like a tool or a collaborator, whether it earns trust or erodes it. We partner closely with engineers and researchers, often designing around capabilities that are emerging in real-time. That means staying close to the models, prototyping rapidly, and being comfortable with ambiguity.

We're looking for designers who ship fast and stay in motion—people who would rather get something in front of users this week than perfect it for a month. You're excited to question fundamental UI assumptions and invent patterns that feel native to AI, and you're already using tools like Claude Code to extend what you can build. You pay attention to where model capabilities are heading, not just what Claude can do today, and you find ways to keep caring about the pixels, the copy, and the edge cases while shipping quickly.

Key responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, AI researchers and other stakeholders to define product vision, strategy and roadmaps, and play an active role in shipping.
  • Understand the technical architecture of our products and define primitives for new capabilities.
  • Define feature areas with exceptional attention to detail and polish, identifying opportunities to improve quality and consistency of broader flows
  • Craft beautiful, polished, and delightful user interfaces that build trust and showcase the power of our AI technology
  • Comfortable in code, design, prototypes, and learning new ways to communicate ideas and concepts
  • Find creative ways to ship high-quality work in a fast-paced, often ambiguous, resource-constrained startup environment

Minimum qualifications

  • Experience designing and shipping complex workflows, enterprise/B2B SaaS, developer tools, or API products end-to-end
  • Proven track record of executing end-to-end on large and complex products, or a series of products, in ambiguous environments
  • A portfolio demonstrating user-centered design thinking and polished UI craftsmanship
  • Proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools, such as Figma
  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude Code as a creative partner in you

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Internal Comms
jobs.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Team

The Twitch community is like no other - a passionate and engaged group of creators and active participants who are uniquely invested in what we’re all building together. The Marketing & Communications team at Twitch serves to authentically activate the Twitch community (and beyond) in ways that inform and inspire. Members of our team work across a range of areas including internal and external communications, content & partnerships, creative services, and marketing strategy.

About the Role

We’re looking for someone to lead internal communications across the company. You’ll help employees understand what’s happening and why it matters, help navigate complex company moments and transitions, and develop company All Hands programming that people look forward to.

It’s a role with range. One day you might be shaping comms for an organizational change; the next, developing a new All Hands segment or finding a great story buried somewhere in the company. We’re looking for someone with excellent judgment, strong instincts, and real creative ambition — someone who runs toward the hard stuff and is always thinking about how to make internal communications more useful, interesting, and engaging. Keeping employees informed and connected, and finding ways to highlight and celebrate our people, our work, and our community, are at the heart of this position.

You can work in New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Los Angeles, CA; Irvine, CA; or Seattle,WA.

You Will:

Manage Internal Comms

jobs.title: [Junior / Senior / Staff] Software Engineer, Inference / Compute Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
About the Role

We're looking for a software engineer to build the Kubernetes-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. You'll design a manifest-driven API where the inference team declares what they need, whether that's a cluster, a model deployment, or a capacity change, and our controllers handle the reconciliation, provider/runtime selection, and lifecycle management underneath, so the inference team never has to know or care which specific serving stack, scheduler, or hardware pool is doing the work. You'll also build the systems that keep the fleet efficient, not just running, including defragmentation and rebalancing logic that consolidates scattered workloads back into contiguous capacity, and scheduling/bin-packing improvements that push GPU utilization up without hurting latency.

The core value we're after is decoupling the people building on top of the platform from the operational and runtime complexity underneath, while squeezing more usable capacity out of the same hardware. You'll build the controllers, reconciliation loops, and self-service surface (API/CLI, not tickets) that make that decoupling real, plus the event-driven health, remediation, and utilization systems that keep it running and efficient without a human in the loop. Strong candidates have hands-on experience with Kubernetes controller/CRD patterns, have built or operated a platform API that abstracts multiple backends behind one interface, understand GPU scheduling and capacity efficiency (fragmentation, bin-packing, right-sizing), and think about GPU infrastructure as software to be engineered.

A product mindset - you've built internal platforms or APIs consumed by other engineering teams and care about the developer experience of what you ship.You build it, you own it. You are not only responsible for delivering the software but also for operating and supporting it in production.

Responsibilities

  • Build the provisioning state machine: design and implement the software that models the full lifecycle of a physical host from discovery, inference bring-up to GPU driver/CUDA stack, health validation, and decommission/RMA — as explicit, versioned states and transitions.
  • Build the self-service API: design declarative APIs and a control plane so the inference team can request, scale, and tear down inference clusters with one API call — no ticket, no human in the loop.
  • Automate self-healing: detect degraded or failed nodes, drain them safely, trigger repair or replacement, and reintroduce healthy capacity into the pool automatically.
  • Own reliability of the pipeline: idempotency, retries, rollback, and drift detection so the provisioning system is as dependable as any other production service.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Designer in Animation
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Senior Technical Designer in Animation (TDiA) to join our team working across various animation systems. As a TDiA, you will use your animation sense and technical understanding of character animation to design and create gameplay animation systems that facilitate appealing, high-quality character motion. You will be the primary point of contact for animation implementation issues and any animation-related technical challenges, and you will work closely with Animation, Design, and Engineering colleagues to ensure the animation pipeline operates smoothly and efficiently. You will also help identify potential issues and deploy correct solutions, using your technical knowledge to help bridge and facilitate communication between the animation team and other departments.

In this role, you will

  • Create animation behavior tools/techniques/philosophies that allow the building of complex movement systems
  • Design and implement animation state machines/behaviors and runtime solutions
  • Work closely with the Animation, Design, and Engineering departments to analyze, troubleshoot, and solve in-game animation implementation issues and animation-related technical challenges
  • Closely collaborate with the animation leadership to maintain the style and quality bar for animations in the game
  • Look for opportunities to improve the animation pipeline/workflow and help provide solutions for technical animation problems, including performing training and creating documentation for the animation team

What we're looking for

  • A strong animation sense with a clear understanding of realistic and stylized character motion and how to achieve them with modern animation methods
  • Expertise with animation pipelines, including source content creation tools such as Maya, MotionBuilder, and the Unreal Engine, using our Control Rig toolset
  • Exceptional problem-solving ability with strong written communication and teamwork skills

jobs.title: Machine Learning Intern
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - EPIC RESEARCH

What We Do

Epic Research conducts state-of-the-art research in machine learning, AI, character animation, and digital humans. We work with leading universities and product teams to bring new research into games like Fortnite, Unreal Engine, MetaHuman, and the tools creators use every day.

MACHINE LEARNING RESEARCH INTERNSHIP AT EPIC GAMES

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for current PhD students and recent PhD graduates (within 12 months of graduation) for paid research internships, working on state-of-the-art machine learning across our ecosystem. Epic makes Unreal Engine, which powers creative work across many industries, alongside some of the world's most popular games, including Fortnite and Rocket League. Through these products, ML research at Epic reaches millions of creators and players every day. AI is reshaping the games industry, and Epic Research - led by Lucia Specia and Michael Black - is at the center of that shift. We're looking for talented interns who want to be part of it.

In this role, you will

Work with our team of research scientists and programmers at the intersection of vision, language, speech processing, embodied agents, and game development to create state-of-the-art machine learning models in a range of areas - research topics of interest include:

  • AI-backed interactive characters: LLMs for conversational characters, memory systems, automated evals, animation, etc.
  • Game agents: vision-language-action, game-state agents, etc.
  • 3D human and object tracking
  • Reinforcement learning for embodied behavior
  • Speech systems and conversational agents
  • World building and game logic generation: video models, 2D->3D scene building, etc.
  • AI-assisted game development, e.g. the next generation of Epic Developer Assistant for UE and UEFN
  • Embodied and physical intelligence including human-object interaction
  • Multi-modal diffusion models
  • Player safety: AI-alignment, content moderation, etc.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Sandboxing
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Every time Claude runs code, uses a computer, or works as an agent, it does so inside a sandbox. Our Sandboxing team builds the isolation layer behind that work. The same systems run the code Claude writes for users, the environments we train and evaluate models in, and the agents our customers deploy.

These workloads are untrusted by design, and there are a lot of them. Sandboxes need to start in milliseconds, hold up under adversarial code, and scale to a very large number of concurrent sessions. You will work at the boundary between the Linux kernel, virtualization, and the container ecosystem. You will partner with research, product, and security teams to make sure that safe and fast do not trade off against each other.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate the sandboxing infrastructure that runs untrusted, model-generated code and agent workloads at scale

  • Improve sandbox startup time, density, and throughput, including snapshot and restore, checkpointing, and warm pools

  • Strengthen isolation across compute, filesystem, and network, including egress controls and per-session credential handling

  • Investigate and fix performance, reliability, and security issues at the kernel, hypervisor, and container runtime level

  • Build the monitoring, tracing, and debugging tools that show where time and resources go inside a sandbox

  • Work with researchers to support reinforcement learning environments and evaluations that need fast, reproducible, isolated execution

  • Work with product and platform engineers to expose sandboxes as a dependable, well-designed capability for Claude products and customers

  • Partner with security teams to threat-model the platform and to test, harden, and respond to escape and abuse scenarios

  • Work with cloud providers on the hardware and platform features that our workloads depend on

  • Share knowledge on systems programming and Linux internals, and help set technical standards for the team

Minimum qualifications

  • Software engineering experience in Linux systems programming, kernel development, or another low-level area

  • Strong programming skills in at least one systems language such as Rust, C, C++, or Go

  • Working knowledge of virtualization or container isolation technologies such as KVM, QEMU, Firecracker, gVisor, or runc

  • Unde

jobs.title: [HR Div.] Developer Relations Program 운영/지원 (3년 미만 / 계약직)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

KRAFTON은 각기 다른 크리에이티브 아이덴티티와 강점을 가진 약 20개 이상의 글로벌 스튜디오로 구성되어 있으며, 국내에만 14개의 스튜디오가 존재합니다. 다양한 위치에서 다양한 프로젝트를 진행하고 있지만, 우리는 모두 하나의 KRAFTON Family입니다.

KDC (KRAFTON Developers Connect)는 KRAFTON Family가 하나로 모일 수 있는 장으로, 서로 다른 배경과 경험을 가진 사람들이 교류하며 창의성(Creativity)을 더욱 발전시킬 수 있다고 믿습니다.

2011년 전사 차원의 지식 공유와 기술 교류를 목적으로 시작된 KDC는 지난 15년간 유관 업계 종사자, 전 세계 스튜디오 및 파트너들과 지속적으로 교류하며 범 크래프톤 차원의 연결을 확장해 왔습니다. KDC 팀은 KRAFTON의 다양한 신작 개발 및 독립 스튜디오 간의 '연결'을 통해 상호 이해를 증진시키고, 개발자 간 지식과 경험이 활발하게 유통될 수 있도록 커뮤니티를 설계하고 운영하는 역할을 합니다.

이를 위해 KDC 팀은 세미나, 핸즈온 워크숍, 해커톤, 직군별 밋업 등 다양한 형식의 프로그램을 기획·운영합니다. 단순히 보고 듣는 것을 넘어 경험을 공유하고, 인사이트를 얻으며, 의미 있는 네트워크를 형성할 수 있도록 — '인정 → 자극 → 동기부여 → 성장 → 새로운 기회'로 이어지는 크래프톤만의 선순환 개발 문화를 만들어가는 것이 우리의 목표입니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 해커톤 사전 준비 및 현장 운영 지원 (인쇄물 제작, 참여자 관리, 웹앱 데이터 입력, F&B·야간 지원, 설문 분석 등)
  • KDC Week·Club·Track 각 프로그램/행사별 사전 준비 및 현장 운영 지원 (연사 초청·예약 보조, 참가자 관리, 에셋 검수, 등록·세션 운영, 설문 분석 등)
  • 개발 행사 진행 전반의 현장 응대 및 사후 정리 (물품 반납, 사진 아카이빙, 재고·데이터 정리 등)

jobs.title: Principal Engineer Capacity/Compute
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Anthropic manages one of the largest and fastest-growing infrastructure fleets in the industry — spanning multiple accelerator families, cpu families and clouds. The Capacity Engineering team is responsible for making sure all our infrastructure resources are accounted for, well-utilized, and efficiently allocated. We own the data, tooling, and operational systems that let Anthropic plan, measure, and maximize utilization across first-party and third-party compute.

As an engineer on Capacity Engineering, you will build the production systems that power this work: data pipelines that ingest and normalize telemetry from heterogeneous cloud environments, observability tooling that gives the org real-time visibility into fleet health, and performance instrumentation that measures how efficiently every major workload uses the hardware it’s running on. You will be expected to write production-quality code every day, operate alongside Kubernetes-native infrastructure at meaningful scale, and directly influence decisions around one of Anthropic’s largest areas of spend.

You’ll collaborate closely with research engineering, infrastructure, inference, and finance teams. The work requires someone who can move between data engineering, systems engineering, and observability with comfort — and who thrives in a high-autonomy, high-ambiguity environment.

This is a pipeline role feeding four areas. Depending on your background and business priority, you’ll focus primarily in one, but the boundaries are fluid and the problems overlap:

  • Data platform Pipelines that ingest occupancy and utilization telemetry from Kubernetes clusters, normalize billing and usage across cloud providers, and serve the BigQuery tables the rest of the org queries against. Correctness, completeness, and latency are the job, not a footnote. Consumers range from research engineers to finance to leadership, so it's product work as much as engineering: defining schema contracts, making data discoverable, and figuring out what people actually need.
  • Planning Knowing what the fleet has, where it's going, and what's in the way. Making the state of the fleet legible and actionable in real time: cluster health tooling, capacity planning platforms, alerting on occupancy drops and allocation problems, and systemic fixes to scheduling and fragmentation. Kubernetes operations on one side, cross-team coordination on the other.
  • Efficiency</

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works

Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements

2+ years of professional software engineering

Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

Regular use of an AI coding tool

Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

At least 10 hours a week, starting now

A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have

Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms

US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

jobs.title: Policy Design Manager, Integrity and Authenticity
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Washington, DC
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Integrity and Authenticity Policy Manager, you will be responsible for developing, refining, and maintaining policies that prevent the misuse of AI systems for deception, manipulation, and unauthorized monitoring at scale. You will serve as the policy owner for risks related to inauthentic behavior, influence activity, surveillance, and the profiling of individuals and groups, and you will help shape policy frameworks across several areas, including authenticity, information integrity, and privacy and surveillance.

Your initial focus will be on translating the Integrity and Authenticity risk framework into clear, enforceable policies, ensuring policy language addresses emerging threats identified by partner teams, and establishing guidelines that enable consistent enforcement decisions. Many of the most serious harms in this space begin with upstream steps that look routine on their own, such as compiling records about a person, automating account creation, or sorting users by inferred identity. Part of your work will be defining where those steps become prohibited. The role will expand as AI capabilities advance. Safety is core to our mission. You will help ensure our products cannot be used to deceive people at scale, monitor and profile people without their knowledge or consent, or sort and target populations based on sensitive characteristics.

Important context for this role: In this position you may be exposed to and engage with explicit content spanning a range of topics, including those of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature, as well as detailed descriptions of privacy violations, surveillance abuses, and deceptive campaigns targeting vulnerable people.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and define policy boundaries for covert monitoring, tracking, and surveillance across different contexts, drawing the distinction between malicious behaviors and compliant dual-use scenarios

  • Write policy guidance on facial recognition, voice cloning, and geolocation inference, specifying which uses require consent and which are prohibited outright

jobs.title: Tabletop Exercise Lead, The Anthropic Institute
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Anthropic Institute

The Anthropic Institute (TAI) is a function within Anthropic that works to advance the public conversation around AI.

The Institute is comprised of research teams tackling some of AI's most consequential societal challenges: the Frontier Red Team, which stress tests our systems against catastrophic risks; Societal Impacts, which studies how Claude is used by millions of people; Economic Research, which tracks AI's impact on people's jobs and the larger economy; the Rule of Law team, which studies AI's impacts to democracy; and more.

The Institute's mission is to reduce information asymmetries between Anthropic and the outside world, name and answer the hard questions implied by powerful AI systems, and publish these findings so that policymakers, researchers, technology leaders, and the public can reckon with what's here and what's to come.

About the role

The role. You will build and lead the Institute’s tabletop exercise program and the team that runs it. Based on trends visible in the exponential and in consultation with technical experts, you will set the research agenda: which questions the exercises should answer, which scenarios to run, with which audiences, and what each run is meant to test. You will own the methods that make results comparable across runs and turn them into findings people outside the room can use. You will hire and manage a team plus a bench of facilitators, and you will be the program’s public voice.

Why tabletop exercises? If RSI arrives, the hardest problems will be about making decisions under uncertainty. The people making them may not trust each other, and the authorities they work under may not be fit-for-purpose. A tabletop exercise (TTX) allows the people who would face that situation practice it before it is real. It also shows us what tools and information they reach for, including what they would need that does not exist yet.

Tabletop exercises are also a research method. You can run the same scenario many times, with different groups of people (and with many more AI agents playing in silico), and you start to see the distribution of decisions people make. This is one of the few ways to generate empirical evidence about the future, i.e., how people and institutions will respond to situations that have not happened yet.

Key responsibilities

  • Set the program’s research agenda: the questions exercises should answer, the scenarios to run, and the audience for each

jobs.title: Research Intern, Frontier Speculative Decoding (Summer 2027)
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Speculative Decoding team at Together AI builds the draft models and algorithms that let large language models generate faster without changing their outputs. Our speculators run in production on frontier open models such as DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM. Our work sits at the intersection of model training, inference algorithms and serving systems, and we co-design all three to lower the cost and latency of generation.

As a research intern, you will dive into open questions in speculative decoding: new drafter architectures and verification schemes, knowledge distillation and training recipes that align draft and target models, and drafters that adapt as traffic shifts. You will train and fine-tune draft models at scale on dedicated GPU clusters, and test your ideas against realistic serving workloads, including long-context and agentic traffic.

Projects aim to answer important research questions in speculative decoding, enabling faster generation on frontier models, drafters that keep pace with changing workloads, and robust, reproducible evaluation under real traffic.

Past Research

Speculative decoding research by Together researchers, interns and academic collaborators includes:

  • Speculative Speculative Decoding (ICLR 2026)
  • When RL Meets Adaptive Speculative Training: A Unified Training-Serving System (ICML 2026)
  • Beat the Long Tail: Distribution-Aware Speculative Decoding for RL Training (MLSys 2026)

Responsibilities

  • Research and prototype new efficient speculative decoding algorithms and draft model architectures

  • *해당 절차는 각 포지션 및 후보자에 따라 변동이 있을 수 있습니다.
  • 상시 채용으로 채용 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
  • 필요 시, 인터뷰 및 직무 테스트가 추가될 수 있습니다.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Inference
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic’s Inference organization serves Claude to millions of users and enterprise customers, across our own products and the world’s largest cloud platforms, with the speed, reliability, and efficiency that frontier AI demands. The stack that makes this possible is deep and tightly coupled: accelerator kernels, an in-house inference engine that manages the entire token path for both production and research workloads, distributed routing, autoscaling, and capacity management. Every layer affects the others, often in ways that are hard to see in isolation. We build across GPUs, TPUs, and Trainium, and the complexity of building, testing, and shipping inference software grows with every platform we add.

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive the programs that scale it. The work spans four closely coupled areas:

  • Scaling and infrastructure. Routing, autoscaling, and capacity management for the serving fleet, and bringing new capacity online.

  • Velocity. The toolchains, development environments, and CI/CD that let inference engineers build, test, and ship across every accelerator platform.

  • Inference engine. The software between the accelerator kernels and the routing layer that serves every request.

  • Performance. Improving throughput, latency, cost, and reliability across the stack, with correctness treated as part of performance.

This is not a status-tracking role. You'll own outcomes end to end, often where no single team is accountable for the whole picture. Much of your value comes from crossing boundaries into Research, Safeguards, Security, Compute, Infrastructure, API, and our cloud and silicon partners, and bringing back the requirements and dependencies that no team sees from inside its own space. There is little process to inherit, and we want to keep it that way: you'll build the minimum machinery the work needs and remove it when it stops helping. And because this is Anthropic, you'll have Claude as a collaborator. We expect TPMs on this team to push hard on what AI-assisted program management and fleet operations can look like.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the programs that scale Claude’s serving fleet across accelerator and cloud platforms, from early direction through delivery.

  • Drive new capacity online end to end, working across compute, infrastructure, security, n

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

Foundation Model Evaluation 팀은 우리 파운데이션 모델과 글로벌 프론티어 LLM을 다각도로 진단하여, 모델 개발의 방향성을 데이터에 기반해 제시하는 역할을 합니다. 벤치마크는 측정 축이 다양하고 점수만으로는 모델의 실질 역량을 판별하기 어렵기 때문에, 우리는 모델이 실제로 어디서 강하고 약한지를 깊이 있게 분석하고 그 결과를 모델 개선으로 연결하는 평가 체계를 구축합니다.

글로벌 프론티어가 주목하는 표준 벤치마크와 실제 사용 맥락을 반영한 자체 평가셋을 함께 운영하며 모델 동향을 추적합니다.

평가 결과를 모델·데이터팀과 공유하여 기술 로드맵과 데이터 전략 수립에 직접 기여합니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

Foundation Model Evaluation 팀의 Engineer로서 하게 될 일은 다음과 같습니다:

  • 우리 모델이 집중해야 할 역량과 타겟을 정의하여 모델 개발 전체의 방향성을 제시합니다.
  • 데이터 contamination에 영향을 받지 않고 모델의 실질 역량을 측정할 수 있는 신규 벤치마크를 설계·구축합니다.
  • 프론티어 모델과 우리 모델을 진단하여, 새로운 모델이 등장할 때 적합성을 빠르게 판단하고 기술 의사결정을 지원합니다.
  • 데이터·모델팀과 긴밀히 협업하여 데이터의 약점과 모델 설계의 개선점을 도출·전달합니다.
  • 대규모 평가를 안정적으로 실행·관리하는 평가 파이프라인·플랫폼을 개발하고, 평가 결과와 인사이트를 중앙화합니다.
  • 연구 성과를 Tech Report 또는 NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, EMNLP 등 탑티어 학회에 논문·워크숍 형태로 발표합니다.

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 딥러닝 관련 분야 전공 석/박사 졸업 이상 혹은 이에 준하는 연구 경력
  • AI 모델 평가·분석 또는 ML/NLP 토픽으로 AI/ML 탑티어 학회(NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, EMNLP 등) 논문 작성을 경험하신 분
  • 데이터를 하나하나 들여다보며 인사이트를 도출하는 집중력을 갖추신 분
  • 복잡한 실험 설정, 결과 분석을 명확하게 문서화하고 공유할 수 있는 커뮤니케이션 능력을 갖추신 분
  • 새로운 domain에 빠르게 적응할 수 있는 분
  • 원활하게 업무 커뮤니케이션 하실 수 있는 분
  • 해외 출장에 결격 사유가 없는 분

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • AI/ML 탑티어 학회(NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, EMNLP 등) 발표/수상 경험이 있으신 분
  • AI 모델 평가를 위한 데이터 수집

    • Multimodal Foundation Model, AI Agent 등 차세대 AI 핵심 기술을 연구·개발하여 게임과 현실 세계에서 사람과 자연스럽게 상호작용하는 지능형 Agent를 구현합니다.
    • AI 기술을 게임 개발과 서비스는 물론 다양한 산업 분야에 적용하여 제작 혁신, 새로운 사용자 경험, AI 기반 서비스와 사업 기회를 창출합니다.

[Team 비전]

  • 저희 팀은 특화 모델(Specialized Model) 을 개발합니다. 많은 기업이 반복되는 고정 업무에 frontier 모델 API를 사용하지만, 실제로 필요한 것은 범용 능력의 일부임에도 매 호출마다 범용성 전체에 대한 비용을 지불하게 됩니다. 저희는 오픈소스 파운데이션 모델을 특정 업무에 맞게 빠르게 finetuning하여,
  • 특화 모델 개발 영역에서는 frontier 모델을 기준으로 타겟 업무의 품질·비용 기준을 수립하고, 다양한 규모의 오픈소스 모델을 평가하여 개발에 적합한 모델을 선정합니다. 이후 모델을 타겟 업무에 맞게 고도화하여 frontier 수준의 성능과 높은 비용 효율성을 동시에 달성합니다.
  • 평가 체계 영역에서는 특화 모델의 품질을 신뢰할 수 있게 측정하는 방법론을 설계합니다. Human gold label 기반 정량 지표, LLM-judge 기반 pairwise 비교, 결함 포착률 분석 등 업무 특성에 맞는 평가 프로토콜을 구축하고, 정량 평가와 정성 감사를 결합해 배포 판단의 근거를 만듭니다.
  • 또한 이러한 과정을 자동화된 파이프라인으로 발전시키는 것을 목표로 하고 있습니다.
  • 새로 합류하시는 분께서는 모델 증류와 finetuning, LLM 평가 등 특화 모델 개발의 전 과정을 함께 추진하며, AI 기술의 실질적인 비즈니스 가치를 만들어가게 됩니다.

크래프톤 AX(AI Transformation)는 전사에 AI를 도입하여 임직원들의 일하는 방식(Work & Workflow)을 혁신하는 핵심 조직입니다.

AXD FDE(Forward Deployed Engineer) 팀은 전통적인 개발 조직처럼 백오피스에 머물지 않습니다. 현업(게임 제작 스튜디오, 글로벌 퍼블리싱, 백오피스 등)의 한가운데로 직접 투입되어, 그들이 겪는 치명적인 비즈니스 Pain Point를 발굴하고 AI 기술을 통해 즉각적인 솔루션을 만들어냅니다. 전사 AI 해커톤을 이끌고, 최단 시간 내에 MVP(최소 기능 제품)를 런칭하여 '기술이 어떻게 재무적/시간적 성과로 이어지는지'를 현장에서 직접 증명해 낼 강인하고 속도감 있는 FDE 팀을 모십니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • AI 혁신 전략 수립 및 자문: 현업 부서의 비즈니스 과제를 분석하여 AI 적용 전략을 독자적으로 수립하고, 기술적 방향성 및 우선순위에 대한 전문적 자문 제시
  • 비즈니스 요구사항 분석 및 아키텍처 설계: 비개발 직군(기획, 재무, HR 등)의 복잡한 요구사항을 정확히 분석·해석하고, 이를 AI 기반의 아키텍처로 설계 및 구현
  • AI 기술 도입 타당성 연구 및 ROI 분석: 도입된 AI 기술의 실제 비용 절감 및 업무 시간 단축 효과를 정량적으로 분석·연구하고, 성공 사례를 전사 스케일업(Scale-up) 전략으로 기획
  • 현업 밀착형 AI 프로토타이핑 및 해커톤 기획: 현업 부서와 직접 호흡하며 비즈니스 문제를 정의하고, 단기간(며칠~몇 주) 내에 AI 에이전트 및 자동화 앱을 설계·프로토타이핑하여 기술 검증 수행 (사내 AI 해커톤 등 전사 혁신 이니셔티브 기술 총괄 포함)

jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

"AI First 크래프톤을 완성하는 데이터의 심장,"

크래프톤 AX(AI Transformation)는 전사에 AI를 도입하여, 데이터와 인프라를 기반으로 임직원들의 워크(Work)와 워크플로우(Workflow) 자동화를 가속화하고 그 압도적인 효율화 성과를 전사로 확산하는 핵심 조직입니다.
Data Foundation 팀은 파편화된 전사 데이터를 통합하고, AI(LLM, AI Agent 등)가 즉각적으로 이해하고 활용할 수 있는 최적의 데이터 구조(Ontology)와 아키텍처를 설계·구축합니다.
크래프톤의 각 조직이 실제로 사용하는 데이터와 업무 맥락을 깊이 이해하고, 이를 AI가 이해할 수 있는 데이터 관리·활용 체계로 직접 기획하고 설계해 낼 분을 모십니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

담당 도메인의 데이터 관리·활용 체계를 직접 기획·설계하고, 설계 산출물(Ontology 설계서, 데이터 모델, 거버넌스 기준 문서 등)을 주도적으로 작성·관리합니다.

  • 도메인별 데이터 구조 분석 및 Ontology 설계: 도메인의 원천 데이터와 업무 프로세스를 분석하고, AI(LLM, AI Agent)가 활용할 수 있는 Ontology(개체·관계·속성 정의) 구조를 주도적으로 설계하며 Ontology 설계서를 작성·관리
  • 비즈니스 용어·지표 정의 및 데이터 거버넌스 기준 수립: 도메인별 핵심 용어(Glossary), 지표 정의, 데이터 오너십·접근 권한 기준을 현업과 협의해 수립하고 거버넌스 기준 문서로 정립
  • 데이터 품질·정합성 분석 및 개선: 원천 데이터의 정합성, 완결성, 중복 여부를 분석하고, 개선 방안을 직접 도출해 Ontology 설계 및 데이터 구축에 반영
  • 현업 부서와의 요구사항 분석 및 데이터 모델링: 담당 조직의 실무자를 인터뷰하고 업무 데이터를 분석하여, 실제 질의·분석 시나리오에 맞는 데이터 모델(테이블 구조, 관계, 계층)을 설계·구축하고 지속적으로 개선

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 데이터 분석, BI, 또는 데이터 모델링 관련 분야 7년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분 (데이터 엔지니어링뿐 아니라 데이터 분석가 경력도 포함)
  • SQL을 능숙하게 다루며, 원천 데이터를 스스로 탐색·분석해 구조를 파악할 수 있는 분
  • 특정 업무 도메인의 데이터와 프로세스를 깊이 이해하고, 현업과 커뮤니케이션하며 요구사항을 구조화해 데이터 모델·지표 체계로 설계해 온 경험이 있는 분
  • 데이터 모델링(테이블 설계, 정규화, 관계 정의 등)을 직접 기획·수행해 본 경험이 있으신 분
  • 새로운 개념(Ontology, Semantic Layer 등)을 빠르게 학습하고 실무에 적용하려는 의지가 강하신 분

With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.


Art Department 소개

Art Department는 크래프톤 게임 스튜디오의 아트 프로덕션 전반에 필요한 그래픽 기술과 솔루션을 지원하는 조직입니다. 그래픽 기술과 제작 파이프라인을 기반으로, 게임 개발팀이 빠르고 안정적으로 프로젝트를 시작하고 확장할 수 있도록 지원하며, 크래프톤만의 차별화된 아트 기술 서비스를 제공합니다
Art Dept는 “Scale-up the Creative”와 “AI-first”라는 회사 방향성 아래, 장인정신에 기반한 높은 퀄리티, 데이터 기반 최적화, 그리고 제작 효율화를 핵심 가치로 삼고 있습니다.
조직 구성원은 Advanced 그래픽 기술과 최신 트렌드를 선도하며, 전사 스튜디오를 대상으로 최적화된 제작 가이드라인을 제시하는 기술 파트너로서 역할을 수행합니다. 단순한 툴 지원을 넘어, 제작 과정에서 발생하는 기술적 병목을 선제적으로 해결하고, 스튜디오와의 협업(Co-development)을 통해 최상의 개발 경험을 제공합니다.
Art Department는 경험과 신뢰를 바탕으로 국내외 다양한 스튜디오를 지원하며, 지속적으로 성과를 만들어가고 있습니다. 크래프톤 게임이 높은 그래픽 완성도를 갖추고 성공적으로 시장에 출시될 수 있도록, 함께 성장할 전문가를 기다립니다.

Visual R&D 팀을 소개합니다.

Visual R&D 팀은 KRAFTON Art Department 산하 조직으로, 예술적 창의성(Art)과 기술적 구현(Technology)의 시너지를 극대화하는 역할을 수행합니다.
우리는 게임 개발 과정에서 마주하는 다양한 난제를 해결하고, 크래프톤 산하 글로벌 스튜디오들이 최고의 퀄리티를 효율적으로 구현할 수 있도록 최적화된 솔루션과 제작 환경을 제공합니다.
현재 우리는 인게임 캐릭터 제작의 혁신을 목표로 하는 'VCC(Visual R&D Character Customization)' 프로젝트를 비롯하여, 차세대 그래픽 기술 연구와 개발 프로세스 고도화 업무를 주도하고 있습니다.
우리의 목표는 단순한 R&D를 넘어, 실제 프로젝트에 즉시 적용되어 성과를 낼 수 있는 실용적인 기준을 만드는 것입니다.
우리는 지금, 변화하는 개발 환경 속에서 유연한 사고와 협업을 통해 새로운 가치를 창출하고 프로젝트의 완성도를 높여갈 인재를 찾고 있습니다.
각 분야의 전문성을 바탕으로 크래프톤 전사 프로젝트의 성공을 함께 지원하고 성장하고 싶은 분들의 도전을 기다립니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

Brand Planning Team은 KRAFTON의 차별적인 가치를 담은 기업 정체성과 브랜드 체계를 수립하고, 글로벌 고객의 인지와 지지를 이끌어냄으로써 브랜드 경쟁력 확대와 사업 성장에 기여를 목표합니다. 사업 전략과 브랜드의 교차점에서 일하며, KRAFTON이 모든 시장·접점·이해관계자에게 자신을 표현하는 방식의 방향을 설정합니다.

  • 글로벌 브랜드 경쟁력을 고려한 전략 아젠다 도출 및 실행 로드맵 수립 참여

2. 글로벌 브랜드 경쟁력 관리

  • 글로벌 게임·엔터테인먼트 산업 내 브랜드 및 커뮤니케이션 트렌드 분석 및 연구
  • 주요 경쟁사 및 선도 기업의 브랜드 전략 분석을 통한 차별화 기회 도출
  • 타겟 시장 및 고객 세그먼트 기반 브랜드 인식·수용도 분석을 통한 전략 수립
  • Western, Emerging 등 주요 게임 시장에서 KRAFTON 브랜드 경쟁력 강화 방안 연구

3. 브랜드 내재화 전략 수립 및 실행

  • Vision & Values를 포함한 기업 브랜드 체계의 조직 내 정렬을 위한 전략 수립 참여

  • 게임·엔터테인먼트·테크 산업 내 브랜드 전략 경험

  • 해외 출장에 결격 사유가 없는 분

About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. HTML

Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

jobs.title: Director, Infrastructure Lease Accounting
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is seeking a Director, Infrastructure Lease Accounting to lead technical accounting for our most complex infrastructure and energy arrangements — the data center leases and related structures underpinning our recently significant investment in American computing infrastructure. As we continue our rapid growth, you will ensure the financial statement accuracy of the most technically complex contracts we enter into.

This is an opportunity to be at the heart of one of the fastest-scaling companies in the industry, and to shape how Anthropic accounts for the highest-stakes arrangements underpinning our compute and energy portfolio.

You will serve as the technical accounting subject matter expert for arrangements spanning data center leases (ASC 842), and counterparty or joint-venture structures (ASC 810 VIE analysis). You'll work closely with Real Estate, Legal, Finance, and external auditors to ensure accounting implications are understood before commitments are made.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the technical accounting subject matter expert for Anthropic's most complex infrastructure arrangements, leading classification, measurement, and subsequent accounting judgments

  • Apply ASC 842 to complex lease arrangements, including lease identification, modifications, reassessments, and embedded leases within compute, colocation, and data center contracts

  • Apply ASC 810 to counterparty and joint-venture structures, including variable interest entity (VIE) analysis for special purpose entities

  • Apply ASC 815 to energy and infrastructure arrangements, including consideration of embedded derivatives

  • Lead technical accounting analysis and memo preparation for new arrangements, ensuring positions are well-reasoned, supported, and auditor-ready

  • Partner with Real Estate, Legal, and Finance teams during contract negotiation and execution to ensure accounting implications are understood before commitments are made

  • Serve as a trusted finance partner to non-finance stakeholders — explaining the financial statement impact of their decisions in clear, simple terms they can act on

  • Serve as a key point of contact with external auditors on technical accounting matters within your portfolio

  • Mentor accounting professionals across the Infrastructure Accounting team on technical accounting matters

  • Drive process improv

You will build joint business plans with partner leadership, work with your partners' sales teams on live opportunities, team up with Anthropic's Partner Sales team to bring those partners into the right accounts, and keep a clear, accurate view of how each partner is performing. You will work closely with our Partner Sales, Partner Programs, Partner Support, Partner Activations, and Partner Success teams so your partners get the full value of what Anthropic offers, and you will bring what you hear from partners back to those teams.

This role reports to the Head of Boutique & AI-Native SIs and works closely with sales, product, and applied AI teams to make sure our SI partners are equipped to win and deliver transformative AI solutions for their clients.

Responsibilities

Partner Development and Go-to-Market

  • Own and manage relationships with a portfolio of key AI-native and boutique SI partners, from practitioners through to founders and executive leadership

  • Develop and execute joint go-to-market strategies that drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline

  • Lead partner business planning, including setting mutual goals, identifying target accounts, and defining success metrics

  • Work directly with your partners' sales teams to identify opportunities and support deal progression

  • Partner closely with Anthropic's Partner Sales team, who lead introductions and co-sell with our account executives and account teams, so your partners are positioned on the right accounts and opportunities

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

At Anthropic, we're building AI systems that are safe, beneficial, and transformative. Our mission is to develop AI that benefits humanity, and we believe the most powerful capabilities emerge when we thoughtfully bridge the gap between research breakthroughs and real-world applications.

Frontier AI runs on datacenters, and the world is in the middle of the largest infrastructure buildout in a generation. The binding constraint on progress is increasingly everything around the chips: land, power, permits, equipment, and the design and construction of the buildings themselves. Bringing a single site online involves hundreds of people, thousands of components, and decisions that move enormous amounts of capital. Much of that work still runs on spreadsheets and handoffs.

At Anthropic, we're building software and Claude-powered tools to help Anthropic scale out its compute, and we think there's an enormous opportunity to rethink how that work gets done. It's early, it's already having a real impact, and the engineers who join now will shape how one of the most consequential buildouts in the world gets done.

We're looking for strong, versatile software engineers who love building for people doing real work in the physical world. You'll embed with the teams that source sites, design buildings, procure equipment, and manage construction, learn their work deeply, and build the tools and systems they rely on every day. Datacenter experience is a big plus, but what matters most is that you can earn the trust of expert operators, model a messy domain cleanly, and move fast.

Responsibilities

  • Build the core systems that track a datacenter's lifecycle (sites, designs, bills of materials, equipment, and construction progress) in one trusted, permissioned source of truth
  • Embed with datacenter, energy, and supply chain teams to understand how the work actually gets done, find the critical path, and build the tools they reach for first
  • Bring order to messy data by migrating and reconciling spreadsheets and legacy trackers, and integrate with the industry's tools, like construction management, scheduling, and engineering systems
  • Design for trust: fine-grained permissions, auditability, and data quality for information that steers major investment decisions
  • Ship early, iterate with us

As Enablement Lead, you will be hands-on in getting the APAC field ready: onboarding, ongoing skill development, manager coaching support and launch readiness, across GTM functions, not just sales. You will spend most of your time in the room, running sessions, building programmes and working directly with sellers and managers, in the time zones and languages where customer conversations happen.

This is a build role with a global spine. You inherit a working global and international enablement engine. Your job is to adapt it for APAC, deliver it across the region, and feed what you learn back into the international and global programme.

How we work: adults learn by doing, so we build sessions around live activity: practice, reflection, real customer scenarios. The measure is not what was covered in the room. It is what changes a week later in how people think, decide and sell.

This takes creativity and a solid understanding of how adults learn, applied at speed. The frontier moves quickly and the field is scaling fast. Much of the work is unlearning: helping experienced sellers let go of pre-AI habits, not just teaching new ones. AI is what makes this scalable: endless practice partners, personalised scenarios from real deals, feedback minutes after a call. You will use it that way, not to generate more content.

  • Personally design and facilitate deal walkthroughs, role-plays and customer-conversation rehearsal, favouring practice over presentation
  • Partner with regional GTM leaders to build a coaching standard that scales as the manager layer grows
  • Own launch readiness for the region, so that when a new model or product ships, the APAC field is certified and conversation-ready in the same week cycle as everyone else

jobs.title: Senior Game Designer
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

DESIGN

What We Do

Put your design skills to work at a cutting-edge company that challenges the norm. From character and level design to competitive gameplay and system design, help shape the future of interactive entertainment at Epic.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Senior Game Designer to help create compelling gameplay experiences across combat, progression, systems, moment-to-moment mechanics, and live gameplay content for our collaboration with LEGO. In this role, you’ll partner closely with design leadership, art, programming, animation, UX, audio, production, and QA to deliver high-quality features from concept through ship. You will own and iterate on gameplay systems, mechanics, and content while balancing player experience, readability, accessibility, engagement, and long-term retention. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, deeply player-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced cross-disciplinary environment where iteration and feedback are core to development.

In this role, you will

  • Work in close collaboration with project leads & directors to design, prototype, tune, and ship features and systems that support the engagement, gameplay, and creative vision of the project
  • Document and create clear, actionable design documents, and iterate on these features, working with a team of developers across multiple disciplines, and oversee their successful implementation from start to finish
  • Get hands-on creating the scripting, data, and content required by those features, diving into the engine, and leveraging other tools
  • Be responsible for soliciting and rapidly integrating feedback from across the team on your own initiative, ensuring we’re continually delivering a fun and fresh experience to our players
  • Help establish and maintain design pipelines, best practices, and cross-discipline communication standards to scope, prioritize deliverables, and hit milestone goals

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience on a live service game, shipping a variety of different features and content types to react to changing player patterns
  • Strong scripting and technical capabilities. Bonus points if you have experience with Unreal Engine and the Ability System

jobs.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Observability
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is seeking Software Engineers to join our Observability team within the Infrastructure organization. The Observability team owns the monitoring and telemetry infrastructure that every engineer and researcher at Anthropic depends on, from metrics and logging pipelines to distributed tracing, profiling, error analytics, alerting, and the dashboards and query interfaces that make it all actionable. By joining this team, you'll have a direct impact on the reliability and operational excellence of Anthropic's research and product systems.

As Anthropic scales its infrastructure across large GPU, TPU, and Trainium clusters, the volume and complexity of operational data is growing by orders of magnitude, and an increasing share of the most challenging problems live below the application layer. We're building next-generation observability systems, including high-throughput telemetry pipelines, fleet-wide continuous profiling, eBPF-based tracing and network visibility, and agentic diagnostic tools, so engineers can detect, diagnose, and resolve issues in minutes rather than hours, even when the answer lies in the kernel, the network stack, or an accelerator rather than on a dashboard.

Key responsibilities

  • Design and build scalable telemetry ingest and storage pipelines for metrics, logs, traces, and error data across Anthropic's multi-cluster infrastructure
  • Build observability solutions that give engineers deep, low-overhead visibility into system behavior across the fleet
  • Own and evolve core observability platforms, leading migrations and architectural improvements that improve reliability, reduce cost, and scale with organizational growth
  • Build instrumentation libraries, SDKs, and eBPF-based auto-instrumentation to emit high-quality telemetry, with and without code changes
  • Reduce mean time to detection and resolution by building cross-signal correlation (from kernel-level events up to application traces), unified query interfaces, and AI-assisted diagnostic tooling
  • Improve fleet-wide efficiency by turning continuous profiling and utilization telemetry into actionable optimization insights across CPU, memory, and accelerator fleets
  • Partner with Research, Inference, Product, and Infrastructure teams to ensure observability solutions meet the unique needs of each organization

jobs.description:

As a Staff Data and AI Engineer on the Enterprise Data & AI team, you will build the governed data foundations that power enterprise analytics, automation, and applied AI. Engineering Fundamentals

jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering - SRE Site Lead: Dublin ROC
jobs.description:
The Riot Operations Center (ROC) delivers 24/7 live response for issues that impact our players. The ROC maintains three sites around the world to provide this coverage, embracing SRE best practices, proactive incident reduction, and an engineering-focused culture. Each site acts independently while keeping its processes and direction aligned with those of the ROC as a whole. Our Site Leads direct their teams in driving technical triage, developing systems for incident mitigation, and creating solutions to reduce incidents across all current and future Riot games.

As a Manager, Software Engineering you will ensure that the Dublin ROC Site is providing high quality live response during its share of the ROC’s follow-the-sun coverage model. You will actively grow the engineering skillset and mindset of your engineers, and be accountable for the technical quality of the team’s work. You will actively grow your team to not only be rock-solid Incident Commanders, but to be expert systems and software triagers as well. You will develop and lead a team of technical sleuths that can accelerate finding the source and the dependencies of any problem at Riot.

You’re right for this role if the idea of growing a new kind of engineering team at Riot and coaching engineers to succeed excites you. You believe SRE is a valuable role you play, not a title you are given. You know in your bones that triage, problem identification, and early detection are essential engineering skills, and you want to teach them to others. You cultivate relationships to provide your team with the support it needs to execute and grow. You use iterative approaches to problems and know how to compromise between ideal solutions and practical outcomes. You believe that just because something is hard doesn’t mean it isn’t worth doing.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage the Site's engineering staff for growth and performance
  • Ensure the Site’s engineers receive active mentorship to develop their technical and soft skills
  • Manage the Site’s response coverage and on-call, participating in the on-call rotation as an Incident Commander
  • Manage the Site’s capacity for project work and incident response, and drive and report on site performance metrics

  • Manage stakeholders during critical incident triages and major launches working alongside TPM teams

Riot engineers bring deep knowledge of specific technical areas, but also value the opportunity to work in a variety of broader domains. As Software Engineers, we work with both established and emerging technology, creating innovative solutions to overcome high-volume obstacles and to deliver value to our players.

Riot Client is the gateway for millions of players to play, discover, and install Riot games. Your work on the Client will be every single desktop players' first touchpoint with the wide range of experiences that Riot has to offer, including Riot’s culture & community, or getting into any of our games as fast as possible, like League of Legends, Wild Rift, Teamfight Tactics, VALORANT, Legends of Runeterra, 2XKO, and beyond. It is also an essential tool for internal game developers including live games and R&D games. Introduced in 2021, the multi-game Riot Client is becoming a destination for players to engage with Riot games, events and communities, and is a fast-evolving desktop software that provides capabilities in game distribution, content publishing, social and internal development efficiency.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Riot Client team, you will deliver high-quality technical solutions that improve the player experience across Riot’s out-of-game ecosystem. You’ll contribute hands-on across the software development lifecycle, partnering closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and other cross-functional teammates to build reliable, scalable, and maintainable Client capabilities. You will help shape technical direction within your area of ownership, make sound implementation and design decisions, and collaborate with peers across Riot to support game distribution, content, social features, and developer productivity. Through strong engineering practices, thoughtful code reviews, and mentorship of other engineers, your work will help advance the next generation of Riot Client experiences for players and developers.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain desktop application features focusing on C++, with the ability to integrate with and contribute to web-based technologies
  • Deliver high-quality, scalable, and reliable engineering solutions within your area of ownership, through hands-on contribution and technical design
  • Contribute to technical planning and design discussions, helping evaluate tradeoffs between long-term sustainability and near-term delivery needs
  • Build and apply a strong understanding of the Riot Client’s dependency landscape, partnering with teams to align on technical solutions
  • Work closely with cross-functional partners, including product, production, QA, design, and data insight
  • Level up other engineers through mentorship and technical guidance

Required Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of related industry experience
  • Bachelor's degree

jobs.title: Senior Technical Producer, 1st Party Platforms - Central Compliance & Release
jobs.description:
As Technical Producers at Riot, we lead passionate technical teams to create products and experiences that want to achieve maximum developer and player value. We guide development, smash through obstacles, and push projects across the finish line while making sure that our teams are sustainable and have a great collaborative environment.

As a Senior Technical Producer on the Central Compliance and Release team, you will partner with Engineering and Tech Leads to align on the product technical plans against Mobile 1st Party Platform guidelines and collaborate with Publishing to develop best practices to maximize the marketing potential of titles. You will lead passionate, cross-functional teams to achieve player value through the planning and integration of 1st Party Best Practices and requirements into their products. Your strong vision and leadership skills will ensure we stay one step ahead of the needs of our 1st party partners and game teams by building trust and a deep understanding of their pain points. You will collaborate with teams across Riot to successfully integrate requirements against dependencies, risk factors, and success criteria. You will oversee delivery, build work systems, maintain execution, and provide initiative leadership with visibility on complex deliverables. You will report to the Sr. Manager of Production on Riot’s 1st Party Operations Team.

  • Develop 1st Party product and development strategies with tech teams across Riot
  • Plan technical brainstorm sessions between 1st Party Platform Partners (e.g. Sony, Apple, etc.) and Riot technical/game teams to overcome blockers and develop new features

  • Partner with Publishing and Legal to review contract language and clearly disseminate obligations contained within each contract

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience with strong technical knowledge and problem-solving skills.

jobs.title: Senior VFX Artist - VALORANT
jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played PC game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

As part of the Real-Time VFX team, you will work closely with a team of artists to deliver high quality premium content skin experiences. With your experience, you’ll create aesthetically astounding visual effects that wow and delight our fans adding richness and excitement to the games experience.

As a Senior VFX Artist, you will utilize your exceptional aesthetic sensibility and technical expertise to shape visual direction for a diverse range of weapon skin thematics. You will establish the benchmark and execute based on the creative direction that will guide and empower our partner studios' production efforts.

Beyond asset creation, you will tackle complex artistic and technical challenges, collaborating with fellow artists to pioneer new VFX features ,workflows and guidelines. Working alongside our VFX Manager, you will serve as a key point of contact for external
partners, providing expert guidance and actionable feedback to ensure all content maintains the highest standards of quality, readability, and style.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with the VFX Manager to establish VFX standards and execution strategies for weapon skinlines. Lead early-stage creative and stylistic exploration for high-tier weapon skins, setting the bar of excellence for asset delivery and seamless
    handovers to partner studios for production.
  • Problems solve complex artistic and technical challenges while collaborating closely with the team to develop innovative VFX features and new technologies.
    Foster close collaboration with cross-disciplinary leads, maintaining open communication to build relationships, clarify project goals, and ensure alignment on
    expected outcomes.
  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to partner studios to ensure all VFX deliverables meet the project’s standards. This includes providing hands-on guidance and using paintovers to achieve good readability, clarity and stylization fitting to the game and
    intended thematic intentions.
  • Assist the VFX Manager in onboarding, training and providing resource materials for new VFX artists.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Gameplay - Unpublished R&D Product (Contract)
jobs.description:

我们以玩家体验为核心，致力于用创新技术为全球玩家带来卓越的游戏体验。作为Riot中国在研项目组的一员，你将和多元化团队一同探索前沿引擎技术，不断学习与成长，共同打造高品质、充满想象力的游戏产品。我们鼓励开放合作、不断挑战自我，诚邀热爱研发和创新的你加入！

岗位职责

  • 负责基于Unreal Engine 5（UE5）引擎的游戏客户端功能开发与维护；
  • 实现和优化客户端各类核心功能，保障高性能和稳定性，为玩家呈现流畅的游戏体验；

  • 针对新需求和玩家反馈，持续进行性能分析、问题定位与优化迭代；
  • 跟踪引擎和行业新技术，将高效工具、流程和最佳实践应用到项目中。

任职要求

  • 本科及以上学历，2年以上游戏客户端开发经验，有较强的C++编程功底；
  • 至少1年以上Unreal Engine 5（UE5）项目开发经验 或 2年以上Unity项目开发经验，熟悉引擎开发流程；
  • 能够独立负责细分功能模块的开发、优化与维护；
  • 具备良好的性能优化能力，能够定位并解决客户端的性能问题与兼容性问题；

  • 具备严谨的编码规范与问题分析能力，乐于分享与持续学习新技术。

加分项

  • 熟悉UE5渲染、UI、动画、网络同步等相关模块开发；

You will work closely with Brand, Creative, Social, Influencer, PR, Organized Play, Product teams, and partners to deliver coordinated, player-first experiences. jobs.title: Sr. Director, Creative Direction - TFT
jobs.description:
Game Creative Directors at Riot define and oversee the overall creative strategy for a product. You’ll create inspiring creative direction across experiences that genuinely surprise and delight players. You will help build the product strategy and tie the product’s goals to the target audience. Creative direction is for the team; as the Creative Director acts as the intersection between aesthetics, story, and brand that evokes a visceral response in players. At that intersection you’ll lead with vision and demonstrate incredible taste with a high quality bar.

  • 线下活动与体验式零售： 主导线下周边体验的端到端商业落地。包括在LPL总决赛、VCT巡回赛、拳头游戏周年庆及专属快闪店等重大节点中，全面管理现场销售运营、库存把控及合作伙伴协调。
  • B2B战略与规划： 与销售运营负责人紧密合作，制定年度和季度的B2B销售策略，确保其与我们更广泛的DTP（玩家直营）/电商目标相辅相成。
  • 合作伙伴营销与联合推广： 与外部KA伙伴及内部营销团队协同，设计定制化的零售营销活动，确保我们的实体产品在合作伙伴的生态系统中获得最大化的曝光。

在这个岗位上，你的成功将源于精湛的专业技能、团队协作精神，以及始终将“给玩家带来惊喜”置于首位的决策力。我们不仅会考量你的过往学业与经验，还会看重你与游戏的个人羁绊。如果你具备玩家同理心，并深切关怀玩家的体验，这就是为你量身定制的角色！

  • 对实时光照、着色模型、后处理或风格化渲染有良好理解
  • 具备一定的性能优化经验，熟悉 RenderDoc、Unreal Profiler 等工具的基本使用

加分项：

  • 有完整游戏项目上线经验

对于这个岗位，你将通过工艺专业知识、协作精神以及优先考虑玩家乐趣的决策来获得成功。我们将关注您过去的学习、经验以及您与游戏的个人关系。如果您体现了玩家的同理心并关心玩家的体验，这可能就是您的角色！
